新中式细线设色，别只拿来画古诗。我用它画了今天的城市：便利店、地铁站、老小区、深夜写字楼。

4 段提示词，一段对一张图，直接拿走。换题材只改“画的是现代城市的日常：”后面那一句。

① 便利店
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜街角一家亮着灯的 24 小时便利店。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出玻璃门、货架、冰柜和门口的一辆共享单车，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：屋檐与招牌用石青、石绿，店内灯光用淡藤黄，门口一个小小的外卖骑手背影用一点朱砂红。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。店的上方飘着两团传统画法的云纹，旁边一棵团状树冠的树，用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

② 地铁站台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：早高峰的地铁站台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出站台、屏蔽门、刚进站的列车车头和一排低头看手机的候车人，线条干净不抖，人物很小。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：列车车身的腰线用石青，站台立柱用石绿，候车人群里只有一个人撑着一把朱砂红的伞。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。站台上方的留白里飘着两团传统画法的云纹，仿佛屋顶不存在。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

③ 老小区阳台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：傍晚的老小区阳台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一栋六层居民楼的侧面，每层阳台上有晾衣杆、空调外机、花盆和防盗网，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：几件晾着的衣服用石青和石绿，一户窗里的灯光用淡藤黄，一只蹲在空调外机上的猫用一点朱砂红的项圈点出来。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼旁一棵团状树冠的老树，楼顶上方飘着一团传统画法的云纹，都用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

④ 深夜写字楼
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜还亮着灯的写字楼一角。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一座玻璃幕墙写字楼的上半截，一格一格的窗户排列整齐，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：幕墙的横向分隔带用石青、石绿，整栋楼只有三四格窗户用淡藤黄点亮，其中一格窗里有一个很小的伏案身影，桌上一只朱砂红的杯子。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼腰处横着一带传统画法的云纹，把楼的下半截遮住，远处一弯细细的月亮。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

规律就三条：细线勾形，颜色只给三四处，剩下全留白。

画法参考了 @MrLarus 的新中式古诗系列。

【顶部背景色】：{根据品牌气质填写}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请为以上品牌生成一张完整的「Brand to Logo」品牌 Logo 概念探索设计稿。核心不是简单生成四个相似 Logo，而是围绕同一个品牌名称、行业属性和核心概念，提出四条真正不同的视觉设计路线。

最终画面固定为 9:16 竖版。顶部品牌输入区严格占整个画面高度的 30%，底部 Logo 展示区严格占 70%，无论品牌名称长短都不能改变这个比例；名字较长时缩小字号，不扩大顶部区域。底部 70% 再严格划分为 2×2 四个等大区域，只使用非常浅、非常细的虚线分隔，不绘制外围边框。

【顶部品牌区】

顶部只是品牌原始信息的引入区，不是主视觉海报。使用【顶部背景色】，加入极轻微的纸张、和纸、包装纸、丝网印刷颗粒或与品牌相关的低对比暗纹，只增加质感，不形成复杂插画。

顶部只保留三层信息：

BRAND TO LOGO

【品牌名称】

【英文名称】

品牌名称使用正常、清晰、现代的印刷字体，不提前进行 Logo 化、手写化或图形变形。不要加入口号、品牌说明、大量小英文、编号、印章、辅助图标或复杂光影，让视觉重点自然落到下方四个 Logo 方案。

【底部 Logo 展示区】

底部统一使用 Warm Ivory 暖米白纸张背景，只保留轻微天然纸纹。四个 Logo 都需要围绕【品牌类型】【品牌关键词】【核心视觉意象】展开，保持品牌核心一致，但设计方法必须明显不同。

每个 Logo 都应该是一套完整、可以真实用于门店、包装、标签、社交头像、名片或周边商品的品牌标识，而不是完整插画、海报或装饰图。

每个方案控制在 1–3 个主要颜色以内，优先使用【主色建议】。避免高饱和杂色、复杂渐变、3D、金属浮雕、玻璃质感和商业 mockup。

【Mascot｜吉祥物型】

从品牌名称、行业或核心意象中设计一个高度概括的角色或拟人化主体。角色需要拥有清楚的大轮廓和强记忆点，但不要做成复杂动漫人物或完整场景插画。

让角色本身与品牌概念发生关系，例如抱着产品、隐藏在物体后面、与核心植物或动物融合。搭配完整的【品牌名称】字标和较小的【英文名称】，整体亲和、有故事感、适合社交传播。

【Emblem｜意象徽章型】

不依赖完整人物，而是从【核心视觉意象】中提炼 2–3 个最重要的元素，组合成一个集中、平衡、容易缩小识别的品牌徽章。

优先使用负空间、环绕、上下叠合、局部包围或图形共形，让不同元素真正融合成一个标志，而不是简单把几个小图标并排放在一起。搭配品牌字标，形成完整稳定的 Logo 系统。

【Type-led｜字形创意型】

以【品牌名称】本身作为核心设计对象。分析中文字或英文字母中最有视觉潜力的笔画、结构、偏旁、负空间和字母轮廓，让品牌的核心意象从文字内部自然生长出来。

可以进行省笔、共享笔画、延长、切割、局部替换、负空间重构或字形融合，但必须保留基本识别度。

不要在普通字体旁边额外贴一个图标。重点是让“文字本身就是 Logo”，形成更现代、更聪明、更具有专业平面设计感的方案。

【Stamp｜开放式手作印记型】

设计一款具有手刻、版画、店章或包装印记气质的 Logo，但不要使用规整完整的方框，也不要把所有内容塞进封闭椭圆。

使用不完整边界、开放弧线、自然笔触、品牌核心图形或文字共同形成松散的视觉范围。元素可以轻微错位，边缘允许少量自然缺墨和手工印刷不均，让整体具有呼吸感。

Stamp 必须保持清楚的主次关系和充分留白。不要因为追求“印章感”而变得死板、密集或难以实际使用。

四款必须共享同一个品牌世界观、核心意象和基础配色，但不能只是同一个 Logo 换四种画风或四种排版。

不要加入 A/B/C/D 等编号。底部不要添加口号、解释句或多余信息。不要生成包装 mockup、真实门店场景或完整插画。

最终画面要像一张成熟、干净、有方法差异、有真实品牌设计价值的专业 Logo Exploration Sheet。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【中文姓名】：{例如：林知夏}  
【姓名拼音】：{例如：LIN ZHIXIA}  
【顶部背景色】：{例如：深钴蓝、灰调珊瑚、鼠尾草绿、深酒红}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请将输入的普通中文姓名重新设计成一张完整的「中文个性签名 AI Filter」设计稿。最终画面为 9:16 竖版，上方约占 40%，展示普通印刷姓名；下方约占 60%，展示同一个名字的四种完全不同的艺术手写签名。整体高级、克制、现代、有专业设计提案感，不要像普通字体样张或书法练习纸。

【顶部姓名区】

使用【顶部背景色】作为主色，加入极轻微的纸张或织物质感，并可加入柔和自然的窗影、树影或建筑光影，但不要复杂。顶部中央使用很小、字距宽松的英文“NAME TO SIGNATURE”，中央使用暖象牙白色、规整优雅的中文宋体大字展示【中文姓名】，姓名下方以小字号、宽字距大写英文显示【姓名拼音】。

这里的中文姓名必须保持普通印刷字体，不要手写、连笔或艺术变形，用来明确表现“原始输入”。除此之外不要添加额外标语、解释文案、Logo、编号或装饰图形，保持充分留白，让姓名成为上半部分绝对视觉中心。

【底部签名区】

底部统一使用暖米白色纸张，只保留非常轻微的天然纸纹，不做明显做旧、污渍或强颗粒。使用非常浅、非常细的灰褐色虚线将区域分成 2×2 四格，不需要外边框。每一格只展示一个大尺寸黑色艺术签名，以及下方很小的风格名称：飘逸、锋势、回环、极简。

四个签名全部来源于同一个【中文姓名】，但在结构、方向、节奏、抽象程度、重心和视觉人格上必须有明显差异。不要只是将完整姓名用四种相似连笔方式重新写一遍。允许大胆省笔、合笔、共享笔画、连续连写、拉长、缩写、重构和符号化，不要求每个中文字都完整可辨，重点是从姓名中提炼具有个人识别度的签名结构。

签名使用自然黑色签字笔、钢笔或 gel pen 的真实手写质感，线条带自然笔压变化：起笔较细，主笔略重，转折处有自然压力，快速拖尾逐渐变细，局部允许极轻微断墨。不要生成完全光滑的数字矢量曲线，也不要做成传统毛笔书法。

【飘逸款】

将姓名设计成横向、轻盈、流畅的艺术签名。可以高度压缩中文字形，并让多个字符共享笔画、自然连写，通过一至两条大跨度长线或拖尾把整个姓名连接为完整手势。允许牺牲部分可读性，重点表现流动节奏、速度感和优雅气质。

最终效果应像艺人、设计师或创作者自然签出的成熟个人签名，而不是清楚书写的三个中文字。整体以柔和曲线和连续笔势为主，不要堆叠过多尖角。

【锋势款】

将姓名设计成更加锋利、快速、有力量的签名。大量使用斜线、尖角、高竖笔、快速切线和干脆的收笔，把中文字形高度压缩，只保留几个最有力量的骨架结构。

整体可以明显向右倾斜，形成强烈速度感和现代感。避免大面积柔软圆环，让这款和飘逸款第一眼就形成明显区别，气质偏冷静、果断、有气场。

【回环款】

将姓名设计成以大型回环结构为核心的艺术签名。可以使用开放圆环、自由椭圆、大 S 曲线、丝带式曲线或不规则包围结构，把高度压缩后的姓名笔势自然嵌入回环内部或让其穿过回环，并允许最后一笔突破主体结构形成长收尾。

回环必须具有真人快速书写的自然感，不能像规整几何图形。整体第一眼应更像一个艺术家的个人签名符号，第二眼才感受到它来自原始中文姓名。

【极简款】

这是四种方案中最抽象、最克制的一款。不需要完整写出整个姓名，只从中文字形中提取大约 4–6 个最有识别价值的主笔，例如长横、主竖、折笔、斜线或几个点笔，再重新组合成一个高级、容易记忆的个人视觉标记。

最终效果可以接近 Personal Mark、个人 Logo 或设计师签名。第一眼不要求直接认出完整姓名，但知道原始姓名以后，应能够理解这些笔势与原字结构的关系。保持大量留白，不要添加无关圆圈、箭头、星形或其他装饰符号。

【整体控制】

四款签名必须真正体现不同的人格：飘逸款强调柔长、流动和速度；锋势款强调锐利、力量和斜向结构；回环款强调艺术性、包围关系和图形感；极简款强调省笔、符号化和个人品牌感。

不要让四款只是同一种签名修改尾笔。最终签名既要具有艺术性和明显风格差异，也应保留真实手写感与一定的实际书写可能性。整张画面保持干净、高级、有编辑设计感，不添加 Logo、水印、编号、四角星芒、复杂边框或其他多余装饰元素。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
People always ask me, what's the difference between code and regular text prompts. For starters, pseudocode structures are very versatile. They are also incredible for unique hybrid styles you wouldn't be easily to do with just plain text.

Prompt: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4  famous countries: INPUT: $ SUBJECT

// ============================================================
// SEMANTIC TYPOGRAPHY ENGINE

S = research_and_infer($ SUBJECT)

WORD = shortest_recognizable_name(S)

DATE = most_defining_date_or_period(S)

EVENTS = rank_defining_events(S)

E1 = EVENTS[0]

ICON = select_one_immediately_recognizable_object(S)

MOTION = infer_dominant_force(S)

// 
// FIRST PRINCIPLE

DO NOT illustrate $ SUBJECT next to its name.

BUILD $ SUBJECT INSIDE ITS NAME.

WORD becomes:

    landscape
    architecture
    timeline
    diagram
    stage
    machine

simultaneously.

// GLYPH STRUCTURE

Construct WORD in enormous condensed black capitals.

Each glyph is treated as architectural volume.

Within / through the letters:

roads may travel
crowds may gather
objects may protrude
walls may crack
machines may operate
buildings may rise
waves may flow
aircraft may cross
figures may climb
landmarks may replace strokes

// EVENT SIMULATION

Convert E1 into a physical force acting on typography.

EVENT_FORCE = map(E1)

Examples:

explosion      → radial fracture
discovery      → reveal / aperture
revolution     → letters overturn
expansion      → glyphs stretch outward
collapse       → broken baseline
flight         → aerodynamic crossing
migration      → repeated figures traverse letters
invention      → mechanical assembly
war            → impact scars / division
unification    → disconnected glyphs interlock
digitalization → modular pixel fragmentation

The event must alter letter geometry.

// HERO OBJECT

ICON is rendered as a small three-dimensional object
or miniature physical model.

It intersects the typography rather than floating outside.

Possible placements:

inside counter
crossing stroke
balanced on baseline
emerging through fracture
replacing letter segment
casting shadow over type

// IDENTITY MANUAL LAYER

Around WORD place a rigorous corporate design-sheet system.

Include only meaningful construction information:

    cap height
    glyph width
    angle
    trajectory
    timeline
    radial origin
    structural axis
    relevant dimensions

Use arrows and engineering labels.

Example:

        1969
          ↓
   ╭────────────────────╮
   │     A P O L L O    │
   │      ↑       ↗     │
   │ LANDER   trajectory│
   ╰────────────────────╯

Do not overload.

Approximately 6–14 annotations.

// HISTORICAL MICRO-TIMELINE

Along one edge place 3–6 tiny dates or stages.

Example grammar:

ORIGIN ─── DEVELOPMENT ─── BREAKTHROUGH ─── LEGACY

But replace these with actual subject-specific events.

Typography:
    tiny technical grotesk.

// STYLE HYBRID

STYLE =

    International Typographic Style
    × aerospace engineering manual
    × architectural construction drawing
    × museum exhibition identity
    × monumental condensed typography
    × miniature physical diorama
    × mid-century corporate design documentation.

// VISUAL RULES

Background:
    clean white / very pale warm gray.

Primary:
    black.

Secondary:
    one subject-specific accent color.

Optional tertiary:
    muted gray.

No gradients except realistic shading on the physical ICON.

Typography:
    extremely bold,
    condensed,
    monumental.

Technical annotations:
    hairline weight.

Therefore visual contrast:

████████████████
heavy semantic type

───────────────
ultra-thin engineering logic

// SUBJECT-SPECIFIC GLYPH MUTATION

for glyph in WORD:

    if glyph resembles subject object:
        mutate(glyph, subject_object)

    if event trajectory crosses glyph:
        carve_path(glyph)

    if architecture is relevant:
        extrude_into_building(glyph)

    if historical rupture is relevant:
        fracture(glyph)

    if growth is relevant:
        extend(glyph)

    if movement is relevant:
        shear(glyph)

Maintain minimum 85% word readability.

// MICRO-DIORAMA OPTION

Selected portions of letters may become shallow physical
miniatures.

Example:

letter cavity →
    miniature street

crossbar →
    bridge

stem →
    tower

baseline →
    landscape

counter →
    arena / harbor / planet / laboratory

Tiny people or vehicles may populate them.

Keep scale disciplined.

// COMPOSITION

             DATE

   ┌──────────────────────┐
   │                      │
   │  █████████████████   │
   │  █   SUBJECT    ██   │
   │  █████████████████   │
   │     ↗    ↑     ↘     │
   │ trajectory event icon│
   │                      │
   └──────────────────────┘

      timeline ──────────→

All technical content surrounds,
but never visually defeats,
the enormous central word.

// NEGATIVE RULES

NO conventional poster illustration.
NO logo placed above a picture.
NO fake blueprint decoration.
NO arbitrary dimensions.
NO multiple unrelated hero objects.
NO generic typography.
NO colorful comic clutter.

The WORD itself must communicate
what happened,
how it happened,
and why SUBJECT matters.

// OUTPUT

A severe black-and-white identity specimen in which
the subject's name becomes a functioning miniature world,
its defining event physically transforms the glyphs,
a single iconic 3D object interacts with the typography,
and precise corporate-construction annotations explain
the geometry like a lost industrial design document.

Prompt:

Crea un póster vertical 9:16 de diseño editorial para transformar un nombre en cuatro estilos de firma.

【Nombre】{ej. Lucía Márquez}  
【Color superior】{terracota / azul cobalto / oliva / ciruela / ocre}

Parte superior ~40%: fondo de color suave y poco saturado, textura sutil de papel y sombra natural de ventana. Texto pequeño: “DEL NOMBRE A LA FIRMA”. En el centro muestra 【Nombre】 en tipografía sans serif moderna y legible; debajo, el mismo nombre en MAYÚSCULAS con amplio espaciado. Respeta exactamente tildes, ñ y caracteres especiales.

Parte inferior ~60%: papel marfil cálido, dividido en una cuadrícula 2×2 con líneas discontinuas muy suaves. Diseña cuatro firmas negras claramente diferentes para el mismo nombre:

FLUIDA — larga, continua, elegante, con un trazo final extendido.  
AFILADA — angular, rápida, con diagonales, cruces y trazos altos.  
LAZO — crea un gran lazo a partir de una letra real del nombre, como g, y, j o q; no añadas un óvalo decorativo.  
MARCA — versión mínima y abstracta basada en las iniciales y 4–6 trazos principales, como una firma-monograma personal.

Permite unir, reducir, superponer o abstraer letras. Las cuatro firmas deben diferenciarse claramente en silueta, ritmo y personalidad.

Usa tinta negra realista de bolígrafo o pluma, con presión natural y ligeras irregularidades. Estética sofisticada, minimalista y editorial española contemporánea.

Sin marcas de agua, números, bordes gruesos, estrellas, corazones, flores, coronas, escudos ni elementos decorativos innecesarios.

prompts.text:
Breakfast with the best view ever.

**PROMPT**
Color street photography in lifestyle style, shot on iPhone 17, 24 mm wide-angle lens, realistic style, high detail, natural lighting, light grain, 9:16 format. Composition: I, a woman, sitting at a stone table on a mountain pasture, body relaxed, one hand resting on the table, gaze directed straight into the camera, expression calm and confident. I am wearing a black oversized Adidas tracksuit with white stripes down the sleeves and a small white Adidas logo on the chest, loose dark trousers.

On the table in front of me: white plates with large red strawberries, dark grapes and apples, a blue-and-white porcelain teapot and bowls with an Eastern pattern, croissants, a plastic bag of food, a bottle of Fiji water, a pack of cigarettes and a lighter.

Location: a high-mountain pasture; in the background — majestic snow-capped mountains with sharp peaks, green slopes, a herd of horses of different colors (dark, bay, light) grazing on the grass, a clear blue sky with white clouds, cool mountain air. Lighting: natural daylight, soft shadows, warm reflections on skin and objects, realistic color rendering. Angle: slightly from below, as if the photo was taken from table level. Color palette: natural color, with accents of black, white, green, red and blue.

【包围方式】暗边夹景 / 圆周环绕 / 时间边界 / 真实门框 / 其他
【空间关系】透视 / 模糊 / 折射 / 旋转 / 运动拖影 / 层层深入 / 其他
【强调色】
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Photography 气质的现代展览海报。核心采用“空间型包围式构图”：不要只依靠文字或边框围住主体，而是利用真实空间、暗部边缘、圆周轨道、摄影裁切、建筑门框、玻璃介质、运动方向或透视结构，从外围向中央建立视觉压力和纵深，让中心自然成为视线落点。包围关系必须有明确前后层次，避免只是平面贴字；可以采用“暗边夹住亮窗口”“圆形主体与环形文字形成轨道”“时间 Typography 从边缘压入摄影”“连续门框一层层指向远处”等方式，让包围本身产生空间感。

先根据【主题】和【空间关系】选择一种最适合的视觉机制。人物或摄影题材可以利用磨砂玻璃、模糊、遮挡和明暗边界形成“外暗内亮”；圆形对象可以让文字沿圆周运行，再用针、杆、手或其他真实物件打破闭合轨道；动态摄影可以让时间、方向和大字从边缘进入，再利用运动拖影把多个区域连接起来；建筑题材可以直接用门洞、墙体、窗框或走廊形成真实的 Frame within Frame。每张只保留一种主机制，不要把圆周、门框、玻璃、拖影全部混在一起。

Typography 必须与空间发生真实关系，而不是浮在图片表面。使用一个醒目的【中文核心字】，允许贴边、局部裁切、反白、被玻璃折射、被暗部吞没、沿圆周变形或与摄影边缘发生遮挡；英文标题可使用 Grotesk、Condensed Sans、Outline Sans 或克制 Serif，并根据空间结构进行横排、竖排、90° 旋转或沿路径排列。大字负责建立边界，中字负责主题，小字只保留日期、地点和极少信息。不要靠大量说明文字制造复杂感。

画面要强化真实的前后层次和空间方向。可以通过明暗、遮挡、尺度差、透视、模糊梯度、反射、圆周运动或连续门洞，让观众明确感受到“外围 → 中层 → 中心 / 远处”的视觉推进。至少保留一处“破框”关系，例如唱针切断圆周文字、人物手部靠近玻璃而更清楚、红线跨出摄影边界、远处色块穿过连续门洞成为最终焦点。破框只保留 1–2 处，避免画面失控。

整体保持现代、克制和高对比。背景优先使用冷白、炭黑、浅灰等中性色，根据主题只加入一个【强调色】；强调色可以用于远处出口、圆形中心、时间节点、细线或局部光源，总面积控制在约 5%–10%。如果使用摄影，摄影本身也应保持统一的灰阶、低饱和或单色体系，不要被商业调色、霓虹或电影特效抢走版式逻辑。

信息密度主要来自“空间层级 + Typography + 主体结构”，不是来自知识模块。中央或远端焦点必须比外围更简洁，至少保留约 25%–35% 的有效负空间。外围可以更重、更密、更黑，中心可以更亮、更静、更空，形成明显的“外密 × 内疏”或“外暗 × 内亮”关系。不要加入流程图、材料卡、小图拼贴、复杂参数或无意义说明，除非它们本身就是主题不可缺少的一部分。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼先看到强烈的外围结构与中央空间焦点，第二眼理解包围关系如何制造纵深或聚焦，第三眼发现模糊、轨道、运动、门框或遮挡等真实空间机制，最后才阅读标题、日期和少量信息。整张作品要像真实的当代摄影展、声音艺术展、建筑展或独立文化视觉，而不是普通照片加字、商业海报或信息说明页。

避免：普通满版摄影、电影海报感、赛博朋克、霓虹特效、科技 HUD、复杂频谱、地铁线路图、机械圆框、平均四边框、PPT 排版、过多说明文字、随机英文、Design Study、Vol.、编号、Logo、二维码和版权标识。

Prompt:

[Name]: {e.g. Amelia Rose}  
[Top Background Color]: {e.g. dusty blue, muted rose, forest green, deep burgundy, warm ochre}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a vertical 9:16 "Name to Signature" design sheet that transforms one plain English name into four clearly different handwritten signature concepts.

Use two sections. The top 40% shows the original typed name, and the bottom 60% shows four signature designs.

For the top section, use the selected muted background color with subtle paper or fabric texture and a soft natural shadow. Add small widely spaced text at the top:

NAME TO SIGNATURE

Display the original name in the center using a large, clean neutral sans-serif font such as Helvetica, Arial, Inter, or a similar modern typeface. This must look like normal typed text, not handwriting. Keep the layout minimal and do not add extra slogans or decorative copy.

For the bottom section, use a warm ivory paper background with very subtle grain. Divide it into a clean 2×2 grid using faint thin dashed lines, with no outer border.

Create four large black handwritten signatures for the same name. They must be noticeably different in silhouette, rhythm, stroke direction, abstraction, and personality. Do not simply generate four similar cursive versions.

Use realistic gel pen or fountain pen handwriting with natural pressure variation, lighter entry strokes, stronger main strokes, tapered endings, and slight ink irregularity. Letters may merge, stretch, overlap, simplify, share strokes, or become partially abstract. The goal is signature design, not perfect letter-by-letter readability.

FLOW: Create a graceful, fluid signature with smooth connected strokes and one or two long sweeping tails. Keep it elegant, natural, and believable as a real personal signature.

EDGE: Create a sharper, more directional signature using stronger slant, tall vertical accents, pointed turns, crossings, and decisive endings. Make it modern, confident, and fashion-forward.

LOOP: Build the signature around a large expressive looping gesture. Compress parts of the name inside or across the loop, and allow one stroke to extend outward as a strong finishing motion. Keep the loop organic and handwritten rather than geometrically perfect.

MARK: Create the most minimal and abstract version. Reduce the name to approximately 4–6 important strokes, often using the initials or strongest letter shapes as the foundation. The result may resemble a personal monogram or creator mark more than fully readable handwriting.

For softer or more romantic names, MARK may be replaced with CHARM: a refined usable signature with one subtle personal detail, such as a tiny heart-like terminal or a minimal floral gesture. Keep it tasteful and mature.

The four designs must feel clearly different at first glance. FLOW should feel fluid, EDGE sharp, LOOP expressive, and MARK minimal.

Keep each signature large enough to dominate its quadrant. Do not add extra descriptions under the style labels.

Do not add watermarks, numbering, decorative borders, stars, crowns, excessive hearts, unrelated icons, or unnecessary graphic elements.

Prompt:

【主题】：
【主视觉对象】：
【中文核心字】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【主体特性】：展开 / 垂落 / 翻卷 / 分层 / 振动 / 投影 / 反射 / 其他
【档案信息】：结构 / 材料 / 尺寸 / 过程 / 局部样本 / 其他
【主题色】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 East Asian Editorial Design、Museum Poster 与文化出版物质感的竖版海报。

采用“非均衡三分构图”，让画面分别承担主视觉、标题文字和辅助档案信息，但不要平均切成三个区域，也不要出现明显分栏。

先分析【主视觉对象】最有辨识度的真实物理或材质特性，再让这种特性直接决定构图。例如展开产生放射、布料垂落与翻卷形成纵深、材料切面揭示内部层次、琴弦振动形成连续轨迹。不要机械套用案例，应根据当前对象重新寻找最合适的视觉动作。

主体必须占据较大的视觉权重，并跨越至少两个区域。通过遮挡、穿插、投影、翻卷、剖面、延伸、振动或其他真实空间关系，把主视觉、Typography 与信息区连接起来，而不是把三部分分别摆放。

设置一个醒目的【中文核心字】，使用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，使文字本身成为构图的一部分。允许主体穿过文字、文字跨越不同材质后发生黑白反转、影子覆盖文字或结构线进入字形负空间，但始终保证核心字清晰可读。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸作为基底，搭配墨黑文字和一个主要【主题色】。每张作品尽量只保留一个强强调色，纸张具有轻微纤维与哑光印刷质感，保持干净，不做严重旧化。

加入与主题真实相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、结构剖面、制作过程、尺寸、运动状态、局部微距或时间记录。小信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace，英文标题使用 Serif。所有文字都应服务作品主题，不使用 Design Study、Visual System、Vol.、Case 等模板占位词。

信息密度保持中高，但不要平均铺满。主视觉形成高密区，结构与档案形成中密区，同时保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成明显的密疏节奏。

最终阅读顺序：第一眼看到巨大主体与核心中文；第二眼发现主体跨区形成的空间或运动关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或制作过程；第四眼阅读作品标题和档案细节。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级与编辑气质，但每张根据不同【主体特性】重新设计三分方向、视觉动势和跨区方式，不做模板换皮。

避免：平均三栏、PPT 感、普通产品摆拍、满版图片加标题、随机小字、无意义英文、科技 HUD、过度做旧、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

4 jobs of the future, visualized by GPT. I am testing these logo prompts with all kinds of topics to see how far I can push the model. 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 jobs of the future: INPUT:
WORD_OR_PHRASE = [ANY TEXT]
OBJECT_OR_INSTRUMENT = [ANY FORM SYSTEM]
SYMBOL_SYSTEM = [OPTIONAL]
MARK_STYLE = [OPTIONAL]

Analyze glyph anatomy:

STEM := main vertical or diagonal stroke
BOWL := rounded enclosed stroke
COUNTER := inner negative space
ASCENDER := upward extension
DESCENDER := downward extension
TERMINAL := stroke ending
SWASH := decorative curve
JOIN := connection between letters

Analyze object anatomy:

BODY := main mass
NECK_OR_HANDLE := elongated structural extension
OPENING := mouth, hole, lens, portal, socket, vent, chamber, cup, or hollow
CONTROLS := buttons, keys, rivets, switches, knots, joints, symbols, or nodes
BASE := grounded or weight-bearing portion
TIP := pointed, soft, capped, hooked, tapered, or functional end
DETAILS := secondary marks from SYMBOL_SYSTEM

Map object anatomy into glyph anatomy:

STEM → structural body, handle, shaft, neck, tower, spine, leg, or support
BOWL → opening, chamber, eye, wheel, bell, cup, core, or negative-space feature
COUNTER → preserved readable interior void
ASCENDER → rising extension, mouthpiece, branch, antenna, blade, mast, smoke, or cable
DESCENDER → lower curve, tail, root, tube, stand, strap, cable, or support
TERMINAL → tip, cap, hook, nozzle, claw, foot, leaf, knob, or exit stroke
SWASH → flowing body contour, tube, strap, sound curve, motion trail, ribbon, or outline
JOIN → integrated connection between typography and object anatomy

Render as a clean, high-contrast, readable logo mark.

MiniMax H3 Prompt
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is A from <Picture 1>, the caster who banishes B.
<Subject 2> is B from <Picture 2>, who returns with souvenirs.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories and illustrated styles. Scale both complete designs to equal standing height while retaining individual proportions.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1). Use its vocal identity and natural pitch range, not its recorded words.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second Japanese 2D anime comedy. A banishes B through a dark portal and believes she has won. After a short empty pause, the same B returns through a smaller portal behind A, carrying a shopping bag and soft-serve ice cream. B taps A's shoulder and offers a souvenir bun. End on A silently staring at the bun she has received. Use the selected output aspect ratio.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shots 1-4): fully_preserved - retain her identity and design with new actions and expressions.
<Subject 2> (Shots 1, 3, 4): fully_preserved - the returning B is the same person, with unchanged costume and new handheld souvenirs.
<Audio 1>: reference - voice timbre for A's single opening sentence.
Images provide identity and style only, not poses, backgrounds or reference-sheet layouts.
detailed_description:
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime with clean linework, cel shading, fluid motion and expressive faces. A level stone courtyard in warm daylight. Exactly two human identities, one A and one B. Equal standing height from soles to skull tops, excluding head ornaments. Establish both at equal camera depth and maintain their scale across shots.
B has one continuous body. She fully exits through the first portal before returning through the second. During the pause, only A is visible. No copies, humanoid afterimages, mirror images, extra faces or additional travelers appear. Portal interiors show abstract darkness and light, never duplicate people.
On return, B holds one vanilla soft-serve cone upright in her LEFT hand. One small plain kraft-paper shopping bag hangs from her LEFT forearm by its handles, leaving her RIGHT hand free. Inside the bag is one round golden-brown souvenir bun in a small white paper cup. No writing, labels, logos or numbers on any prop.

[Shot 1] Open on a level full-body two-shot. <Subject 1> stands screen-left and <Subject 2> screen-right, facing each other about three meters apart. Both are visibly the same standing height. A sweeps her right palm toward B. A tall vertical oval of violet-edged darkness opens immediately behind B, its lower edge meeting the ground.
From 0.3 to 2.8 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1), using the voice timbre of <Audio 1>, declares with proud theatrical confidence, [Japanese] いくうかんで、えいえんにさまよえ! Synchronize A's lips with this sentence and finish before three seconds.

A brief inward gust lifts B's hair and loose fabric. B slides backward through the opening as one intact body, feet close to the ground. Show her crossing its plane rather than dissolving into particles. By four seconds she has completely disappeared. Only then does the portal contract and close. No part of B remains in the courtyard. A magical rushing sound ends with a low sealing thump.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, cut to a medium-wide view of A and the now-empty space on her right. A lowers her casting hand, lifts her chin and closes her lips into a smug smile. Hold her apparent victory for a clear beat. B and all portals are absent. Quiet wind replaces the magical rumble.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, cut to a wider three-quarter view. A remains in the foreground, still looking toward the empty banishment spot. A second, narrower but full-height portal opens behind her left shoulder, leaving clear space between A and the opening. A does not notice it yet.
The SAME <Subject 2> steps forward through this opening, already holding the ice cream and carrying the paper bag on her left forearm. Her appearance and height are unchanged. Show one continuous entrance: head, torso and legs cross the doorway together in a normal walking action. She places both feet on the courtyard floor before the portal closes behind her. Prompt: 

2x2 grid, 16:9, AI picks subjects: INPUT: $ SUBJECT

// ── SEMANTIC INFERENCE ──────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHETYPE     = infer_subject_archetype($ SUBJECT)        // detective, child, musician, dancer, animal, messenger
MOOD_KEY      = infer_emotional_tone($ SUBJECT)           // melancholic, defiant, whimsical, longing, solemn
STAGE         = infer_storybook_setting($ SUBJECT)        // rain-slick street, foggy forest, train platform, ballroom
LIGHT_SOURCE  = infer_primary_light($ SUBJECT)            // window slats, streetlamp, projector beam, moon
HAZE          = infer_atmospheric_element($ SUBJECT)      // smoke, fog, mist, dust, rain, steam
SYMBOLS       = infer_symbolic_objects($ SUBJECT, 3..5)   // clocks, birds, keys, doors, branches, letters
FRAME_ELEMENT = infer_framing_device($ SUBJECT)           // doorway, arch, window, mirror, stage proscenium
SILHOUETTES   = infer_background_figures($ SUJECT, 1..3)  // distant witness, mirror-self, shadow-self
ACCENT_COLOR  = infer_single_accent($ SUBJECT)            // red, blue, yellow, ember orange, none
PALETTE       = { black, deep charcoal, graphite, silver-gray, paper white, one accent }
TEXTURE_MIX   = { film_grain, ink_wash, paper_fiber, smoke_haze, wet_reflection }

// ── COMPOSITION FIELD ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Subject anchors the center; light rays and reflections radiate outward.
P(x,y) = subject_gravity(ARCHETYPE) + beam_pressure(LIGHT_SOURCE)
F = ∇P                    // primary light ray direction, floor reflection angle
Curl = ∇×P                // smoke curls, water ripples, cloud shape, decorative scrollwork
Div  = ∇·F                // density of symbolic objects, background figures, poster elements

// ── SUBJECT LAYER ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SUBJECT_RENDER = monochrome_figure(
    archetype   := ARCHETYPE,
    pose        := staged_contrapposto or dramatic_gesture,
    silhouette  := clean, readable, theatrical,
    facial_tone := partial shadow — features half-lit, half-dissolved
)
// Subject faces a light source; one side is silver-gray, the other black.
// No full-face realism — expression implied through silhouette and gesture.

// ── LIGHTING SYSTEM ────────────────────────────────────────────
KEY       : single directional beam from LIGHT_SOURCE
            — window slats casting parallel shadows
            — streetlamp halo pooling on wet floor
            — projector cone slicing through haze
            — moonburst through foliage
FILL      : minimal, deep shadow dominant
RIM       : reflective highlight on the floor, silver edge on subject's silhouette
BEAMS     : volumetric light shafts through haze; sharp or diffuse depending on genre
REFLECTIONS: wet floor, mirrored pool, polished surface, glass

// ── ATMOSPHERE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
HAZE_LAYER = volumetric field from HAZE:
    density  : gradient from subject outward
    motion   : drifting, curling, thinning
    interaction: haze brightens in beam, darkens in shadow
    treatment: silver streaks, mist ribbons, ink-wash blots

// ── STORYBOOK FRAMING ──────────────────────────────────────────
FRAME_DEVICE = FRAME_ELEMENT rendered in strong graphic style
    — arch, doorway, window, mirror: purely architectural silhouette
    — acts as a threshold the subject either stands within, moves through, or faces
DECORATIVE_DETAILS around edges:
    — scrollwork corners, hanging vines, tiny stars, floating leaves
    — restrained, not cluttering; each traces to $ SUBJECT's world

// ── SYMBOLIC OBJECTS ───────────────────────────────────────────
for each symbol in SYMBOLS:
    placed at a Div-maximum point
    rendered as silhouette or outlined icon
    some act as foreground depth cues (feet of a statue, top of a clock)
    some act as background narrative cues (distant figure, hanging sign)
    none compete with subject silhouette

// ── STAGED BACKGROUND ──────────────────────────────────────────
BACKGROUND = layered stage geometry
    LAYER 1 (nearest): frame element + foreground props
    LAYER 2 (mid): subject + symbolic objects
    LAYER 3 (far): distant architecture, silhouettes, glowing windows
    LAYER 4 (deepest): fog banks, moon, horizon haze
Every layer separated by tone and haze; no layer fully resolved.

// ── ACCENT COLOR ───────────────────────────────────────────────
ACCENT = single hue applied to one element only:
    — a scarf, a lit window, an eye highlight, a blossom, a lantern
    — maximum 3% of frame area
    — if subject suggests no accent, palette stays pure monochrome

// ── TEXTURE PASS ───────────────────────────────────────────────
Composite pass: film grain overlay (subtle, organic)
Ink wash diffusion on flat tone regions
Paper fiber visible in highlights
Wet reflections rendered with sharp silver streak highlights
Smoke rendered as soft diffusion, no hard edges

// ── CAMERA & FINISH ────────────────────────────────────────────
Framing   : subject slightly off-center, framed by stage geometry
Format    : 4:5 or 2:3
Resolution: 8K
Finish    : filmic black-and-white, no color, no bloom, no vignette beyond natural falloff
Text      : none

// ── VALIDATION ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
verify: subject silhouette reads at 200px thumbnail
verify: primary light source creates consistent shadows across all layers
verify: accent color (if present) appears on exactly one element
verify: no color beyond palette + single accent
verify: no logos, no watermarks, no captions
verify: image reads as a poster, not a photograph
Output: one 8K monochrome noir storybook poster.

设计一张「一字一境」东方古画文字重构海报。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：____
【主视觉】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【三分方式】：纵向 / 横向 / 2+1 / 错位
【主色】：____

【比例】：9:16

生成一张 East Asian Editorial Design 风格的文化海报，使用“非均衡三分区构图”。

不要平均把画面切成三块，而是让三个区域分别承担：主视觉、标题文字、辅助信息。主视觉占最大权重，标题形成明显 Typography 大形，较小区域负责时间、材料、地点、数据、图谱或其他与主题真正相关的信息。

prompts.text:
兄弟，我发现了一个特别容易出神图的海报公式。

真的不是再加几个“高级感、电影感、杂志感”这种废词。

我最近在研究这类复古海报，突然发现它最爽的地方是：

把一幅名画“拆了”，只拿走它最值钱的东西。

不是复刻《雾海上的漫游者》《睡莲》《神奈川冲浪里》，而是只提炼：

巨大英文单词 + 极小人物 + 大面积留白 + Swiss 排版 + 70 年代旧印刷质感。

一下就从“名画二创”变成了真正的概念设计海报。

提示词母版也直接送了，自己替换括号就行👇

3:4 conceptual retro editorial poster, inspired by 【名画母题/艺术流派】 but not directly reproducing it, reinterpret its composition, visual motif and emotional atmosphere as a modern conceptual poster.

Large 【cream / ivory】 negative space on aged uncoated paper, giant uppercase word “【主标题】” in 【颜色】 bold condensed sans-serif typography, interacting with the scene through fog, water, architecture or foreground elements.

Lower portion shows 【重新设计后的场景】 with a very small 【人物 / 小船 / 房子 / 物体】 as a scale anchor, creating a strong contrast between monumental typography and tiny human presence.

Swiss modernist editorial layout, tiny ISSUE / DATE / POSTER SERIES metadata, thin rule lines, small poetic quote, bottom caption and issue number.

Muted 2–4 color palette, 1970s European art magazine aesthetic, vintage offset printing, screen print texture, halftone grain, faded ink, subtle scratches, slight misregistration, aged paper fibers, matte finish.

minimal, poetic, conceptual, museum poster, elegant, restrained, quiet but visually striking.

no QR code, no watermark, no logo, no mockup, no social media overlay, no glossy commercial style, no neon cyberpunk, no 3D metallic text, no clutter
这套东西我越玩越觉得有意思。

AI 画图最怕的是“想画得漂亮”，一旦开始用设计逻辑控制它，味道马上就不一样了。

Pet Portrait AI Filter Prompt

Use the uploaded pet photo as the source. Create one vertical 9:16 comparison image:
Top 50% = the original pet photo
Bottom 50% = the AI-filtered storybook portrait

Keep the top image faithful to the uploaded photo. Do not repaint, stylize, beautify, or redesign it. Only crop when necessary to fit the layout.

For the filtered portrait, keep the pet clearly recognizable. Preserve its species, breed traits, coat colors, markings, facial features, expression, and the core action or moment captured in the original photo.

Do not simply repaint the photo. Reimagine the pet as a charming hand-painted storybook character based on what is actually happening in the image.

Use the pet’s real activity, expression, clothing, pose direction, and nearby objects as the storytelling cues. Preserve the original little story — for example running with a ball, hiding inside a paper bag, yawning, getting soaked, chewing a plant, or wearing a funny accessory.

You may add a few small playful details only when they naturally extend the original moment. Do not invent unrelated costumes, fantasy props, or completely new scenes.

Use cute, slightly exaggerated character proportions where appropriate: a somewhat larger head, expressive eyes, compact body, and small paws. Keep the pet’s original expression and personality more important than making every character look equally cute.

Render the result with traditional watercolor and opaque gouache on warm white textured paper. Use visible brushstrokes, layered pigment, dry-brush texture, slightly rough edges, and handcrafted color variation. Avoid smooth digital gradients, glossy 3D rendering, anime styling, or photorealistic painting.

Keep the lower portrait clean and visually focused, with generous warm-white negative space around the character. Retain only the props or environmental details needed to tell the pet’s story.

The top and bottom sections must each occupy exactly 50% of the final image.

Do not add text, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, inset images, or decorative frames.

REFERENCES
A = the black-haired heroine from @Image 1.
B = the white-haired heroine from @Image 2.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and 2D anime art styles. Appearance references only; new poses and background. Separate identities, consistent scale.
Both characters are completely silent. No voice references, dialogue or lip sync.
STYLE AND STAGING
Photorealistic Shibuya crossing at dusk, with realistic asphalt, glass and buildings. Keep heroines hand-drawn 2D anime: clean lines, cel shading, matching lighting and shadows.
Empty streets. Exactly two heroines. A stays screen-left, B screen-right.
One tall, narrow orange fire pillar rises between them, slightly behind their positions, above the lower rooftops. Orange light reflects across asphalt and windows.
B stays outside the fire; her skewer reaches its outer edge. Keep faces and skewer visible.
PROP CONTINUITY
One long, rigid bamboo skewer, held in B's right hand throughout. One white cylindrical marshmallow is firmly pierced at its tip and visible from the opening shot.
Keep the marshmallow attached, unchanged in shape and size. Toasting changes its surface from white to golden brown.
Move skewer and marshmallow together; preserve grip, attachment and length.
Only the marshmallow tip enters the flame's edge. B's hand and body remain outside it.
Shot 1 [0-3s] — WORLD-ENDING FIRE
Start with A already thrusting one palm toward the empty ground. Within the first second, a towering orange fire pillar erupts from that point.
Low-angle wide two-shot: A's serious casting pose, B standing calmly with her skewer, and the enormous flame all remain visible.
Gold-centered orange flames and sparks surge upward. Wind lifts A's hair and costume edges; firelight washes across buildings.
A keeps her mouth closed and looks completely confident. B glances from the fire to her marshmallow.
<Heavy magical ignition, deep rushing flames>
(Ominous instrumental strings and forceful percussion, no vocals.)
Shot 2 [3-7s] — AN ORDINARY USE
One uninterrupted three-quarter medium shot showing B's face, right hand, full skewer, marshmallow and the flame's edge.
B calmly extends her right arm, moving the skewer horizontally toward the fire. The marshmallow reaches the outer edge; her grip stays well away from the flames.
She stops and holds the marshmallow steadily there. Its visible surface begins changing from white to pale gold.
Keep A visible at screen-left, still maintaining her dramatic spell.
B's lips stay closed: calm expression, tiny snack, immense fire.
<Continuous roaring fire, faint toasting crackle>
(The dramatic instrumental score continues seriously.)

Shot 3 [7-11s] — PERFECTLY TOASTED
Close-up of the marshmallow on the skewer, with B's unchanged grip still readable. Its surface finishes turning evenly golden brown, with a few small toasted patches. Preserve its shape and attachment.
Cut back to the medium two-shot. B withdraws the complete skewer from the flame and holds it on her own side.
A notices the toasted marshmallow. Her confidence fades. She lowers her casting palm; the fire pillar rapidly collapses into its original ground point and disappears.
By 11s, the street is clear of fire. Keep the buildings intact and return their lighting to dusk.
Stop the music exactly when the pillar disappears.
<Fire rushing down, one short magical fizzle, then faint city wind>
Shot 4 [11-12s] — SNACK READY
B raises the skewer slightly and admires the perfectly toasted marshmallow with her usual small, satisfied smile. Her lips stay closed.
A looks from the vanished fire to the tiny golden marshmallow.
No eating, blowing, chewing or speaking. The visual joke is already complete.
Shot 5 [12-15s] — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Close-up of A, preserving @Image 1's exact facial design.
Her eyes widen, pupils become small and eyebrows rise. Lips part slightly once, then remain still. Use her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
A short, controlled push-in. Hold the final full second with only a tiny shoulder tremble.
No vocal reaction. End directly on A's silent face.
AUDIO CONTROL
Zero character vocal sounds throughout: no speech, narration, inner monologue, grunts, gasps, screams, laughter, vocal breaths, choir or vocal samples.
Specified instrumental music, effects and ambience only. After the fire disappears, ambience only. No comedy sting or canned laughter.
EXCLUDE
Extra people, clones, face swaps, costume changes, realistic character faces, game-CG, chibi, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, bent or duplicate skewers, detached or duplicate marshmallows, destroyed food, obscured faces, injury, destroyed buildings, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks, HUD, end card.

High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime with smooth character motion, clean linework, expressive faces and cinematic depth. Use three-quarter views, foreground separation and gentle camera parallax, not flat front-facing staging. One continuous location: a deserted, cracked stone courtyard at dusk, with cool ambient light and warm rim light. Keep the location and lighting consistent through the comedy.

Continuity: exactly two full-size characters and one inanimate, hand-sized curse doll. The doll has a straw body, stitched face, and simplified hair and clothing colors matching <Subject 2>, never <Subject 1>. Its appearance and size stay unchanged. Both have the exact referenced designs. Faint violet curse threads connect the doll to <Subject 2>. With ominous confidence and the voice timbre from <Audio 1>, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Japanese] お前の体は、思いのまま.</d>
The caster's right hand bends the doll's RIGHT elbow upward once. At that exact moment, <Subject 2>'s RIGHT elbow involuntarily bends to the same angle. Show the doll's arm and the corresponding real arm together in the SAME frame, without an intervening cut. A brief violet pulse and taut magical twang mark the connection. The opponent looks startled but remains silent. No injury. The caster releases the doll's forearm; both affected arms settle. The doll remains in the caster's left hand.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut slightly wider on the same side of the axis.
<Subject 2> looks from the doll to their own shoulder, then steps half a pace closer. In one clearly visible action, the opponent takes the doll's torso with the right hand; the caster's left fingers release it. The opponent draws it to their own chest and supports it with both hands. 生成一张具有 **East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Design** 气质的现代竖版海报，核心采用“对角构图”。不要简单把图片或文字旋转 45°，而是先建立一条隐形的斜向主轴，让主体、自然边界、色域或负空间从一个角向另一个角推进，使整个版面的视觉重量产生明确方向。

根据【主题】选择一种最适合的对角机制：人物题材可以让身体动作从左下伸向右上，以姿态本身形成视觉主轴；极简题材可以让大片斜向负空间成为真正主体，只加入极小人物作为尺度参照；自然题材可以利用海岸线、水面、山坡、光影边界等真实斜向关系切分画面；地形或建筑题材可以用大面积切面、尺度差和留白形成距离感。每张只突出一种主要机制，不要把人物、斜线、色块和复杂透视全部叠在一起。

对角构图应依赖“大关系”，不是小装饰。主体或主要色域最好占画面约 45%–65%，同时保留一块明显的安静区域，使画面形成“密到疏”“近到远”或“重到轻”的方向变化。避免平均 50% 对半切，也不要使用标准机械的 45° 斜线，可以让斜向角度略微偏移，使版式更自然、更有编辑感。

Typography 必须保持稳定，与动态画面形成对抗。中文核心字可以放大、贴边、局部裁切，但保持水平或竖直；英文标题使用 Serif、Grotesk 或 Condensed Sans，小信息使用 Neutral Grotesk。不要让所有文字跟随斜线倾斜。建议形成“图像负责动，文字负责稳”的关系，并允许主体与文字产生一处轻微穿插、遮挡或压边。

整体色彩控制在 2–3 个主要层级，以冷白、暖白、黑、灰或单一高纯强调色为主。强调色可以用于短线、节点、局部标题或主体区域，但不要平均散布。保持现代、克制、干净，减少传统装饰和模板化说明文字。信息密度以中等为宜，至少保留约 25%–35% 有效留白。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到强烈的对角大形，第二眼理解主体或边界如何形成方向，第三眼发现尺度、负空间和文字之间的关系，最后再阅读标题与少量信息。整体效果应像真实的现代展览海报、摄影专题、文化视觉或设计年鉴案例，而不是普通图片斜着摆放。

避免：所有元素都倾斜、标准 45° 模板、平均对半切、斜向时间轴、PPT 感、满版说明文字、无意义英文、复杂传统装饰、科技 HUD、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【品牌名称】：{例如：尾巴日和}  
【英文名称】：{例如：TAIL & DAY PET CLUB}  
【品牌类型】：{例如：宠物生活方式品牌 / 花店 / 餐饮 / 书店}  
【品牌关键词】：{例如：温暖、自然、亲切、手作感}  
【核心视觉意象】：{例如：尾巴、太阳、宠物陪伴}  
【主色建议】：{例如：奶油黄、深棕、砖红、鼠尾草绿}  
【顶部背景色】：{根据品牌气质填写}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请为以上品牌生成一张完整的「Brand to Logo」品牌 Logo 概念探索设计稿。核心不是简单生成四个相似 Logo，而是围绕同一个品牌名称、行业属性和核心概念，提出四条真正不同的视觉设计路线。

最终画面固定为 9:16 竖版。顶部品牌输入区严格占整个画面高度的 30%，底部 Logo 展示区严格占 70%，无论品牌名称长短都不能改变这个比例；名字较长时缩小字号，不扩大顶部区域。底部 70% 再严格划分为 2×2 四个等大区域，只使用非常浅、非常细的虚线分隔，不绘制外围边框。

【顶部品牌区】

顶部只是品牌原始信息的引入区，不是主视觉海报。使用【顶部背景色】，加入极轻微的纸张、和纸、包装纸、丝网印刷颗粒或与品牌相关的低对比暗纹，只增加质感，不形成复杂插画。

顶部只保留三层信息：

BRAND TO LOGO

【品牌名称】

【英文名称】

品牌名称使用正常、清晰、现代的印刷字体，不提前进行 Logo 化、手写化或图形变形。不要加入口号、品牌说明、大量小英文、编号、印章、辅助图标或复杂光影，让视觉重点自然落到下方四个 Logo 方案。

【底部 Logo 展示区】

底部统一使用 Warm Ivory 暖米白纸张背景，只保留轻微天然纸纹。四个 Logo 都需要围绕【品牌类型】【品牌关键词】【核心视觉意象】展开，保持品牌核心一致，但设计方法必须明显不同。

每个 Logo 都应该是一套完整、可以真实用于门店、包装、标签、社交头像、名片或周边商品的品牌标识，而不是完整插画、海报或装饰图。

每个方案控制在 1–3 个主要颜色以内，优先使用【主色建议】。避免高饱和杂色、复杂渐变、3D、金属浮雕、玻璃质感和商业 mockup。

【Mascot｜吉祥物型】

从品牌名称、行业或核心意象中设计一个高度概括的角色或拟人化主体。角色需要拥有清楚的大轮廓和强记忆点，但不要做成复杂动漫人物或完整场景插画。

让角色本身与品牌概念发生关系，例如抱着产品、隐藏在物体后面、与核心植物或动物融合。搭配完整的【品牌名称】字标和较小的【英文名称】，整体亲和、有故事感、适合社交传播。

【Emblem｜意象徽章型】

不依赖完整人物，而是从【核心视觉意象】中提炼 2–3 个最重要的元素，组合成一个集中、平衡、容易缩小识别的品牌徽章。

优先使用负空间、环绕、上下叠合、局部包围或图形共形，让不同元素真正融合成一个标志，而不是简单把几个小图标并排放在一起。搭配品牌字标，形成完整稳定的 Logo 系统。

【Type-led｜字形创意型】

以【品牌名称】本身作为核心设计对象。分析中文字或英文字母中最有视觉潜力的笔画、结构、偏旁、负空间和字母轮廓，让品牌的核心意象从文字内部自然生长出来。

可以进行省笔、共享笔画、延长、切割、局部替换、负空间重构或字形融合，但必须保留基本识别度。

不要在普通字体旁边额外贴一个图标。重点是让“文字本身就是 Logo”，形成更现代、更聪明、更具有专业平面设计感的方案。

【Stamp｜开放式手作印记型】

设计一款具有手刻、版画、店章或包装印记气质的 Logo，但不要使用规整完整的方框，也不要把所有内容塞进封闭椭圆。

使用不完整边界、开放弧线、自然笔触、品牌核心图形或文字共同形成松散的视觉范围。元素可以轻微错位，边缘允许少量自然缺墨和手工印刷不均，让整体具有呼吸感。

Stamp 必须保持清楚的主次关系和充分留白。不要因为追求“印章感”而变得死板、密集或难以实际使用。

四款必须共享同一个品牌世界观、核心意象和基础配色，但不能只是同一个 Logo 换四种画风或四种排版。

不要加入 A/B/C/D 等编号。底部不要添加口号、解释句或多余信息。不要生成包装 mockup、真实门店场景或完整插画。

最终画面要像一张成熟、干净、有方法差异、有真实品牌设计价值的专业 Logo Exploration Sheet。

Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Do not combine multiple photos into a collage. Each photo must be processed and output as a separate poster.

OVERALL FORMAT

Strict 3:4 vertical composition.

Divide the canvas horizontally into two exactly equal sections, with a precise 1:1 height ratio.

The top half occupies exactly 50% of the canvas.

The bottom half occupies exactly 50% of the canvas.

The two sections should feel visually connected as one refined art publication cover.

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible.

Keep the main composition, subjects, identity, facial features, body proportions, poses, expressions, clothing, objects, and spatial relationships unchanged.

Preserve the realistic photographic texture, natural lighting, shadows, atmosphere, and original color mood.

Apply only subtle, sophisticated editorial color grading, creating the feeling of a premium magazine photograph, contemporary art book, or high-end independent publication.

The image should remain photorealistic and authentic, never overly retouched or artificially stylized.

If necessary to fit the 3:4 composition naturally, extend the sky, ground, walls, or surrounding environmental background.

Background extension must feel seamless and photographic.

Never stretch, distort, reshape, replace, or alter the main subject.

BOTTOM HALF — MINIMAL HAND-DRAWN PAPER ILLUSTRATION

Extract the most recognizable visual elements from the original photograph and reinterpret them as a minimalist hand-drawn paper-cover illustration.

Preserve:

The most recognizable subject

Essential silhouette and proportions

Key pose or gesture

Important objects

The core narrative relationship between people and objects

Highly simplify the image. Remove unnecessary details and retain only the visual information needed for immediate recognition.

Use:

Delicate, slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines

A small number of bold, clearly defined acrylic-style flat color shapes

Rough paper texture

Visible handmade brush marks

Slightly irregular, organic edges

Subtle imperfections that make it feel genuinely handmade

The main illustrated subject should be small, centered, and carefully composed, occupying approximately 10–20% of the bottom half.

Leave a large amount of negative space around the illustration.

The background should primarily resemble:

Rough white paper

Warm off-white paper

Pale natural paper

Minimal editorial book-cover stock

Use only a few lines or small color shapes to suggest the surrounding environment.

COLOR PALETTE

Extract the dominant colors directly from the original photograph.

Compress the palette into no more than 4 main colors.

Keep the colors restrained, sophisticated, and harmonious.

Use bold but controlled flat color blocks.

Avoid excessive color variation.

Preserve subtle paper grain and handmade brush texture.

The illustration should visually feel like a simplified color interpretation of the photograph.

TYPOGRAPHY

A small amount of simple typography may be included when appropriate.

Possible elements:

A short title

Keyword

Object name

Location

Year

Number

Short phrase

Text should be minimal, understated, and editorial.

Typography should naturally interact with the large areas of negative space and the small illustration, evoking:

Art book covers

Independent publishing

Contemporary editorial design

Thoughtful children's picture books

Do not force text into the composition if it does not naturally fit the photograph.

VISUAL LANGUAGE

The final poster should feel:

Quiet · Poetic · Refined · Minimal · Innocent · Relaxed · Artistic · Thoughtful · High-recognition · Premium

The visual concept should be:

“A small subject surrounded by a large amount of empty space.”

The result should resemble a carefully designed independent art publication cover, rather than a commercial advertisement.

AVOID

Do not use:

Colored-pencil aesthetics

Crayon textures

Bleeding watercolor

Pure line-art illustration

Complex realistic illustration

Heavy oil-painting effects

Smooth polished digital illustration

3D rendering

Glossy 3D textures

Commercial cartoon aesthetics

Cute commercial character design

E-commerce advertising aesthetics

Generic poster templates

Excessive decorative elements

Busy compositions

Excessive typography

FINAL ART DIRECTION

The top half should feel like a beautiful, authentic editorial photograph.

The bottom half should feel like a small, handmade visual poem derived from that photograph.

The two halves should clearly belong to the same visual story, while maintaining a strong contrast between photographic realism above and minimal handmade illustration below.

Prioritize recognition, restraint, negative space, material texture, subtle imperfection, editorial sophistication, and artistic storytelling over decorative complexity.

Create four large black handwritten signatures for the same name. They must be noticeably different in silhouette, rhythm, stroke direction, abstraction, and personality. Do not simply generate four similar cursive versions.

Letters may merge, stretch, overlap, simplify, share strokes, or become partially abstract. The goal is signature design, not perfect letter-by-letter readability.

FLOW: Create a graceful, fluid signature with smooth connected strokes and one or two long sweeping tails. Keep it elegant, natural, and believable as a real personal signature.

EDGE: Create a sharper, more directional signature using stronger slant, tall vertical accents, pointed turns, crossings, and decisive endings. Make it modern, confident, and fashion-forward.

LOOP: Build the signature around a large expressive looping gesture. Compress parts of the name inside or across the loop, and allow one stroke to extend outward as a strong finishing motion. Keep the loop organic and handwritten rather than geometrically perfect.

MARK: Create the most minimal and abstract version. Reduce the name to approximately 4–6 important strokes, often using the initials or strongest letter shapes as the foundation. The result may resemble a personal monogram or creator mark more than fully readable handwriting.

For softer or more romantic names, MARK may be replaced with CHARM: a refined usable signature with one subtle personal detail, such as a tiny heart-like terminal or a minimal floral gesture. Keep it tasteful and mature.

The four designs must feel clearly different at first glance. FLOW should feel fluid, EDGE sharp, LOOP expressive, and MARK minimal.

Keep each signature large enough to dominate its quadrant. Do not add extra descriptions under the style labels.

Do not add watermarks, numbering, decorative borders, stars, crowns, excessive hearts, unrelated icons, or unnecessary graphic elements.

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European food branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the food and typography as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction should visibly alter the structure, surface, or material behavior of the letterforms through clear and believable physics.

Examples: TWIST, long food elements wrap around, pass in front of and behind, tighten around, and subtly pull selected letter strokes; SNAP, the food fractures along a clear force line and the typography breaks along the same continuous axis with small structural offsets; DRIP, a real liquid or glaze flows over the letters, gradually covering and replacing parts of the geometric type with edible material; PEEL, the surface of a letter is physically removed to reveal a different edible material underneath, with the peeled layer remaining visibly connected and curling away.

Keep the interaction focused on one main physical mechanism, localized deformations should follow real contact, weight, tension, gravity, viscosity, fracture, or material separation, untouched areas of the typography should remain clean, hard, geometric, and readable, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, floating food pieces, or digital-looking distortion.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final image should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and immediately understandable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal how the food has physically changed the typography.

给餐饮品牌做新品海报、电商主图和节日营销素材； 
给房地产项目做区位图、价值点海报和开盘物料； 
给自媒体博主做封面、信息图和系列内容模板；
给企业市场部做品牌宣传、活动物料和社交媒体配图。  

或者，把真正稀缺的东西塞进工作台： 
经过反复测试的提示词； 
成熟的构图和配色方案； 
统一的品牌视觉规范； 
可以直接调用的产品、人物和场景素材库； 
适配小红书、公众号、抖音、电商平台的尺寸与版式； 
从创意拆解、图片/视频生成、局部修改到批量交付的完整流程。  

最好还能记住品牌的字体、色彩、产品卖点、禁用元素和审美偏好，让每次生成都保持统一，而不是一遍遍抽卡。  工作台只是一个壳。 

真正值钱的是里面沉淀的审美、行业经验、品牌资产和稳定交付能力。 
用户愿意付钱，是因为以前做一套视觉物料要找策划、设计、摄影和后期，折腾一周；现在只需要输入一个需求，十分钟就能得到一套风格统一、尺寸齐全、可以继续修改的方案。  

所以，“做出一个工具”会越来越不值钱。 
能把抽象的审美、专业的创意方法和复杂的设计流程，封装成点几下就能获得的结果的稳定流程， 这才值钱！！

MiniMax H3 Max Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese 2D anime action-comedy with synchronized sound. Use the selected output aspect ratio.

STORY
A summons a threatening formation of metal swords and launches them at B. B raises a large red horseshoe magnet. The swords veer toward it and stick together in a noisy pile. End on A, still holding her attack pose, silently stunned by the empty sky.
REFERENCE / ROLE LOCK
A = character reference image 1 + voice reference audio 1. A is the caster, stands screen-left, summons the swords and appears in the final reaction close-up.
B = character reference image 2 + voice reference audio 2. B stands screen-right, holds the magnet and calmly collects the swords.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and art styles. Use references for identity and style only, not poses, backgrounds or reference-sheet layouts.
Keep these roles throughout. Only A casts magic. Only B holds the magnet. Neither character changes identity between shots.

VOICE
Exactly ONE spoken sentence:
A says 「にげばは、ない！」 once at 0.3-2.5s, using voice 1's identity, timbre and natural pitch range with accurate lip sync.
Read the hiragana as written. Finish before 3.0s. Audio references define voices, not scripts; never replay recorded words.
B is completely silent. Voice reference 2 belongs to B but produces no vocals.
After 3.0s, ZERO character voices: no additional dialogue, narration, inner monologue, gasps, grunts, screams, laughter or vocal breaths.
Continue sound effects and instrumental music as specified.
VISUAL STYLE / STAGING
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime: clean linework, cel shading, fluid action and expressive faces.
Exactly two characters in a broad stone courtyard. A screen-left, B screen-right, about eight meters apart. Establish clear empty space between them. Maintain positions and screen direction across cuts.
A's summoned swords occupy the open air above the gap, initially closer to A. Keep them separate and readable against the sky.
PROPS / CONTINUITY
Use EIGHT summoned swords: solid silver metal blades with simple dark hilts. They are physical objects with visible weight and reflections, not beams or flat energy symbols.
The same eight swords remain visible through summoning, flight and collection. No new swords appear after the initial formation.
B uses ONE large, familiar U-shaped horseshoe magnet: red curved body, two silver pole tips, no writing or symbols. About shoulder-width, held securely by its curved base.
The magnet is separate from B's costume and does not emerge from her body. She brings it into view from behind her hip.
Its open ends face screen-left and angle slightly upward toward the approaching swords. Hold it in front of and slightly away from B's torso, below her face.
Only the summoned swords are collected. Reference costume pieces and sheathed accessories remain in place.
Sword blades attach flat against the pole tips and against one another. They form a visible metal bundle OUTSIDE the magnet, never disappearing inside it. Preserve individual hilts and blades rather than morphing them into a solid blob.
No sword strikes either character. Keep B's face and hands unobstructed.
0.0-4.0s — NO ESCAPE
Dramatic low-angle wide shot.
A speaks her single line, raises one hand and summons eight swords in a staggered formation above the courtyard.
Brief violet summoning light fades to reveal real silver blades. Their tips rotate together toward B.
A holds a commanding pose with a confident, closed-mouth smile. B watches calmly.
Use intense instrumental battle music, a magical surge and a clear metallic shimmer. No choir or vocal samples.
4.0-6.5s — THE ORDINARY SOLUTION
Medium shot of B. She reaches behind her hip and brings the large red horseshoe magnet fully into view.
Both hands support its curved base. She presents the open pole tips toward screen-left, below her face.
Pause briefly so the audience recognizes the ordinary magnet. The swords stay in formation until A gives the launch gesture.
Cut back to the original wide view with A, B, all eight swords and the magnet visible.
A sharply extends her casting hand. The swords launch across the open gap toward B.

6.5-9.0s — ALL CONFISCATED
Show the interception in ONE continuous wide shot.
As the swords approach, their trajectories visibly bend toward the magnet's two silver tips, away from B's body.
The swords swivel so their flat metal sides meet the poles. They arrive in rapid, staggered succession over roughly one second.
Use a brisk sequence of distinct metallic clanks, ending with one heavier clatter. Stop the music at the FIRST contact.
All eight swords stick to the magnet, with clear overlap and separate hilts.
Keep their flight fast and purposeful, with short motion trails. No slow floating, teleportation, explosion or cut hiding the capture.
B remains planted and calm, both hands holding the magnet. The sky becomes completely empty of swords.
9.0-12.0s — NOTHING LEFT TO FIRE
Hold a readable two-shot.
B steadies the magnet and its attached sword bundle. A small final metal rattle, then stillness.
A remains screen-left with her attack hand extended. She looks from the empty formation above her to the collected swords beside B.
Her confident smile disappears. Her hand hangs uselessly in the same commanding pose.
B gives A a quiet, neutral look. No triumphant speech or exaggerated grin.
Do not launch, drop or detach any sword.
12.0-15.0s — SILENT DISBELIEF
Cut to a close-up of A, the SAME caster from the opening.
Eyes widen, pupils shrink, eyebrows rise. Her lips part slightly once and remain still.
Hold her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
Use a short controlled push-in. Hold the final full second with faint courtyard ambience only.
End directly on A. No talking mouth, explanation, cut back, second attack or extra gag.
EXCLUSIONS
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD or end card.
No photorealism, 3D-rendered look, chibi redesign, swapped roles, extra characters, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, costume changes, bodily transformation, injury, blood or canned laughter.

prompt：https://promptsref.com/prompt/crouching-woman-under-a-blue-umbrella-compact-camera-grain-079faf83a701251903e7d88415032700

A realistic rainy-day street portrait with the visual language of an early-2000s Japanese independent magazine photograph and a low-resolution compact digital camera. Use a narrow approximately 9:16 vertical frame. A clearly adult young woman is facing the camera while crouching extremely low on rain-soaked asphalt or concrete. Both feet are planted apart, her knees are deeply bent and naturally opened to either side, her center of gravity dropped close to the ground. Her shoulders curl inward slightly, her head is lowered, and one or both hands hold a thin umbrella shaft near the center of her body. The pose should not feel like professional fashion posing; it should look as though she had already been crouching beside the puddle for a while.

She has very dark black, medium-to-long straight hair with dense heavy bangs falling over the upper eye area. The side sections hang beside her cheeks and shoulders. Humid rainy air has made the hair slightly damp, heavy and low-volume, with a few naturally clumped strands. She quietly looks toward the lens from beneath the shadow of her bangs; because her head is lowered, the eyes feel subtly raised toward the camera. Her expression is restrained, unsmiling, slightly tired and detached, carrying the emotional residue of a private pause. Keep the facial details soft and imperfect rather than sharpening them into a standardized commercial beauty face. Makeup follows a muted Japanese street-editorial language: cool fair natural base, subtle dark definition around the eyes or fine eyeliner, and muted berry-red to dark-red lips.

She wears a loose matte-black short-sleeved top or short black one-piece garment, paired with black shorts or another short dark bottom partially hidden beneath the oversized upper layer. No visible logos or bright graphics. The black fabric absorbs most of the available light so the clothing and dark hair merge into one compact shadow-like shape. Add chunky black shoes or short black boots.

Visible skin is limited mainly to the face, a small amount of neck, portions of the forearms and elbows, both knees, and short sections of the legs surrounding the knees. The chest, abdomen, waist, back, shoulders and buttocks remain covered. Skin is fair to light rather than porcelain white, with a subtle cool cast from the cloudy sky and reflected blue umbrella. Preserve faint pores, natural tonal variation and slightly more texture around the knees. The skin should visually suggest something soft and cool to the touch after sitting in humid rainy air, never waxy or aggressively airbrushed.

Above her is a large saturated blue umbrella occupying most of the top of the frame, serving as the strongest color identity in the photograph. Dark umbrella ribs and a thin shaft remain visible. The umbrella blocks part of the overhead skylight, leaving the face and black hair slightly darker while casting only a faint cyan-blue environmental spill onto the hair, face and shoulders.

The most important compositional feature is a broad shallow puddle directly below the subject. A large portion of the lower half of the image is devoted to her full reflection. The real figure occupies the upper half and the reflected figure occupies the lower half, forming an almost vertically mirrored two-part composition. The reflected body, legs, dark clothes and umbrella should broadly align with the real subject, but never look like a perfect Photoshop duplicate. Include subtle water distortion, small ripples, softness, brightness variation and irregular wet-pavement reflections.

Use a natural 35–50mm full-frame-equivalent lens feel without obvious ultra-wide distortion. Place the camera very low, approximately around the knee height of the crouching subject or slightly lower, shooting almost straight ahead with a very mild upward axis. Keep the complete crouching figure in the upper portion of the frame, but do not center everything mathematically. Allow slight framing drift, imperfect edge spacing and casual human composition. Depth of field is moderately shallow: the woman remains recognizable but never razor sharp, while pale gray-white buildings, the road and scattered green vegetation in the distance dissolve into soft blur.

Use only real overcast rainy-day illumination. A thick cloud-covered open sky acts as a broad, cool gray-white, nearly directionless light source. The umbrella blocks part of that top light, while the wet ground gives only extremely weak cool reflected fill from below. No flash, no artificial rim light, no three-point studio lighting.

Image texture should resemble an early consumer compact digital camera, inexpensive point-and-shoot, or low-resolution film scan: mild missed focus, soft atmospheric haze, fine grain, limited dynamic range, slight color cast and gentle underexposure. Allow subtle moisture haze on the lens, uneven ground reflections and softer edges than modern digital photography.

The rain had been heavier only moments ago. She had already been crouching there when she briefly lifted her eyes toward the camera. A second later she might stand and leave, while the other version of her would still tremble softly in the puddle. The final image should feel quiet, cold, damp, slightly melancholic and privately observed—not polished commercial photography.

Negative prompt: studio lighting, hard flash, HDR, ultra sharp, plastic skin, over-retouched skin, sunny weather, dry pavement, missing reflection, perfect digital reflection, fisheye, extreme wide angle, neon rim light, runway pose, anime face, oversaturated colors, clean commercial photography.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【中文姓名】：{例如：林知夏}  
【姓名拼音】：{例如：LIN ZHIXIA}  
【顶部背景色】：{例如：深钴蓝、灰调珊瑚、鼠尾草绿、深酒红}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请将输入的普通中文姓名重新设计成一张完整的「中文个性签名 AI Filter」设计稿。最终画面为 9:16 竖版，上方约占 40%，展示普通印刷姓名；下方约占 60%，展示同一个名字的四种完全不同的艺术手写签名。整体高级、克制、现代、有专业设计提案感，不要像普通字体样张或书法练习纸。

【顶部姓名区】

使用【顶部背景色】作为主色，加入极轻微的纸张或织物质感，并可加入柔和自然的窗影、树影或建筑光影，但不要复杂。顶部中央使用很小、字距宽松的英文“NAME TO SIGNATURE”，中央使用暖象牙白色、规整优雅的中文宋体大字展示【中文姓名】，姓名下方以小字号、宽字距大写英文显示【姓名拼音】。

这里的中文姓名必须保持普通印刷字体，不要手写、连笔或艺术变形，用来明确表现“原始输入”。除此之外不要添加额外标语、解释文案、Logo、编号或装饰图形，保持充分留白，让姓名成为上半部分绝对视觉中心。

【底部签名区】

底部统一使用暖米白色纸张，只保留非常轻微的天然纸纹，不做明显做旧、污渍或强颗粒。使用非常浅、非常细的灰褐色虚线将区域分成 2×2 四格，不需要外边框。每一格只展示一个大尺寸黑色艺术签名，以及下方很小的风格名称：飘逸、锋势、回环、极简。

四个签名全部来源于同一个【中文姓名】，但在结构、方向、节奏、抽象程度、重心和视觉人格上必须有明显差异。不要只是将完整姓名用四种相似连笔方式重新写一遍。允许大胆省笔、合笔、共享笔画、连续连写、拉长、缩写、重构和符号化，不要求每个中文字都完整可辨，重点是从姓名中提炼具有个人识别度的签名结构。

签名使用自然黑色签字笔、钢笔或 gel pen 的真实手写质感，线条带自然笔压变化：起笔较细，主笔略重，转折处有自然压力，快速拖尾逐渐变细，局部允许极轻微断墨。不要生成完全光滑的数字矢量曲线，也不要做成传统毛笔书法。

【飘逸款】

将姓名设计成横向、轻盈、流畅的艺术签名。可以高度压缩中文字形，并让多个字符共享笔画、自然连写，通过一至两条大跨度长线或拖尾把整个姓名连接为完整手势。允许牺牲部分可读性，重点表现流动节奏、速度感和优雅气质。

最终效果应像艺人、设计师或创作者自然签出的成熟个人签名，而不是清楚书写的三个中文字。整体以柔和曲线和连续笔势为主，不要堆叠过多尖角。

【锋势款】

将姓名设计成更加锋利、快速、有力量的签名。大量使用斜线、尖角、高竖笔、快速切线和干脆的收笔，把中文字形高度压缩，只保留几个最有力量的骨架结构。

整体可以明显向右倾斜，形成强烈速度感和现代感。避免大面积柔软圆环，让这款和飘逸款第一眼就形成明显区别，气质偏冷静、果断、有气场。

【回环款】

将姓名设计成以大型回环结构为核心的艺术签名。可以使用开放圆环、自由椭圆、大 S 曲线、丝带式曲线或不规则包围结构，把高度压缩后的姓名笔势自然嵌入回环内部或让其穿过回环，并允许最后一笔突破主体结构形成长收尾。

回环必须具有真人快速书写的自然感，不能像规整几何图形。整体第一眼应更像一个艺术家的个人签名符号，第二眼才感受到它来自原始中文姓名。

【极简款】

这是四种方案中最抽象、最克制的一款。不需要完整写出整个姓名，只从中文字形中提取大约 4–6 个最有识别价值的主笔，例如长横、主竖、折笔、斜线或几个点笔，再重新组合成一个高级、容易记忆的个人视觉标记。

最终效果可以接近 Personal Mark、个人 Logo 或设计师签名。第一眼不要求直接认出完整姓名，但知道原始姓名以后，应能够理解这些笔势与原字结构的关系。保持大量留白，不要添加无关圆圈、箭头、星形或其他装饰符号。

【整体控制】

四款签名必须真正体现不同的人格：飘逸款强调柔长、流动和速度；锋势款强调锐利、力量和斜向结构；回环款强调艺术性、包围关系和图形感；极简款强调省笔、符号化和个人品牌感。

不要让四款只是同一种签名修改尾笔。最终签名既要具有艺术性和明显风格差异，也应保留真实手写感与一定的实际书写可能性。整张画面保持干净、高级、有编辑设计感，不添加 Logo、水印、编号、四角星芒、复杂边框或其他多余装饰元素。

惊呆！Qwen4.5后模型将扩展至5-10T参数！！
不愧是全球开源AI扛把子！！

阿里云栖大会，Qwen真的放了点大招！！
除了全模态音视频模型、TTS、生图模型啥的！
真正的重点，是那些见不到摸不着的东西！

首先是RSI，也就是模型递归自我进化。
Qwen3.8-Max在零人工参与情况下，自己训练自己，连续跑了一个多月，完成33轮有效迭代。
更夸张的是，模型不光自我训练迭代，还延展到推理适配和芯模协同优化设计上！
给一块从没见过的GPU，它可以自主优化框架，完成自适应，推理速度提升96%！
Qwen3.8-Max能够基于一份设计文档，自己展开设计验证，超万次调用EDA，持续优化，把芯片物理面积减少42%！
造数据、改算法、适配芯片、做物理设计，一整个飞轮就这样转起来了！！
怪不得，三天两头就在推新模型！
这个加速度是已经刻在基因上了！！

另外我比较感兴趣的，就是最新的开源生图模型 Qwen-Image-2.1，
视觉生成部分只有7B，这么小参数，能力基本对齐Nano banana2，某些方面可能更强！
文生图、图像精准编辑、人像商品保真，最高十张参考图输入，原生2K，
而且还原生支持带alpha通道的透明图生成，
闭源旗舰有的，它都有！
而且因为参数小，针对性改进了算法，生图是又快又稳！
很明显就是冲着电商、设计这个高频场景来的！！

提示词：

【主题】：____
【主视觉】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【三分方式】：纵向 / 横向 / 2+1 / 错位
【主色】：____
【辅助信息】：____
【比例】：9:16

生成一张 East Asian Editorial Design 风格的文化海报，使用“非均衡三分区构图”。

不要平均把画面切成三块，而是让三个区域分别承担：主视觉、标题文字、辅助信息。主视觉占最大权重，标题形成明显 Typography 大形，较小区域负责时间、材料、地点、数据、图谱或其他与主题真正相关的信息。

三个区域至少产生一处跨区关系，例如主体越界、巨大文字压图、枝条或结构线穿区、局部纹理进入标题区域，让画面有网格但不被网格限制。

使用暖纸底、黑色文字和一个主要强调色；中文采用现代宋体 / 明朝体，英文使用 Serif，小字使用 Grotesk / Monospace。保持中高信息密度，并保留约 20%–30% 有效留白。

加入一层与主题相关的档案内容，如局部放大、剖面图、时间记录、材料信息或图谱，但不要使用随机英文和模板占位文字。

同系列统一纸张、字体与信息系统，每张重新变化三分方向、区域比例、主题色和主视觉类型。

避免：平均三栏、PPT 感、普通满版图片加字、模板换皮、随机小字、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese anime action-comedy with synchronized dialogue and sound. Use the selected aspect ratio.

STORY
A unleashes a spectacular bowling throw. All ten pins jump over her ball and land upright, completely untouched. B then makes an ordinary throw at the SAME pins and scores a strike. End on A’s familiar stunned, uncomprehending face.
REFERENCES
@Image 1 = A, the black-haired heroine.
@Image 2 = B, the white-haired heroine.
Preserve each character’s exact face, hairstyle, costume, accessories, proportions and 2D art style. Use references for identity only, with new poses and scenery. Never mix designs or reproduce reference-sheet layouts.

@Audio 1 = A’s voice, only for A’s assigned sentence.
@Audio 2 = B’s voice, only for B’s assigned sentence.
Preserve their vocal identities and natural pitch ranges. Never replay the words recorded in the reference audio.
STYLE AND LOCATION
Expressive hand-drawn 2D anime heroines with clean linework, crisp cel shading and fluid movement, integrated into a photorealistic bowling alley.
Polished wooden lane, realistic gutters, metal fixtures and colorful overhead lighting. No readable signage or score display.
Exactly two characters, one active lane and one continuous location. No spectators.
A bowls first, then waits on the left side of the approach. B initially waits on the right, then steps into the same release position. Keep their identities and screen direction consistent.
Both balls travel away from the approach toward the pins. Neither character enters the lane.
PROPS AND CONTINUITY — HIGH PRIORITY
Exactly TEN ordinary white bowling pins with two red neck stripes, arranged in the standard triangular formation: rows of 1, 2, 3 and 4.
Pins have no faces, limbs or clothing. Their only supernatural action is ONE synchronized vertical jump during A’s throw.
All ten remain the same size and shape throughout.

A uses one normal-sized teal bowling ball.
B uses one normal-sized purple bowling ball.
A’s ball has a dramatic energy trail but remains a solid, recognizable bowling ball. B’s ball has no magic or energy effects.
Only one ball rolls on the lane at a time.
A’s ball passes beneath the airborne pins without touching them, then enters the rear pit.
All ten pins land upright in their ORIGINAL positions.
B bowls at this same untouched formation. No pin reset, replacement or extra pins between throws.
During B’s throw, the pins stay on the floor until her ball physically strikes them.
DIALOGUE
Exactly TWO spoken sentences:

At 0.1–0.8 seconds, A, using @Audio 1, says in Japanese {いっけー！}
Delivery: a confident, energetic battle shout.
At 6.0–6.7 seconds, B, using @Audio 2, says in Japanese {よいしょ。}
Delivery: casual and relaxed, making an ordinary bowling throw.
Accurate lip synchronization. Only the assigned speaker speaks.
No additional dialogue, narration, gasps, grunts, laughter or vocal reactions.
After 6.7 seconds, both characters remain vocally silent.
TIMELINE

0.0–1.5s — THE ULTIMATE BOWLING THROW
Begin with A already taking the final step of her bowling approach. No slow introduction or extended power-up.
Use a dynamic low three-quarter view showing A, her ball and the long lane ahead. B is visible waiting to the side.
A delivers her assigned sentence and releases the teal ball with one powerful underarm bowling swing.
Clearly show the ball leaving her hand and beginning to roll forward on the wood.
A brilliant teal energy ribbon follows the ball. A broad luminous shockwave sweeps along the lane edges, making the throw look absurdly powerful.
Keep the ball and its forward motion readable. Effects do not damage the lane or conceal the pins.
(Music: energetic instrumental battle music with driving percussion, no vocals.)
<Powerful release whoosh, fast bowling-ball rumble, short energy surge.>

1.5–4.5s — THE PINS DODGE
Cut to a low three-quarter side view near the far end of the lane, showing the ENTIRE ten-pin formation, the approaching ball and the rear pit.
Keep this shot UNINTERRUPTED through the jump, ball passage and landing.
The teal ball approaches rapidly.
Just before contact, ALL TEN pins jump straight upward together, approximately 60 centimeters.
Their spacing and upright orientation remain unchanged, like ten rigid objects making the same hop.
The ball continues rolling along the floor and passes visibly UNDER the entire airborne formation.
Show a clear gap between the ball and the pin bases. No collision.
The ball enters the rear pit.
Only AFTER the ball has completely cleared them do all ten pins descend and land upright in their original triangular positions.
One jump only. A short natural arc, no hovering or repeated bouncing.
Hold the perfectly intact formation briefly so the failed throw is unmistakable.
The energy trail fades without moving the pins.
Stop the battle music when the pins jump.
<Fast rolling ball, synchronized light jumping whoosh, rear-pit thud, ten pins landing with one crisp wooden clack.>
4.5–7.5s — B TAKES A NORMAL TURN
Return to the approach.
A stares down the lane, her throwing arm still extended. Her confident smile has disappeared.
B calmly steps into the same bowling position carrying her purple ball.
She makes one simple, relaxed underarm throw, speaking her assigned sentence during the preparation.
Show the ball leaving her hand and rolling forward along the same lane.
No aura, charge-up, acrobatics or supernatural speed.
A silently turns her eyes toward B’s ordinary throw.

7.5–10.5s — THIS TIME THEY FALL
Use the SAME low pin-area camera angle as the dodge shot.
All ten pins are still upright in the same positions.
B’s purple ball approaches at a normal bowling speed.
The pins do not jump, slide aside or anticipate the ball.
Clearly show the ball physically contacting the front of the formation.
The collision knocks the pins into one another; all TEN fall naturally into the rear pit.
A clean, satisfying strike with ordinary physical impacts.
Do not make the pins fall before contact.
Briefly show the empty pin deck.
<Normal rolling rumble followed by a loud, satisfying bowling-pin crash.>
No announcer, cheering or victory voice.
10.5–12.0s — THE UNFAIR RESULT
Return to the two-shot at the approach.
B makes one small, pleased fist pump, relaxed and satisfied.
A looks from the lane to B, then back toward the lane.
Her expression quietly becomes disbelief. She says nothing.
No confrontation, second throw or extra gag.
12.0–15.0s — A’S USUAL FACE
Cut to a close-up of A.
Use her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression: slightly widened eyes, subtly raised eyebrows and lips slightly parted.
Keep her normal facial proportions. No screaming, crying, exaggerated terror or distorted comedy face.
She makes one tiny sideways glance toward B, then holds the expression.
Use a short, controlled push-in. Hold the final full second.
End directly on A’s silent face with faint room ambience.

VISUAL PRIORITIES
The joke must be clear without dialogue:
spectacular teal throw → ten pins visibly jump over it → untouched pins land → ordinary purple throw → physical strike → A’s usual face.
Keep both balls normal-sized.
Show the first dodge and the second collision clearly from matching camera angles.
Use brief slow motion only at the instant the teal ball passes beneath the airborne pins. Do not stretch either ball’s travel into a prolonged slow roll.
EXCLUDE
Subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD, end cards, extra characters, duplicate bodies, mixed identities, extra limbs or fingers, costume changes, humanoid pins, extra pins, giant balls, floating balls, ball teleportation, pin resets, explosions, building destruction, injury, photorealistic heroines, 3D-rendered characters, chibi redesign, vocal music and canned laughter.

I am testing a few ideas to put on t-shirts. This is one you can try yourself. It's not the complete t-shit prompt but rough idea to see what works.

Prompt: 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 famous philosophers: INPUT: $ SUBJECT // If an image is supplied, treat the visible subject as $ SUBJECT.  // ------------------------------------------------------ // SEMANTIC REDUCTION // ------------------------------------------------------  S = analyze($ SUBJECT)  IDENTITY = {     silhouette     = S.minimum_recognizable_outline,     anchors        = top_3_identity_features(S),     expression     = simplest_readable_expression(S),     appendages     = simplify(S.appendages),     action_logic   = infer_characteristic_or_absurd_action(S) }  complexity_target:     semantic_information ≈ HIGH     drawing_information  ≈ VERY_LOW   // ------------------------------------------------------ // SHAPE COMPRESSION // ------------------------------------------------------  FORM($ SUBJECT) =     blob(silhouette)     + primitive(anchor_1)     + primitive(anchor_2)     + primitive(anchor_3)     + tiny_face_marks;  Rules:  - Convert the main body into ONE dominant flat irregular silhouette. - Remove anatomy that is not necessary for recognition. - Reduce eyes to dots, circles, slits, or deliberately mismatched primitive shapes. - Convert limbs / extensions into awkward sticks, hooks, wedges, loops, or noodles. - Preserve small irregularities rather than perfect geometry. - Slightly wrong proportions are desirable. - Make the subject look like someone understood it perfectly and then drew it in 6 seconds.   // ------------------------------------------------------ // DEADPAN EVENT GENERATOR // ------------------------------------------------------  PROP = infer_unexpected_but_semantically_interesting_prop($ SUBJECT)  interaction =     choose(         holding(PROP),         staring_at(PROP),         balancing(PROP),         wearing(PROP),         accidentally_becoming(PROP),         ignoring(PROP)     )  IMPORTANT: PROP should create a visual joke through contrast, not random clutter.   // ------------------------------------------------------ // PALETTE // ------------------------------------------------------  BASE = black_or_near_black GROUND = warm_white / dirty_white / paper_white  ACCENT_COUNT = 1  ACCENT =     choose_semantically(         red,         orange,         acid_yellow,         cobalt,         toxic_green     )  Use accent ONLY for:     one object     OR one body feature     OR one visual consequence;   // ------------------------------------------------------ // TYPOGRAPHY // ------------------------------------------------------  OPTIONAL_TEXT =     generate_1_to_3_word_deadpan_caption($ SUBJECT, interaction)  Typography:     crude bold uppercase     slightly uneven baseline     hand-cut / cheap screenprint feeling     no polished branding     no explanatory paragraph   // ------------------------------------------------------ // RENDER // ------------------------------------------------------  STYLE:     naive graphic icon     black-paper-cut silhouette     crude editorial cartoon     zine humor     imperfect ink edges     tiny registration errors     huge negative space  BACKGROUND:     nearly empty  COMPOSITION:         [ strange simple subject ]               [tiny prop]               CAPTION?  Mood:     confusing for 0.5 seconds     then immediately funny.  AVOID:     polished vector mascot     detailed illustration     realistic anatomy     gradients     glossy 3D     multiple accent colors     decorative background     kawaii overload  OUTPUT: A brutally simplified, oddly charming graphic interpretation of $ SUBJECT — recognizable through silhouette and 2–3 semantic cues, with one unexpected action or object creating deadpan visual humor.
