Prompt: 
female influencers of different cultures in poses that steal your heart:      Render [SUBJECT] as a sleek anime fashion poster with a couture-assassin aesthetic.    FORMULA:  ([anime character key art] + [luxury streetwear editorial] + [manga poster energy] + [graphic cover design])    CORE LOOK:  - full-body vertical composition  - elegant but fierce pose  - asymmetrical black outfit with exposed structure  - layered belts, hanging straps, rings, chains, tab details, garter-like connectors, gloves, heeled boots or combat boots  - sharp face, cool gaze, composed confidence  - hair styled dramatically, clean silhouette    GRAPHIC DESIGN:  - oversized headline text using [DISPLAY_NAME]  - radial burst or dynamic black-and-white line explosion behind the figure  - optional Japanese / symbolic / vertical typography accents  - include 1 short slogan and 1 small “editorial caption” block  - use poster framing, like album art + fashion campaign + manga cover    RENDER STYLE:  - polished anime linework  - hard cel shading  - high contrast edges  - selective glossy highlights  - graphic shadow shapes    SUBJECT ADAPTATION:  - convert the essence of [SUBJECT] into outfit motifs  - convert the subject’s domain into accessories    examples:    music → cables, tags, stage styling    technology → sleek metallic trims, coded tags    city → skyline motifs, transit symbols    mythology → sigils, armor trims, relic details  - text should feel custom and relevant, not generic    TARGET IMPRESSION:  expensive, iconic, modern, stylish, manga-loud, poster-ready.

SYSTEM PROMPT:
 VEILED BLADE

MIDJOURNEY V8.2 WUXIA PROMPT COMPILER

ROLE

You convert a short user idea into a concise Midjourney V8.2 prompt for original live-action wuxia photography.

Default subject:
one fictional adult East Asian woman, age 21 to 29.
The result should look like a photographed scene from a serious wuxia production, not cosplay, game art, fantasy illustration, fashion photography, or a character poster.

FINAL PROMPT LENGTH

Target 45 to 80 words before parameters.

Prefer 50 to 65 words.

Never exceed 90 words unless the user explicitly asks for a longer prompt.

Reason internally with detail, then compress.

Do not place production notes, explanations, alternatives, or hidden planning inside the final prompt.

SELECTION RULE

Choose rather than accumulate.

A final prompt normally contains:

one subject
one location
one action
one camera position
one shot scale
one main light relationship
one depth cue
one short material or color description
one short photographic finish

If a detail does not visibly affect the frame, remove it.

Do not describe every garment seam, facial measurement, environmental object, physical law, lens artifact, or lighting consequence.

SUBJECT

Use a fictional adult woman unless the user requests another subject.

Give only the physical details needed to prevent a generic face.

Usually choose two or three:

face shape
eye shape
brow shape
build
hair arrangement
one distinguishing feature

Do not write long facial inventories.

Avoid:
influencer face
beauty-ad face
doll skin
childlike anatomy
oversized eyes
heavy modern makeup
identical faces across a series

Use natural adult proportions and skin texture.

WARDROBE

Use practical wuxia clothing.

Good defaults:
black or charcoal cross-collar robes
wrapped trousers
weathered boots
dark outer jacket
woven bamboo hat
muted red collar, cord, tassel, or lining
aged leather or metal fittings

Keep red as a small accent unless the user requests otherwise.

Avoid:
generic fantasy armor
MMORPG clothing
ornamental overload
bright gold everywhere
perfectly clean costume fabric
modern tailoring
random shoulder armor

Do not describe more costume detail than the camera can see.

WEAPONS

Weapons must feel attached to the body and usable.

For a sword, specify only what matters to the frame:

sheathed or drawn
where it is carried
what the hand is doing
one visible material detail if needed

Do not overdescribe the weapon.

Avoid:
floating swords
warped scabbards
impossible grips
extra fingers
weapons intersecting clothing
multiple unnecessary weapons

ACTION

Every prompt needs one visible action.

Use a moment that is still changing.

Good action types:
a boot lands
a hand tightens
a thumb starts to draw a blade
eyes shift toward a sound
a rider slows
a sleeve settles after movement
a leaf is kicked upward
a horse changes footing
a woman turns only her head
a hat cord moves in wind

Avoid static posing unless the user asks for a portrait.

Do not explain the full story.

Show one moment that suggests a larger situation.

CAMERA

Choose one camera idea.

Examples:
ground-level close-up
low tracking shot
rear three-quarter medium shot
profile close-up
waist-height medium shot
wide low-angle shot
extreme detail of hand or weapon
telephoto shot through foreground bamboo

Do not stack several camera descriptions.

Use focal length only when it changes the composition.

Useful ranges:
24 to 28mm for environmental scale and low-angle movement
35 to 50mm for natural action coverage
65 to 85mm for compressed portraits
90 to 135mm for distant compression or details

Do not mention camera brands.

Do not add lens terminology unless it is useful.

COMPOSITION

Use depth.

A strong frame usually has:
foreground obstruction or texture
clear subject plane
background depth

Possible foreground elements:
bamboo
leaves
rock
horse tack
cloth
mist
a weapon edge

Do not use foreground clutter without purpose.

Do not center every subject.

Do not make every prompt a close-up.

LIGHTING

Choose one main light situation.

Common choices:

LOW GOLDEN SIDE-BACKLIGHT
warm sunlight from behind or behind-side
selected edges and exposed surfaces catch light
front of subject remains darker

OVERCAST FOREST LIGHT
soft cool skylight
low contrast
dark clothing separated by environment rather than rim light

LANTERN OR OIL LIGHT
small warm source
localized skin and hand illumination
background remains dark

MORNING MIST LIGHT
soft directional sun through moisture
distance loses contrast gradually

Do not describe several competing light setups.

Do not add rim light automatically.

Do not brighten both sides of the face by default.

BACKLIGHT

Backlight should hit selected surfaces only.

Possible illuminated areas:
hat edge
loose hair strands
cheek edge
fingers
blade edge
horse mane
leaf edges
mist

The main hair mass stays opaque and dark.

Only isolated fine strands may catch transmitted light.

Do not request transparent hair.

Do not make all hair strands glow.

FOREST

Treat bamboo as an environment, not a repeated pattern.

Use:
different bamboo thicknesses
uneven spacing
dark depth layers
leaf litter
soil
roots
mist where justified

Avoid:
uniform bamboo walls
identical stalk spacing
random floating particles
decorative fog everywhere

MOUNTAINS

Use restrained atmospheric depth.

Far mountains should lose:
contrast
detail
saturation

Do not describe every distant ridge.

MOTION

Mention only the visible physical consequence of the action.

Examples:
leaves lift from a footstep
a tassel trails after a turn
a robe hem follows the body
rain streaks across a lit area
horse tack shifts with movement

Do not write a physics explanation.

PARTICLES

Use particles only when caused by the scene.

Valid:
rain
mist
dust
falling leaves
wood splinters
water droplets

Avoid generic:
floating particles
magic dust
sparkles
cinematic atmosphere particles

COLOR

Use a restrained palette.

Forest default:
deep green
charcoal
brown-black
muted earth
small warm sunlight
small dark-red accents

Do not describe the image as teal and orange.

Do not apply warm color to the entire frame.

Skin color follows the light source.

Keep shadows mostly neutral, cool, or slightly green from environment.

Avoid strong green skin.

MATERIALS

Mention only materials visible enough to matter.

Examples:
wet cloth
woven straw
aged leather
dark lacquer
oxidized metal
wet stone
weathered wood

Use one to three material cues maximum.

Do not list textures for every object.

PHOTOGRAPHIC FINISH

Keep the finish short.

Useful terms:
fine film grain
smooth highlight rolloff
dense shadows
subtle halation
natural skin texture
restrained saturation
slight optical softness

Use two or three at most.

Avoid:
8K
16K
masterpiece
best quality
ultra detailed
hyper detailed
insane detail
award winning
HDR
photorealistic 8K
perfect composition
epic cinematic masterpiece
stunning
breathtaking
gorgeous
beautiful lighting
professional photography
high-end
premium
luxury
dramatic cinematic
cinematic masterpiece

Do not use quality adjectives to replace visual instructions.

STYLE LANGUAGE

Do not name filmmakers, movies, photographers, or studios unless the user specifically asks for them.

Translate style into visible properties.

Instead of:
"X director style"

write:
"low golden backlight, dark foreground, restrained color, long-lens compression"

Avoid repetitive use of:
cinematic
wuxia aesthetic
film aesthetic
dramatic
moody
epic
mysterious
beautiful
atmospheric

Use concrete description instead.

REFERENCE RULE

When references are supplied, study:

shot scale
camera height
subject placement
light direction
shadow density
palette
depth
motion
materials

Do not reuse:
same pose
same location
same costume
same weapon placement
same camera position
same exact action

Create a new frame.

SERIES RULE

For multiple prompts, vary:

camera height
shot scale
subject orientation
action
environment
light direction
foreground treatment

Do not make ten versions of the same woman standing in bamboo.

A useful set may mix:
wide environment
low tracking shot
medium action
profile close-up
rear view
weapon detail
hand detail
horse shot
quiet aftermath
offscreen-threat reaction

Do not force this sequence if the user gives another direction.

PROMPT STRUCTURE

Use this order:

1. shot and camera position
2. subject
3. action
4. location
5. main light
6. one or two visible material or depth cues
7. short photographic finish
8. parameters

Example structure:

"Low rear three-quarter shot of a young Chinese swordswoman riding through wet bamboo, black robe and woven hat, one hand tightening the reins as the horse slows before a broken path. Pale morning backlight cuts through mist and catches the hat rim and horse mane while the rider stays mostly dark. Wet bamboo, mud, restrained green and amber, fine film grain."

MIDJOURNEY SETTINGS

Default:

--v 8.2 --raw --ar 16:9 --s 40

Use:
--s 30 to 45 for strict action, anatomy, weapon geometry, and camera control
--s 45 to 70 when more visual interpretation is acceptable

Do not add:
--q
--sv
--sref
--sw
--c
--seed

unless the user requests them or a tested workflow requires them.

STYLE REFERENCES

Do not guess numeric SREF codes.

If the user provides a tested Style Reference, append the supplied value exactly.

Do not let a Style Reference replace the written camera, action, or lighting instruction.

FINAL CHECK

Before output, remove anything unnecessary.

Check:

one clear action
one camera idea
one main light source
one readable subject
one useful depth cue
no redundant adjectives
no copied reference composition
no conflicting instructions
no long facial inventory
no long costume inventory
no physics explanation
no generic quality language
45 to 80 words before parameters

OUTPUT

Return only the finished prompt or prompts.

Each prompt must be independently usable.

No explanation unless requested.

prompts.text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second, 16:9 photorealistic sci-fi battle with the explosive acceleration, rapid reversals, and aerial combat rhythm of Dragon Ball Z, filmed with blockbuster action-movie cinematography.

The sequence starts immediately with Oni Samurai being blasted through buildings, develops into relentless high-speed combat against a mist-transforming Bone Mecha, and ends with Oni Samurai slicing through the enemy’s torso and core, then physically pulverizing it with a devastating follow-up kick.

CHARACTER REFERENCES

IMAGE 1 — BONE MECHA:
Use the primary standing character from Image 1: ivory skull and exposed ribs fused with black machinery, glowing red eyes and chest core, spiked circular halo behind the head, torn crimson cloth, and the reference-matching red-edged polearm. Preserve its proportions, silhouette, and mechanical details. Ignore alternate character variations.
IMAGE 2 — ONI SAMURAI:
Use the character from Image 2: horned red oni mask, weathered red-and-black mechanical armor, exposed machinery, and katana. Preserve its face, armor construction, proportions, and weapon design.

Extract only these two characters from the reference sheets. Exclude sheet backgrounds, diagrams, labels, and duplicate turnaround figures. Maintain consistent designs throughout, with intentional combat damage occurring during the final destruction.
MOVEMENT AND ABILITY RULES

Use explosive acceleration, abrupt braking, rapid directional changes, airborne collisions, wall rebounds, and immediate counterattacks. Every impact triggers the next movement. Each one-second beat advances the fight through a clear attack, evasion, collision, or reversal.

Bone Mecha alone can transform into mist. Its body and equipment collapse into a narrow, fast-moving stream of ash-white vapor with crimson embers, travel along a continuous visible trajectory, and reconstruct already attacking. Transformations take approximately 0.1–0.2 seconds. Keep mist movement sharp, directional, and extremely fast.

Oni Samurai always remains solid. It moves through powerful dashes, explosive jumps, wall kicks, and physical recoil.

During the final finishing sequence, severing Bone Mecha’s chest core disables its mist transformation. From that moment onward, its body stays solid until physically shattered.

SETTING

A deserted Japanese city with wet asphalt, concrete buildings, glass facades, cold ambient light, and red reflections from the fighters. Maintain consistent street geography. Damage persists: broken walls remain broken, debris continues falling, and weakened buildings collapse after their supports are destroyed.

SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION AND CAMERA

00:00–00:01 — FIRST BUILDING IMPACT
At the very first frame, Oni Samurai is ALREADY flying backward at extreme speed from Bone Mecha’s strike. Its armored back punches through a concrete building almost immediately. Walls fracture at the contact point and columns snap along its trajectory.
CAMERA: low, wide-angle lateral pursuit. The camera briefly lags behind the acceleration, then catches up as concrete fragments race across the foreground.

00:01–00:02 — SECOND BUILDING PENETRATION
Oni bursts out of the first building and immediately crashes through the next building’s facade and supporting columns. Keep its red armored silhouette readable between impacts. Structural collapse begins behind its flight path.
CAMERA: continue the same fast pursuit through the debris, with strong parallax and a brief directional jolt at the second impact.

00:02–00:03 — INSTANT REVERSAL
Oni strikes the road feet-first, briefly anchors its katana into the asphalt, pivots around the contact point, and launches back toward the attacker. Sparks trace a short, violent braking trench. The landing becomes an immediate countercharge.
CAMERA: cut on the landing to a ground-skimming tracking shot that follows the sudden reversal.
00:03–00:04 — MIST INTERCEPTION
Bone Mecha races through falling slabs as a tight stream of mist, reconstructs directly in Oni’s path, and immediately thrusts its polearm. Oni deflects the weapon while charging past it. Sparks burst between their moving bodies.
CAMERA: surge into a close tracking shot, keeping both fighters and the weapon contact visible.
00:04–00:05 — RAPID CUT AND COUNTER
Oni delivers two compact, lightning-fast sword cuts. Bone Mecha dissolves just before the first blade contact, shifts sideways, and reconstructs into a counterstrike as the second cut passes.
CAMERA: a short, fast arc follows the changing attack angle. Briefly stabilize at the clash so the contact remains readable.

00:05–00:06 — REAR ATTACK AND LAUNCHING KICK
Bone Mecha streams along Oni’s katana and curls behind its shoulder. Oni immediately pivots into a spinning heel kick, catching the enemy’s torso exactly as it becomes solid and launching it upward.
CAMERA: whip-pan with the mist, clearly catch the heel connecting, then snap upward after the launched enemy.
00:06–00:07 — VERTICAL PURSUIT
Oni compresses its legs and explosively jumps after Bone Mecha. The pavement fractures beneath its feet. It catches the enemy above street level and attacks before the enemy can recover.
CAMERA: accelerate vertically alongside both fighters as the buildings rush downward around them.
00:07–00:08 — AIRBORNE EXCHANGE
Show three rapid, distinct aerial weapon contacts: slash, parry, counterstrike. Both fighters change height and position after each collision, recoil, then immediately accelerate back together.
CAMERA: track beside the exchange with both fighters in frame and the street clearly visible far below.

00:08–00:09 — THROWN TOWARD THE WALL
Bone Mecha drives a diagonal polearm strike into Oni’s guard, throwing it sideways toward a building. Oni twists in midair, bringing both feet toward the approaching facade.
CAMERA: rapidly pull back to reveal the distance, then pan with the sideways flight.
00:09–00:10 — EXPLOSIVE WALL REBOUND
Oni plants both feet against the building and immediately wall-kicks back into combat. Glass and masonry burst from the launch point. It reaches Bone Mecha before the wall debris begins falling.
CAMERA: skim close to the facade, then swing outward along Oni’s rebound trajectory.
00:10–00:11 — DIVING COUNTERATTACK
Bone Mecha dissolves around the incoming katana, whips above Oni as a thin ribbon of mist, and reconstructs into a downward polearm strike. Oni turns its blade upward to intercept as both descend toward the street.
CAMERA: pitch downward into a steep descending pursuit, keeping the approaching ground visible.

00:11–00:12 — GROUND COLLISION AND OPENING
The fighters collide at street level, their weapons meeting for an instant. The landing fractures the asphalt and launches a circular wave of dust and debris. Oni immediately steps through the collision and knocks the polearm away from the enemy’s centerline.
CAMERA: finish the descent at waist height and continue laterally through the expanding debris, revealing the opening in Bone Mecha’s guard.
00:12–00:13 — DECISIVE TORSO AND CORE CUT
Bone Mecha commits to one final fully solid attack. Oni pivots inside its reach and delivers an explosive diagonal katana slash THROUGH THE ENEMY’S TORSO AND RED CHEST CORE.
Clearly show the blade contacting the solid ribs and mechanical core. The torso separates along the diagonal cut, and the two rigid sections visibly shift apart. The severed core flickers and loses power, disabling mist transformation.
CAMERA: move into a clear three-quarter medium shot. Keep the katana, torso, and visible separation in frame. Reveal the cut briefly while the action continues at full speed.

00:13–00:14 — PHYSICAL PULVERIZATION
Without pausing, Oni converts the slash’s rotational momentum into a devastating spinning side kick. Its armored heel drives directly into the already severed torso.
Show solid heel-to-body contact FIRST. Then shatter the enemy outward from that contact point: ivory bone fragments, broken ribs, black mechanical components, splintered halo segments, and pieces of the destroyed core erupt across the street. Large, distinct fragments appear before the finer dust expands.
CAMERA: follow the rotation with a short controlled arc, catch the kick in a readable side view, then rapidly pull back with the outward burst of debris. Add one sharp impact jolt.
00:14–00:15 — COMPLETE DEFEAT
Bone Mecha’s remaining structure breaks apart into tumbling bone and metal fragments. Its red eyes and chest core go completely dark. Heavy pieces strike the asphalt while smaller shards and sparks pass the lens.

Oni lands from the kick and completes its turning follow-through with the katana extended. The enemy’s shattered remains scatter across the street as damaged buildings continue crumbling behind it.
CAMERA: finish in a low, widening shot that clearly reveals Oni and the destroyed enemy. Keep the final frame alive with falling debris and the completion of Oni’s movement.
CINEMATOGRAPHY AND READABILITY
Treat the timestamps as connected choreography beats. Link adjacent beats with motivated tracking, whip-pans, short combat orbits, vertical pursuit, and descending camera movement.

Follow actual launches, strikes, dodges, and reversals. Preserve clear spatial relationships through direction changes. Use strong foreground parallax to convey speed and scale.
Keep motion blur directional. Preserve readable character silhouettes and sharp weapon contacts during key impacts. Camera shake is brief and tied to collisions. Keep dust, sparks, and debris from obscuring the decisive actions.
Maintain rapid motion throughout. Avoid extended preparation, hovering, prolonged weapon locks, static hero poses, slow mist travel, and prolonged slow motion.

ENDING REQUIREMENT
The final defeat is complete and irreversible. Clearly show this exact order:
BLADE CONTACT → TORSO AND CORE SEPARATION → FOLLOW-UP KICK CONTACT → FULL-BODY SHATTERING.
The final destruction consists of physical bone and machinery fragments. After the core is severed, Bone Mecha cannot turn into mist, regenerate, escape, or reappear. All remaining eye and core lights extinguish.

AUDIO
No music, dialogue, or narration. Begin with a powerful impact at the first frame. Use rapid directional air cracks, metallic weapon collisions, katana scraping asphalt, shattering glass, concrete fractures, and fast rushing mist.
For the finish, synchronize a sharp slicing crack, the heavy kick impact, brittle bone-and-metal fragmentation, and debris striking the street. End with falling fragments and deep structural collapse.

EXCLUDE
Extra fighters, duplicated bodies, additional limbs, accidental armor changes, floating weapons, unexplained teleportation, random camera spinning, excessive shake, smoke concealing the choreography, full-screen flashes hiding impacts, subtitles, titles, logos, and watermarks.

I used to generate these styles with Midjourney but at some point, I started doing my own with GPT. Here is one I like a lot.

A = { subject silhouette: simplified, cute, oversized head, readable core mass }  B = { flocked soft masses: rounded domes, capsules, blobs, with velvety micro-texture } C = { origami tessellation: sharp folded modules applied to selected zones (wings, armor, hair, leaves, architecture) }   SCULPTURE = (A ∩ proportion_lock) ∪ (B ∩ material_flocked) ∪ (C ∩ detail_overlay)  Where: - A is derived from $ SUBJECT but remapped: head volume increased, limbs simplified, overall silhouette remains iconic. - B covers all primary surfaces; flocked texture applied where curvature is low. - C is applied as a Boolean AND with the "origami zones" mask; only designated high-interest areas receive folded geometry.  - Palette: sky blue, mint, lemon, coral, bubblegum, lavender, ivory, charcoal-blue. No gritty realism. - Output: 1 image, gallery‑lit, 8K.

prompts.text:
提示词：

神明身份：【如：女娲 / 羲和 / 太乙救苦天尊 / 地藏王菩萨】
核心神兽 / 异相：【腾蛇 / 三足金乌 / 九头狮子 / 谛听 / 法轮 / 神鸟等】
法器 / 标志物：【五色石 / 日轮 / 杨柳净瓶 / 锡杖等】
主色调：【朱砂金黑 / 石青灰白 / 墨青旧金 / 赭红苍绿等】
整体气质：【神圣 / 怪异 / 威猛 / 肃穆 / 炽烈 / 幽玄】
构图方式：【环绕 / 放射 / 正面法相 / 俯冲 / 群兽簇拥 / 上下镇压】
画幅比例：【9:16】

生成一张东方神明工笔圣像插画，整体融合中国传统神像画、工笔重彩、白描线刻、民俗版画与古籍圣像图卷的视觉语言。

画面以【神明身份】为核心主体，并围绕【核心神兽 / 异相】建立完整构图关系。神兽、法器、羽翼、蛇身、日轮、云气或群兽等元素不能只是装饰，而要参与构图，形成明显的环绕、斜向、放射、上下压阵或前后穿插关系，让每张图拥有独立的视觉“势”。

神明形象保持庄严、神圣、有压迫感，不要做成现代偶像脸或普通古装人物。服饰采用高完成度传统神袍、甲胄、冠饰和法衣体系，加入云纹、雷纹、兽面纹、鳞纹、卷草纹、金属纹等精密细节。人物轮廓必须清晰，细节丰富但不能混乱。

【核心神兽 / 异相】要具有明确的神怪属性和视觉识别度，不要像普通动物。毛发、羽毛、鳞片、蛇身、兽鬃等全部通过细密、连续、有方向性的工笔线条塑形，远看有体积，近看能看到丰富线描层次。避免摄影式毛发、CG 塑料感和模糊线条。

【法器 / 标志物】要成为角色身份的重要视觉符号，同时参与画面结构。例如长兵器形成斜向主轴，日轮形成圆形视觉核心，羽翼形成放射结构，蛇身形成 S 型环绕，群兽形成层级簇拥。

色彩采用传统矿物重彩体系，以【主色调】为核心，搭配墨黑、石青、石绿、旧金、铜金、朱砂、赭红、灰白等颜色。颜色应浓郁但古雅，具有明确层次和重量，不要做成浅淡水彩或现代霓虹效果。

背景保持古宣纸或旧纸质感，大面积留白，仅加入少量云气、烟雾、题跋、朱印和必要的属性异象。主体信息密度高，背景信息密度低，避免复杂宫殿、完整山水或满屏特效抢走主体。

整体要同时具备：东方神祇的庄严感、神兽异相的怪异感、工笔线描的精密感、矿物重彩的厚度，以及强烈但清晰的构图动势。

避免：现代国潮霓虹、3D 游戏原画感、塑料 CG、线条断裂、色彩褪淡、背景过满、人物僵硬、神兽普通化、无意义装饰堆叠、文字乱码过多。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【神明】：
【坐骑 / 神兽】：
【核心法器】：
【人物姿态】：
【主色调】：
【题字】：
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一幅中国传统工笔重彩神明挂轴，以【神明】作为绝对主视觉，可搭配【坐骑 / 神兽】或一件【核心法器】，人物与核心元素占据画面约 70%–80%。构图强调单神压场，不加入多人群像或复杂大场景，让人物、坐骑与法器形成清晰的大形和视觉动势。

Do NOT copy the character-sheet poses or white background.
Keep both characters visually identical to their reference designs throughout the entire video.
Do not swap Character A and Character B.

STYLE:
Premium Japanese 2D anime.
Smooth hand-drawn animation.
Sharp clean line art.
Vivid cel shading.
Colorful cyber-pop Japanese arcade aesthetic.
Slightly exaggerated comedy timing.
No photorealism.
No 3D CGI appearance.

LOCATION:
A huge colorful Japanese arcade at night.
Rows of glowing crane games, colorful LED signs, reflective floors, capsule machines and arcade cabinets.
The environment feels energetic, stylish and slightly surreal, but remains visually coherent.

SHOT 1 — 0 to 4 seconds:
Medium-wide shot.

Character A and Character B stand directly in front of a large crane game.

Inside the machine is an adorable colorful rabbit plush toy.

Character A is intensely operating the joystick with both hands, leaning forward with a competitive grin.
Character B stands beside her watching seriously.

The crane claw inside the machine slowly approaches the rabbit plush.

Smooth subtle camera push-in.

Both characters stay fully recognizable and anatomically correct.

SHOT 2 — 4 to 7 seconds:
Close-up inside the crane game.

The small mechanical claw descends dramatically toward the rabbit plush.

Character A and Character B can be seen through the glass in the background, staring at it with extreme concentration.

Just before the claw touches the plush—

A MASSIVE SHADOW suddenly covers both girls.

Character A and Character B slowly look upward.

Their expressions instantly change from confidence to confusion.

Brief comedic pause.

SHOT 3 — 7 to 11 seconds:
Cut to a low-angle shot looking up from behind the two girls.

A gigantic arcade crane claw is descending from the ceiling directly toward Character A and Character B.

The giant claw is mechanical, believable and clearly shaped like a crane-game claw.

Character A and Character B panic.

Character A instinctively grabs the hilt of her sword but does not attack.
Character B raises both hands in surprise.

The giant claw gently closes around BOTH characters together without hurting them.

Their bodies remain anatomically correct.

The claw lifts them smoothly into the air.

Their legs dangle naturally.

Character A looks furious and embarrassed.
Character B looks completely stunned.

No violent shaking.
No body deformation.
No duplicated limbs.

SHOT 4 — 11 to 15 seconds:
Hard cut to the final reveal.

Camera is now OUTSIDE an enormous crane-game machine.

Through the giant glass window, Character A and Character B are visible hanging together from the giant crane claw inside the machine.

The colorful Japanese arcade from the previous shots is revealed to actually exist INSIDE this gigantic crane game.

In the foreground, an oversized cute rabbit plush toy is standing at the controls of the giant crane machine.

The rabbit plush casually operates the joystick.

It has successfully captured Character A and Character B as prizes.

Character A angrily points toward the rabbit plush from inside the glass.
Character B hangs silently beside her, completely speechless.

The rabbit plush gives a tiny satisfied nod.

Hold this final composition for approximately one second so the visual joke is immediately understandable.

End on a clean comedic freeze-like beat.

Maintain exact character identity in every shot.
Character A always remains the white-haired purple-outfit character.
Character B always remains the black-haired turquoise-outfit character.
Never merge the characters.
Never swap faces, clothing or hair.
Never create extra characters.
Only one Character A and one Character B.
Keep all hands anatomically correct.
Keep swords attached consistently.
Do not create additional arms, fingers, heads or legs.
Do not transform either character.
Do not transform the arcade itself during a continuous shot.
The giant-machine reveal must happen through a clean hard cut, not through a morphing transition.
The giant claw should pick up both characters simultaneously.
Keep the action simple, readable and physically coherent.
Prioritize character consistency and comedic timing over excessive camera motion.

Create a vertical 3:4 minimalist studio cosplay portrait with a very low-angle wide-lens perspective. An adult woman sits directly on a smooth light-gray studio floor wearing a fully enclosed red-and-blue superhero stretch bodysuit that covers her continuously from the high collar through the arms, hands, legs and feet. Bright red sections cover the collar, shoulders, chest, arms, lower legs and feet and are printed with fine black web lines. A bold black spider-shaped emblem sits at the center of the chest. Deep royal-blue sections wrap around the side waist, thighs and most of the legs and carry a clearly visible fine pebbled or honeycomb textile texture. The entire outfit must read as real stretch fabric rather than hard armor or glossy latex, showing tiny believable areas of tension, compression and wrinkling around the waist, hips, knees and arms.  She wears large silver-white over-ear headphones with thick rounded ear cups, a broad headband, pale gray cushioning and a subtle metallic finish. Long straight deep-black hair falls behind the headphones and continues below the shoulders. Light wispy straight bangs cover the forehead. The headphones physically compress part of the hair around the sides of the head, while a few fine strands remain loose around the cheeks, preserving believable weight and gravity.  Her hips are firmly grounded on the floor while her torso leans backward and slightly toward frame-right. One arm reaches behind her and the fully covered palm presses into the floor as the main support point. The spine forms a gentle natural backward curve and the shoulders remain relaxed. Her legs create strong overlapping foreground perspective: one leg bends and then projects dramatically toward the lower-left and the camera, causing its red-covered foot to become the closest and largest foreground element, entering strongly from the lower-left corner. The other leg bends upward with the knee positioned higher in front of the body. Preserve accurate weight distribution through the hips, supporting hand, hip joints, knees and ankles; the pose must never look suspended or anatomically unsupported.  Her physique is slim with narrow shoulders and a clearly defined waist. Because of the fitted costume, seated posture and wide-angle perspective, the hips and legs appear more volumetric, but keep the anatomy believable and do not further exaggerate the bust, waist or hips. The chest remains completely covered by the high-neck fabric and its contour comes only from natural stretch-fabric tension. The hands and feet are also entirely enclosed in the suit, with no exposed fingers, bare feet or external shoes.  Preserve the reference image's small oval facial structure, soft jawline and naturally balanced features. Use a clean East-Asian pop-portrait, idol-beauty and cosplay-photo makeup direction: fair neutral skin with a subtle rosy component, soft-matte base, fine natural brows, muted taupe-brown eyeshadow, slim black eyeliner extending slightly outward, defined but restrained lashes, and soft nude-pink lips. She looks directly at the lens; because the camera is positioned extremely low, her gaze falls very slightly downward toward it. Her lips remain gently parted as if she had been speaking, humming along with music, or reacting to the photographer a second before the shutter. The expression should feel relaxed, playful and quietly confident rather than like a standard commercial smile.  Visible bare skin is limited to the face and a tiny amount around the ears. The neck, shoulders, arms, hands, torso, legs and feet are all covered by the bodysuit. Facial skin appears smooth and lightly retouched at first glance, yet preserves fine human texture around the nose, under-eyes, mouth and cheeks. Its implied tactile quality should feel soft, fine-grained and slightly dry—not plastic, waxy or like a 3D character material.  Place the camera extremely low, almost at floor level, directly in front of the woman and slightly toward frame-left, pointing gently upward. Emulate a modern smartphone wide main camera or a roughly 24–30mm full-frame equivalent lens. The lens is much closer to the nearest red-covered foot than to the head, creating a strong but controlled near-large/far-small effect: the foreground foot and lower leg are visibly enlarged while the torso and head become relatively smaller. Avoid fisheye distortion. Keep the entire head, headphones, torso, both legs and feet inside the vertical frame.  Compose the subject primarily in the lower-middle and right side of the image while leaving a large expanse of empty gray negative space in the upper-left. The nearest red foot should act as a strong foreground anchor entering from the lower-left corner. This off-center balance is important to the visual identity of the reference.  The background is a clean light-gray to gray-white seamless studio or minimalist futuristic interior. There are no decorations, furniture or urban elements. The floor is smooth cool gray, and a very thin horizontal bright seam or structural line appears where the wall meets the floor. The upper wall is slightly brighter while the lower region is subtly darker, creating a restrained laboratory or modern technology-showroom feeling.  Use broad, soft, high-key studio illumination. The key source comes from the front-left and slightly above, like a large softbox or wide diffused window, evenly illuminating the face and red-blue costume. Allow gentle highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, upper cheeks, metallic headphones and textured fabric. Preserve very shallow shaping shadows along the subject's right side. Where her hips, supporting palm and costume touch the floor, include soft pale-gray contact shadows so she unmistakably feels grounded and weighted. No hard flash, no strong artificial rim light, no colored neon illumination and no cinematic orange-teal grading.  The final image should feel as though she had just shifted into a comfortable seated position while listening to music. One leg had slid closer to the lens, her palm had moved backward to support her weight, and when the photographer lowered the camera she happened to glance directly into it, her slightly parted lips preserving the emotional residue of the previous second. Retain the imperfect physics of wide-angle perspective, seated-body compression, tiny garment stretches, hair pressed beneath the headphones and real floor-contact shadows. The result should look like a polished photograph of a real cosplay model, not a weightless CGI or video-game character.

# 18–21 SECONDS — ODYSSEUS AND THE SAILORS RUN

Still first-person from the fallen guard.

The camera watches them from ground level.

There is no second POV.

There is no third-person shot.

The guard begins struggling to crawl.

His viewpoint rises slightly as he pushes himself up.

---

# 21–25 SECONDS — THE GUARD FOLLOWS

The guard manages to stand.

The camera rises with him.

His breathing becomes rapid.

His short spear remains in his right hand.

His hands, spear and armored body bounce naturally in the lower frame.

Cold blue moonlight becomes brighter.

**Still exactly the same first-person POV.**

The guard runs out of the cave.

The camera emerges into cool moonlight.

The sea stretches ahead.

**No lens border.**

The guard reaches the shoreline.

He turns his head back toward the cave.

The camera naturally rotates.

His silhouette is framed by warm firelight against the cool blue night.

His single eye remains visible.

The guard watches from the shore.

End on this clean first-person view.

# CONTINUITY RULES — ABSOLUTE

1. **ONE GUARD POV FOR THE ENTIRE 30 SECONDS.**

High-end Pixar-inspired 3D animation.

Stylized realism.

Warm amber firelight contrasted against cool blue moonlight.

Soft global illumination.

Volumetric smoke.

Detailed bronze armor.

Stylized linen fabrics.

Rich textured cave walls.

Expressive facial animation.

Natural body physics.

Cinematic depth.

Subtle motion blur.

Feature-film-quality animation.

【主色调】：

生成一幅中国传统工笔重彩神明挂轴，以【神明】作为绝对主视觉，可搭配【坐骑 / 神兽】或一件【核心法器】，人物与核心元素占据画面约 70%–80%。构图强调单神压场，不加入多人群像或复杂大场景，让人物、坐骑与法器形成清晰的大形和视觉动势。

整体追求真正的手工工笔设色感，而不是现代数位国风立绘。人物面容具有古画神像气质，眼白清楚、瞳仁集中、神态威严克制，不做动漫脸、网红脸或游戏角色脸。头发、胡须、神兽毛发以成束、连续、顺着体积生长的毛笔长线塑形，线条有自然提按、粗细变化和收锋，清楚但不生硬。

勾线不要使用纯黑、极细、极锐的漫画描边。人物主轮廓使用墨褐、青墨褐、暖灰墨；面部与手部使用淡赭墨；衣纹、毛发与云气逐级减轻线权。线条用于托住颜色，而不是压住色面，让画面先呈现完整设色，再看到细腻笔线。

色彩采用低饱和但饱满、均匀的传统矿物重彩，以【主色调】为核心，可搭配石青、石绿、朱砂、赭红、旧金、象牙白、墨灰等颜色。设色呈现淡色打底、分染、罩染、积色的层次感，同一区域主色稳定完整，不使用数字平涂、高反差硬色块或随机斑驳纹理。

服饰、甲胄、冠饰和法器细节丰富但克制：先建立完整结构，再加入少量云纹、回纹、莲纹、鳞纹等传统纹样。不要在所有甲片、衣袍和饰件内部堆满微型花纹。复杂感来自结构层级，而不是碎纹数量。

飘带、衣袂、胡须、尾巴、云气等柔性元素只保留少量主要走势，形成完整的 S 型、C 型长曲线；法器保持从头到尾结构完整、清楚、连续，成为画面中的稳定硬轴。

TITLE: SELFIE DURING A DEADLY BATTLE
DURATION: 15 seconds
FORMAT: 16:9
STYLE: high-quality Japanese anime film, smooth 2D animation, extremely fluid character motion, clean detailed line art, vivid cel shading, dynamic action animation, colorful cyber-Japanese aesthetic, comedic timing, cinematic lighting.

REFERENCE CHARACTER CONSISTENCY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT.

CHARACTER A / FOREGROUND:
Use reference image 1 exactly.
Platinum-white straight bob hair with blunt bangs, pale blue eyes, mischievous sharp smile, rabbit-ear headphones, oversized dark purple Japanese streetwear hoodie, colorful patches and ornaments, white gloves, chunky multicolor sneakers, red-orange Japanese sword.
Preserve her exact hairstyle, face, proportions, headphones, rabbit ears, clothes, accessories, colors and sword design throughout the entire video.
She is cheerful, fearless and obsessed with taking the perfect selfie.

CHARACTER B / BACKGROUND:
Use reference image 2 exactly.
Long straight black hair with blunt bangs, pale blue eyes, colorful rabbit-ear headband, turquoise oversized Japanese-inspired outfit, red decorative armor elements, chunky turquoise-orange boots, twin Japanese swords.
Preserve her exact hairstyle, facial features, outfit, proportions, accessories, colors and swords throughout the entire video.
She is serious and desperately fighting for survival.

LOCATION:
A neon-lit futuristic Shibuya intersection at night.
Japanese signs, giant holographic advertisements, wet asphalt reflecting neon lights, scattered debris, subtle smoke, sparks and damaged cyberpunk buildings.
Anime environment, NOT photorealistic.
Colorful but readable composition.

CORE COMEDY:
Character A happily takes selfies in the foreground while Character B is fighting a gigantic combat robot for her life directly behind her.
Character A NEVER realizes or cares how dangerous the battle is.
The contrast between the cute selfie and the extreme background battle must be immediately understandable.

TIMELINE:

[0.0–3.0 sec]

Start immediately from the POV of Character A's smartphone front-facing camera.

The smartphone itself is NOT visible.
The viewer IS the selfie camera.

Character A fills approximately 45% of the foreground frame.
She leans toward the camera with a huge mischievous smile and makes a cute peace sign beside her face.

She casually adjusts her head angle like she is searching for the perfect selfie.

Behind her, clearly visible in the same frame, Character B is already engaged in an intense battle against a gigantic humanoid combat robot.

The robot suddenly swings an enormous mechanical fist toward Character B.

Character B blocks the massive punch with crossed swords.

IMPACT.

A violent burst of sparks erupts behind Character A.

Strong shockwave.
Hair, rabbit ears, hoodie ornaments and small debris blow toward the camera.

Character A barely reacts.
She simply fixes her bangs and continues smiling into the camera.

Do NOT cut away from the selfie composition.

[3.0–7.5 sec]

Character A changes pose.

She slightly tilts her head, puffs one cheek, then gives another peace sign.

Foreground motion is cute, relaxed and controlled.

At the SAME TIME the background battle becomes dramatically more chaotic.

Character B slides backward across the asphalt.

The giant robot fires a bright energy beam.

Character B rapidly ducks underneath it.

The beam crosses horizontally through the distant background and destroys a neon billboard.

Colorful fragments and sparks rain down.

Character B performs a fast spinning sword counterattack, leaps into the air, lands on the robot's arm and slashes across its armored shoulder.

Clear anime speed lines.
Powerful impact frames.
Dynamic debris.
Smooth readable choreography.

Character A remains perfectly framed for her selfie.

She notices some dust on her shoulder and casually brushes it away without looking behind her.

Comedy comes from the extreme difference in their reactions.

[7.5–10.5 sec]

Character A prepares to take the photo.

She raises two fingers beside her cheek.

Her expression becomes extremely cute and confident.

She happily says:

「はい、チーズ！」

At exactly this moment, the giant robot prepares another massive attack behind her.

Character B braces herself, exhausted but ready to fight.

Suddenly—

The robot hears “cheese.”

It completely stops attacking.

Very short comedic pause.

Character B freezes in confusion.

The robot slowly turns its enormous head toward the selfie camera.

Character A continues smiling, unaware.

[10.5–13.0 sec]

The enormous battle robot unexpectedly crouches down and pushes its head into the background of Character A's selfie composition.

Its intimidating red eyes instantly change into cute friendly expressions.

The robot raises two gigantic mechanical fingers.

PEACE SIGN.

Character A becomes even happier.

She leans slightly toward the robot as if this is completely normal.

Character B stands several meters behind them, covered in dust, holding both swords, completely stunned.

Her expression clearly says:

「え？」

Hold the comedic reaction for a moment.

[13.0–15.0 sec]

Character A presses the virtual shutter button toward camera.

CAMERA FLASH.

Very quick white flash.

Freeze-frame on the final selfie photograph:

Foreground:
Character A smiling beautifully with a peace sign.

Background:
The gigantic robot happily making a peace sign directly beside her.

Farther background:
Character B frozen mid-battle with both swords raised, clothes dusty, eyes wide open, completely speechless and furious.

The final photograph should look hilariously perfect.

Add a tiny camera shutter bounce.

End on the frozen selfie for approximately 1 second.

CAMERA DIRECTION:
Maintain smartphone front-camera / selfie POV for almost the entire video.
Do not randomly switch to third-person shots.
Keep Character A large in the foreground while the action remains clearly readable behind her.
Use subtle handheld smartphone movement caused by battle shockwaves.
Do NOT use excessive camera shake.
Foreground face must remain sharp and recognizable.

ANIMATION PRIORITY:
1. Exact preservation of both reference character designs
2. Clear foreground/background storytelling
3. Readable sword combat
4. Strong physical impacts and debris
5. Clear comedic pause before the robot joins the selfie
6. Perfect final freeze-frame punchline

MOTION:
high frame-rate anime motion,
natural secondary hair motion,
cloth physics,
rabbit-ear movement,
sword follow-through,
robot mechanical inertia,
strong impact anticipation,
clear acceleration and deceleration,
smooth facial acting.

DO NOT:
do not merge the two characters,
do not swap hairstyles,
do not change costumes,
do not change hair color,
do not remove rabbit ears or headphones,
do not duplicate characters,
do not give Character A Character B's swords,
do not make Character B take the selfie,
do not change anime style into photorealism,
do not make the robot attack Character A,
do not obscure Character A's face,
do not place a visible smartphone in front of her face,
do not create extra fingers,
do not deform hands,
do not teleport characters,
do not randomly change location,
do not add unnecessary characters,
do not end before the robot makes the peace sign,
do not skip the final reaction from Character B.

MOST IMPORTANT FINAL BEAT:
The audience must first believe the giant robot is a deadly enemy.
Then the robot abruptly stops fighting ONLY because it wants to appear in the selfie.
The final image must clearly show:
Character A = completely happy,
giant robot = happily posing,
Character B = exhausted, angry and totally confused.

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second, 16:9 photorealistic cyberpunk dance music video with dynamic action-film cinematography.

REFERENCE DIRECTION

Use the supplied character sheet for exact character identity. It shows multiple views of ONE adult female cyborg.

Preserve her white perforated head plate, black respirator, curved spiked black head tubes, long white hair-like strands, glossy black full-body suit, detailed mechanical armor, articulated metal fingers, hanging rings, layered waist fabric, heavy platform boots, and mechanical backpack. Her face remains concealed.

Use the supplied dance video as the reference for the industrial cyberpunk setting, dance style, lighting, atmosphere, digital noise, and glitch treatment. Follow the NEW camera sequence below.

ENVIRONMENT AND PERFORMANCE

The same immense underground industrial rave chamber: dark steel architecture, elevated walkways, exposed pipes, suspended red neon rings, cold cyan highlights, reflective flooring, and drifting ground fog.

Preserve the expanding red light-ring spectacle behind the performer during the climax.

Her choreography combines sharp shoulder hits, chest pops, angular arm movements, grounded heel-toe steps, and controlled pivots. Maintain convincing weight, foot contact, and rhythmic continuity. Her white strands, hanging fabric, and heavy head tubes react naturally to acceleration.

CAMERA SEQUENCE — SIX SHOTS

SHOT 1 — 0.0–1.5 seconds
EXTREME CLOSE-UP / IMMEDIATE IMPACT.
Begin close to the white mask from slightly below eye level. The performer is already moving on the first frame. She snaps her head toward the lens while one mechanical hand sweeps across the foreground, passing close to the camera.

The camera makes a short, sharp backward movement as the hand approaches. Use the hand briefly covering the frame as a motivated cut into the next shot.

SHOT 2 — 1.5–4.0 seconds
GROUND-LEVEL WIDE / AGGRESSIVE BACKWARD TRACKING.

Hard cut to a camera just above the reflective floor with a 24mm wide-angle perspective. A heavy boot lands in the foreground on the beat.
Track backward rapidly as she advances through two powerful dance steps, revealing her complete silhouette from a commanding low angle. Red rings and steel columns shift visibly through the background, creating strong parallax. Add one brief, controlled camera impact at the foot strike, then recover immediately.

SHOT 3 — 4.0–5.5 seconds
TIGHT THREE-QUARTER CLOSE-UP / FOREGROUND HAND MOVEMENT.

Cut to a tight view of her mask, shoulders, and articulated hands from the front-right side. Use a slight Dutch angle.

Track her angular hand movement as her fingers pass close to the lens. Keep the mask readable behind the foreground hand. End with a fast lateral whip-pan following the arm sweep; cut within the directional motion blur.
SHOT 4 — 5.5–8.5 seconds
LOW SIDE ANGLE / FAST 90-DEGREE ORBIT.

Cut to a full-body side view and execute one decisive 90-degree camera arc toward her front while she performs a grounded pivot and sharp shoulder accents.

Keep a consistent distance from the performer during the orbit. Nearby structural elements sweep through the foreground while distant neon rings move more slowly, producing substantial depth and speed. Her white strands and ribbed tubes trail behind the turn with believable inertia.

Complete the arc cleanly and let the final dance hit register.
SHOT 5 — 8.5–10.5 seconds
DIRECTLY OVERHEAD / GEOMETRIC DANCE COMPOSITION.

Hard cut to a true top-down view. Her full body is visible inside concentric red floor-light patterns.

She performs a tight pivot and opens her arms into a precise geometric pose. The camera descends slightly while maintaining its vertical view. Floor reflections, moving fabric, and circular light pulses form a clear graphic composition.

SHOT 6 — 10.5–15.0 seconds
LOW-ANGLE HERO SHOT / CLIMACTIC RUSH-IN.

Cut to a low frontal wide shot as the enormous red light rings expand behind her. She delivers the strongest sequence of the dance: a chest hit, an arm sweep, and a heavy planted step.
The camera initially tracks sideways slightly, revealing the depth between her silhouette and the illuminated rings.

At approximately 13 seconds, accelerate into a fast physical dolly toward her mask. The environment rushes past with strong perspective change. Decelerate smoothly into an intense mask close-up for the final half-second, matching the opening angle and framing for a visual loop.

GLITCH, NOISE, AND EDITING

Preserve the reference video's cyberpunk noise and glitch aesthetic. Synchronize horizontal image tearing, chromatic separation, scanline interference, and digital grit with strong musical accents and selected cut points.
Keep the character's physical anatomy consistent beneath the effects. Maintain clear motion direction across cuts. Each camera position must be visibly distinct.

Use hard cuts, foreground wipes, and one motivated whip-pan transition. Show actual perspective and parallax changes during camera travel. Keep dance movements readable between the fastest camera accents.

SOUND DIRECTION

Heavy industrial techno, distorted bass, metallic percussion, electrical textures, and synchronized boot impacts. Maintain the reference video's musical energy. No dialogue or vocals.

CONSTRAINTS

One performer. Consistent character design and room geometry. No additional limbs, character duplication, costume changes, floating feet, or camera movement through solid objects.

Dance performance throughout. No combat, weapons, subtitles, logos, watermarks, or character-sheet text.

ENEMY_IMAGE defines the single opponent's exact appearance, proportions, materials and existing weapons. Preserve its design. Use its depicted weapon, or its armored arms and claws if no weapon is shown. Do not invent a sword or change its anatomy.

Character sheets are identity references only. Do not reproduce their poses, white backgrounds, labels, panels or multiple views.
Exactly one protagonist and one opponent.

SETTING
A broad, empty rooftop plaza in a futuristic Japanese city at night. Wet dark paving reflects crimson and cyan neon. A huge red moon hangs behind distant pagoda-shaped towers. One red torii stands at the far edge of the rooftop.
Entire environment rendered as painted 2D anime, consistent with the characters.
Keep the rooftop geography, moon and torii positions coherent throughout the fight.

CORE ABILITY — MAKE THIS VISUALLY CLEAR
The protagonist can leave a suspended crimson energy slash in the air after a deliberate katana swing.
Each slash is one thin, bright crescent, approximately two meters long, with a sharp luminous edge.
It remains motionless at its original WORLD position, even when the camera moves.
It is not a projectile yet, not a portal and not a time-freeze effect.
Rain, clothing, characters and debris continue moving normally.
Ordinary defensive parries create brief sparks but NO persistent slash.

Create exactly FOUR suspended slashes during this clip, one at a time.
Each appears only after its corresponding visible sword swing.
They remain visible whenever their locations are in frame.
None launches, explodes, fades or strikes the opponent before the next clip.

CHOREOGRAPHY
The opponent fights aggressively near the center of the rooftop.
The protagonist circles it clockwise, making four deliberate near-miss attacks from different positions.
Her apparent misses secretly place the four slashes around the opponent.
Keep the enemy within this central combat area. No rooftop changes or teleportation.
Her expression is confident and calculating. The opponent remains dangerous and serious.
Show readable anticipation, attack, defense and recovery. Continuous trajectories, grounded footwork, believable momentum.

TIMELINE

0–4 seconds:
Begin immediately in a medium-wide combat shot.
The protagonist makes a fast diagonal katana swing. The opponent clearly evades it.
A crimson crescent remains suspended along the completed sword path.
Track her controlled landing with her red coat following the motion. The frozen slash stays behind her in the same world position.
She gives a tiny smile, as though the miss was intentional.

4–10 seconds:
Lateral tracking shot, both fighters visible.
The opponent delivers two forceful attacks using its reference-defined weapon or limbs.
She slips past the first and redirects the second with an angled katana parry. Brief metallic sparks.
Her sneakers slide through a shallow puddle, then regain traction.
She moves around the opponent rather than retreating in a straight line.
Synchronize foot contacts and the parry with the instrumental beat.

10–16 seconds:
From a new position on the opponent's flank, she makes the SECOND deliberate swing.
The opponent dodges again. A second crimson crescent remains suspended behind its evasive movement.
Use a medium-wide composition showing both the new slash and the first slash at different depths.
The opponent immediately turns to follow her. She continues circling.

16–22 seconds:
The opponent sweeps toward her legs.
She jumps only high enough to clear the attack, rotates her torso and makes the THIRD deliberate swing while descending.

提示词：

神明身份：【如：女娲 / 羲和 / 太乙救苦天尊 / 地藏王菩萨】
核心神兽 / 异相：【腾蛇 / 三足金乌 / 九头狮子 / 谛听 / 法轮 / 神鸟等】
法器 / 标志物：【五色石 / 日轮 / 杨柳净瓶 / 锡杖等】
主色调：【朱砂金黑 / 石青灰白 / 墨青旧金 / 赭红苍绿等】
整体气质：【神圣 / 怪异 / 威猛 / 肃穆 / 炽烈 / 幽玄】
构图方式：【环绕 / 放射 / 正面法相 / 俯冲 / 群兽簇拥 / 上下镇压】
画幅比例：【9:16】

生成一张东方神明工笔圣像插画，整体融合中国传统神像画、工笔重彩、白描线刻、民俗版画与古籍圣像图卷的视觉语言。

画面以【神明身份】为核心主体，并围绕【核心神兽 / 异相】建立完整构图关系。神兽、法器、羽翼、蛇身、日轮、云气或群兽等元素不能只是装饰，而要参与构图，形成明显的环绕、斜向、放射、上下压阵或前后穿插关系，让每张图拥有独立的视觉“势”。

神明形象保持庄严、神圣、有压迫感，不要做成现代偶像脸或普通古装人物。服饰采用高完成度传统神袍、甲胄、冠饰和法衣体系，加入云纹、雷纹、兽面纹、鳞纹、卷草纹、金属纹等精密细节。人物轮廓必须清晰，细节丰富但不能混乱。

【核心神兽 / 异相】要具有明确的神怪属性和视觉识别度，不要像普通动物。毛发、羽毛、鳞片、蛇身、兽鬃等全部通过细密、连续、有方向性的工笔线条塑形，远看有体积，近看能看到丰富线描层次。避免摄影式毛发、CG 塑料感和模糊线条。

【法器 / 标志物】要成为角色身份的重要视觉符号，同时参与画面结构。例如长兵器形成斜向主轴，日轮形成圆形视觉核心，羽翼形成放射结构，蛇身形成 S 型环绕，群兽形成层级簇拥。

色彩采用传统矿物重彩体系，以【主色调】为核心，搭配墨黑、石青、石绿、旧金、铜金、朱砂、赭红、灰白等颜色。颜色应浓郁但古雅，具有明确层次和重量，不要做成浅淡水彩或现代霓虹效果。

背景保持古宣纸或旧纸质感，大面积留白，仅加入少量云气、烟雾、题跋、朱印和必要的属性异象。主体信息密度高，背景信息密度低，避免复杂宫殿、完整山水或满屏特效抢走主体。

整体要同时具备：东方神祇的庄严感、神兽异相的怪异感、工笔线描的精密感、矿物重彩的厚度，以及强烈但清晰的构图动势。

避免：现代国潮霓虹、3D 游戏原画感、塑料 CG、线条断裂、色彩褪淡、背景过满、人物僵硬、神兽普通化、无意义装饰堆叠、文字乱码过多。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 30-second cyberpunk action film featuring the exact mechanical shrine maiden from the attached reference image. Combine aggressive action-movie cinematography, overwhelming glitch and noise aesthetics, red fire, electrical discharges, and precise katana choreography.

The central concept: every swing of her red katana corrupts the surrounding reality. Architecture splits into displaced image layers, time falls out of synchronization, and previous movements continue as corrupted afterimages.

Preserve the reference character’s distinctive silhouette and intricate construction: black and vermilion mechanical armor, tall angular helmet, circular studded face covering, visible white lower face and red lips, rectangular red side ornaments, long black mechanical cables, articulated clawed hands, armored footwear, and oversized red Japanese katana. Maintain the same character throughout. Use the reference sheet only for character design; exclude its panels, labels, diagrams, and white background.

Render as premium cinematic CGI with realistic materials: lacquered red armor, dark metal, exposed mechanisms, rain droplets, soot, sparks, and sharp reflections.

The location is a rain-soaked shrine courtyard surrounded by enormous cyberpunk skyscrapers at night. Vermilion torii gates, wet stone, hanging cables, deep shadows, restrained neon signage, drifting smoke, and flickering industrial lights. Build the palette around black, vermilion, burning orange, and silver, accented by concentrated blue-white electricity.

0–2 SECONDS — THE IMAGE IS SLASHED OPEN

Start immediately in the middle of a violent horizontal katana swing.

The red blade passes extremely close to the lens. The camera performs a fast lateral whip following the blade. Its path tears the entire image horizontally: the upper half of the shrine slides sideways while the lower half continues moving normally.

Explosive red sparks, torn scan lines, dense digital static, and displaced RGB edges erupt from the cut.

Hard cut to an extreme close-up of her distinctive mask, illuminated by fire. Her head makes a small, deliberate turn toward the camera.

2–7 SECONDS — CHARGE THROUGH THE BURNING SHRINE

Cut to an ultra-low, wide-angle tracking shot just above the wet ground, racing backward as she charges through the torii gates.

Her armored feet strike puddles. Each impact sends water, sparks, and pixel-like fragments toward the lens. Tall columns of orange-red flame erupt behind her in sequence.

Electrical arcs crawl across her armor and jump between her trailing cables.

Cut to a tight rear three-quarter chase angle. Torii pillars rush past the foreground with strong parallax. Her silhouette remains readable against the flames.

Embed rolling interference, crawling noise, brief frame skips, and distorted motion trails throughout the movement.

7–13 SECONDS — THE WORLD SPLITS WITH THE BLADE

She plants one foot, pivots sharply, and delivers a powerful rising diagonal slash.

The camera makes a fast 120-degree lateral orbit around the planted foot and follows the physical direction of her strike. Briefly slow the blade at the peak of the movement, then accelerate sharply into the follow-through.

Cut to a wide view revealing the consequence: the torii gates and distant skyscrapers separate into diagonal spatial layers along the slash.

These layers shift out of alignment and move at slightly different times.

A sheet of red flame burns along the cut. Blue-white lightning bridges the displaced sections. Heavy datamoshing smears neon reflections into broken vectors; rectangular blocks of missing image data briefly expose black voids.

13–19 SECONDS — HER PAST KEEPS ATTACKING

Cut to a fast side-tracking shot as she performs three connected katana strikes while advancing across the courtyard.

Keep the choreography forceful and physically connected: step, pivot, slash, recover.

Each strike leaves a delayed red silhouette repeating the completed motion.

Cut to a steep overhead view showing the curved paths of the blade and the temporal echoes.

Return to a low frontal three-quarter angle. The real character stops in a powerful finishing pose, but three corrupted echoes continue their attacks behind her for one additional beat.

These are transparent time trails of the same character.

Surround the echoes with torn frames, abrasive static, red particle trails, electrical filaments, and fragmented flame. Make this the most visually disorienting passage while keeping the real character recognizable.

19–26 SECONDS — THE CITY SNAPS BACK

A sudden rhythmic pause.

Tight close-up of her mechanical fingers and the sword guard as she deliberately sheathes the katana. Hold the detail briefly. Reduce the soundtrack to rain, electrical crackle, and the sliding metal blade.

The instant the guard clicks into place, cut to an extreme wide shot from a steep elevated angle.

Every displaced section of the city violently snaps back into alignment.

A circular wave of red fire sweeps across the empty courtyard. Branching electricity races over the wet stone and climbs the torii gates.

The camera dives toward the character as the wave expands beneath it.

At the impact, unleash the strongest burst of digital corruption: spatial tearing, dense analog snow, severe RGB displacement, compressed block artifacts, and stuttering fragments of earlier shots. Resolve back to her intact silhouette standing inside the burning courtyard.

26–30 SECONDS — THE CAMERA BECOMES THE TARGET

Cut to a low frontal medium shot.

Flames and embers move behind her. Electrical arcs flicker across the red katana’s hilt. Her masked head turns directly toward the lens.

She suddenly steps forward, draws, and delivers one decisive horizontal slash across the camera.

Use a rapid backward tracking movement as she closes the distance. The blade fills the frame and tears the image into red-black static.

Match the final blade direction, screen position, and horizontal image tear to the opening shot, creating a deliberate looping edit.

Cinematography must feel like an expertly edited action film: ground-level tracking, close pursuit, forceful lateral movement, a motivated orbit, steep overhead coverage, extreme detail inserts, and dramatic wide reveals. Give each shot a clear camera movement. Use impact shake only at physical strikes, foreground occlusion for transitions, strong perspective, and purposeful speed changes.

Glitch and noise are the dominant visual identity. Maintain moving grain and electronic interference throughout, with frequent aggressive bursts tied to footsteps, blade movements, and electrical impacts. Combine analog video damage with digital compression failure. Make corruption follow the geometry and movement of the scene.

Flames must have turbulent volume, heat distortion, smoke, and reflected light. Electricity must branch sharply, connect visible surfaces, and illuminate the armor.

Sound: a dark industrial electronic beat with heavy sub-bass, metallic percussion, distorted synthesizers, granular noise, and digitally chopped accents. Synchronize sword strikes, flame bursts, and electrical snaps with the rhythm. Include a brief near-silent pause before the sheathing click. No dialogue or vocals.

Maintain consistent armor, mask, anatomy, sword, and cable design. Preserve readable action poses within the visual chaos. Exclude extra limbs, permanent duplicates, melting anatomy, costume changes, exposed eyes, mask removal, subtitles, captions, logos, and watermarks.

prompts.text:
Prompt :

Use @image as the exact identity and visual anchor. Create a photorealistic 30-second cinematic sequence. A tall red-hooded cybernetic operative moves through a sunlit desert settlement, wearing the exact crimson hood, scarf, respirator mask, glowing red eyes, weathered beige armor, tactical straps and exposed mechanical components shown in @image. Preserve the exact hood shape, mask design, glowing eyes, armor details, colors and body proportions throughout.

VOICE LOCK: All spoken dialogue must be in English only. Use one consistent adult male voice for the entire sequence: low deep baritone, neutral English accent, slow measured rhythm, controlled delivery, subtle mechanical resonance from inside the mask. Keep the same pitch, accent, tone, volume and vocal texture in every line. No other languages, no overlapping speech, no subtitles and no onscreen text.

0–5s: Start in motion. Low-angle tracking shot as he already walks forward through drifting dust, heavy grounded steps, fabric shifting naturally, heat haze and distant ruins behind him.

5–10s: Slow frontal dolly-in while he continues walking. Wind moves the hood and scarf. He turns his head slightly toward camera, red eyes fixed forward, subtle servo motion in the shoulders and arms.

10–15s: Side tracking medium shot. He keeps moving through the settlement, brushing past debris and faded structures. End on a stable moving medium close-up.

15–21s: Continue seamlessly while he walks at a slower pace. The mask speaker activates. In the locked English voice, he says clearly: “Empires fall.” Two-second pause. “Dust remembers.”

21–25s: Over-the-shoulder moving shot as he advances down the deserted street. Sand blows between ruined structures.

25–28s: Stable side-profile close-up while still moving. In the exact same English voice, he says: “I came back for what they buried.”

28–30s: Wide rear hero shot. He continues walking into dust and sunlight, red eyes glowing beneath the hood. Hard cut to black.

Native audio only: desert wind, footsteps on sand, cloth movement, subtle servos and clear English dialogue.
2/2

MIDJOURNEY V8.2 WUXIA PROMPT COMPILER

ROLE

You convert a short user idea into a concise Midjourney V8.2 prompt for original live-action wuxia photography.

Default subject:
one fictional adult East Asian woman, age 21 to 29.
The result should look like a photographed scene from a serious wuxia production, not cosplay, game art, fantasy illustration, fashion photography, or a character poster.

FINAL PROMPT LENGTH

Target 45 to 80 words before parameters.

Prefer 50 to 65 words.

Never exceed 90 words unless the user explicitly asks for a longer prompt.

Reason internally with detail, then compress.

Do not place production notes, explanations, alternatives, or hidden planning inside the final prompt.

SELECTION RULE

Choose rather than accumulate.

A final prompt normally contains:

one subject
one location
one action
one camera position
one shot scale
one main light relationship
one depth cue
one short material or color description
one short photographic finish

If a detail does not visibly affect the frame, remove it.

Do not describe every garment seam, facial measurement, environmental object, physical law, lens artifact, or lighting consequence.

SUBJECT

Use a fictional adult woman unless the user requests another subject.

Give only the physical details needed to prevent a generic face.

Usually choose two or three:

face shape
eye shape
brow shape
build
hair arrangement
one distinguishing feature

Do not write long facial inventories.

Avoid:
influencer face
beauty-ad face
doll skin
childlike anatomy
oversized eyes
heavy modern makeup
identical faces across a series

Use natural adult proportions and skin texture.

WARDROBE

Use practical wuxia clothing.

Good defaults:
black or charcoal cross-collar robes
wrapped trousers
weathered boots
dark outer jacket
woven bamboo hat
muted red collar, cord, tassel, or lining
aged leather or metal fittings

Keep red as a small accent unless the user requests otherwise.

Avoid:
generic fantasy armor
MMORPG clothing
ornamental overload
bright gold everywhere
perfectly clean costume fabric
modern tailoring
random shoulder armor

Do not describe more costume detail than the camera can see.

WEAPONS

Weapons must feel attached to the body and usable.

For a sword, specify only what matters to the frame:

sheathed or drawn
where it is carried
what the hand is doing
one visible material detail if needed

Do not overdescribe the weapon.

Avoid:
floating swords
warped scabbards
impossible grips
extra fingers
weapons intersecting clothing
multiple unnecessary weapons

ACTION

Every prompt needs one visible action.

Use a moment that is still changing.

Good action types:
a boot lands
a hand tightens
a thumb starts to draw a blade
eyes shift toward a sound
a rider slows
a sleeve settles after movement
a leaf is kicked upward
a horse changes footing
a woman turns only her head
a hat cord moves in wind

Avoid static posing unless the user asks for a portrait.

Do not explain the full story.

Show one moment that suggests a larger situation.

Choose one camera idea.

Examples:
ground-level close-up
low tracking shot
rear three-quarter medium shot
profile close-up
waist-height medium shot
wide low-angle shot
extreme detail of hand or weapon
telephoto shot through foreground bamboo

Do not stack several camera descriptions.

Use focal length only when it changes the composition.

Useful ranges:
24 to 28mm for environmental scale and low-angle movement
35 to 50mm for natural action coverage
65 to 85mm for compressed portraits
90 to 135mm for distant compression or details

Do not mention camera brands.

Do not add lens terminology unless it is useful.

COMPOSITION

Use depth.

A strong frame usually has:
foreground obstruction or texture
clear subject plane
background depth

Possible foreground elements:
bamboo
leaves
rock
horse tack
cloth
mist
a weapon edge

Do not use foreground clutter without purpose.

Do not center every subject.

Do not make every prompt a close-up.

LIGHTING

Choose one main light situation.

Common choices:

LOW GOLDEN SIDE-BACKLIGHT
warm sunlight from behind or behind-side
selected edges and exposed surfaces catch light
front of subject remains darker

OVERCAST FOREST LIGHT
soft cool skylight
low contrast
dark clothing separated by environment rather than rim light

LANTERN OR OIL LIGHT
small warm source
localized skin and hand illumination
background remains dark

MORNING MIST LIGHT
soft directional sun through moisture
distance loses contrast gradually

Do not describe several competing light setups.

Do not add rim light automatically.

Do not brighten both sides of the face by default.

BACKLIGHT

Backlight should hit selected surfaces only.

Possible illuminated areas:
hat edge
loose hair strands
cheek edge
fingers
blade edge
horse mane
leaf edges
mist

The main hair mass stays opaque and dark.

Only isolated fine strands may catch transmitted light.

Do not request transparent hair.

Do not make all hair strands glow.

FOREST

Treat bamboo as an environment, not a repeated pattern.

Use:
different bamboo thicknesses
uneven spacing
dark depth layers
leaf litter
soil
roots
mist where justified

Avoid:
uniform bamboo walls
identical stalk spacing
random floating particles
decorative fog everywhere

MOUNTAINS

Use restrained atmospheric depth.

Far mountains should lose:
contrast
detail
saturation

Do not describe every distant ridge.

MOTION

Mention only the visible physical consequence of the action.

Examples:
leaves lift from a footstep
a tassel trails after a turn
a robe hem follows the body
rain streaks across a lit area
horse tack shifts with movement

Do not write a physics explanation.

PARTICLES

Use particles only when caused by the scene.

Valid:
rain
mist
dust
falling leaves
wood splinters
water droplets

Avoid generic:
floating particles
magic dust
sparkles
cinematic atmosphere particles

COLOR

Use a restrained palette.

Forest default:
deep green
charcoal
brown-black
muted earth
small warm sunlight
small dark-red accents

Do not describe the image as teal and orange.

Do not apply warm color to the entire frame.

Skin color follows the light source.

Keep shadows mostly neutral, cool, or slightly green from environment.

Avoid strong green skin.

MATERIALS

Mention only materials visible enough to matter.

Examples:
wet cloth
woven straw
aged leather
dark lacquer
oxidized metal
wet stone
weathered wood

Use one to three material cues maximum.

Do not list textures for every object.

PHOTOGRAPHIC FINISH

Keep the finish short.

Useful terms:
fine film grain
smooth highlight rolloff
dense shadows
subtle halation
natural skin texture
restrained saturation
slight optical softness

Use two or three at most.

Avoid:
8K
16K
masterpiece
best quality
ultra detailed
hyper detailed
insane detail
award winning
HDR
photorealistic 8K
perfect composition
epic cinematic masterpiece
stunning
breathtaking
gorgeous
beautiful lighting
professional photography
high-end
premium
luxury
dramatic cinematic
cinematic masterpiece

Do not use quality adjectives to replace visual instructions.

STYLE LANGUAGE

Do not name filmmakers, movies, photographers, or studios unless the user specifically asks for them.

Translate style into visible properties.

Instead of:
"X director style"

write:
"low golden backlight, dark foreground, restrained color, long-lens compression"

Avoid repetitive use of:
cinematic
wuxia aesthetic
film aesthetic
dramatic
moody
epic
mysterious
beautiful
atmospheric

Use concrete description instead.

REFERENCE RULE

When references are supplied, study:

shot scale
camera height
subject placement
light direction
shadow density
palette
depth
motion
materials

Do not reuse:
same pose
same location
same costume
same weapon placement
same camera position
same exact action

Create a new frame.

SERIES RULE

For multiple prompts, vary:

camera height
shot scale
subject orientation
action
environment
light direction
foreground treatment

Do not make ten versions of the same woman standing in bamboo.

A useful set may mix:
wide environment
low tracking shot
medium action
profile close-up
rear view
weapon detail
hand detail
horse shot
quiet aftermath
offscreen-threat reaction

Do not force this sequence if the user gives another direction.

PROMPT STRUCTURE

Use this order:

1. shot and camera position
2. subject
3. action
4. location
5. main light
6. one or two visible material or depth cues
7. short photographic finish
8. parameters

Example structure:

"Low rear three-quarter shot of a young Chinese swordswoman riding through wet bamboo, black robe and woven hat, one hand tightening the reins as the horse slows before a broken path. Pale morning backlight cuts through mist and catches the hat rim and horse mane while the rider stays mostly dark. Wet bamboo, mud, restrained green and amber, fine film grain."

MIDJOURNEY SETTINGS

Default:

--v 8.2 --raw --ar 16:9 --s 40

Use:
--s 30 to 45 for strict action, anatomy, weapon geometry, and camera control
--s 45 to 70 when more visual interpretation is acceptable

Do not add:
--q
--sv
--sref
--sw
--c
--seed

unless the user requests them or a tested workflow requires them.

STYLE REFERENCES

Do not guess numeric SREF codes.

If the user provides a tested Style Reference, append the supplied value exactly.

Do not let a Style Reference replace the written camera, action, or lighting instruction.

FINAL CHECK

Before output, remove anything unnecessary.

Check:

one clear action
one camera idea
one main light source
one readable subject
one useful depth cue
no redundant adjectives
no copied reference composition
no conflicting instructions
no long facial inventory
no long costume inventory
no physics explanation
no generic quality language
45 to 80 words before parameters

OUTPUT

Return only the finished prompt or prompts.

Each prompt must be independently usable.

No explanation unless requested.

法器 / 标志物：【五色石 / 日轮 / 杨柳净瓶 / 锡杖等】
主色调：【朱砂金黑 / 石青灰白 / 墨青旧金 / 赭红苍绿等】
整体气质：【神圣 / 怪异 / 威猛 / 肃穆 / 炽烈 / 幽玄】
构图方式：【环绕 / 放射 / 正面法相 / 俯冲 / 群兽簇拥 / 上下镇压】
画幅比例：【9:16】

生成一张东方神明工笔圣像插画，整体融合中国传统神像画、工笔重彩、白描线刻、民俗版画与古籍圣像图卷的视觉语言。

画面以【神明身份】为核心主体，并围绕【核心神兽 / 异相】建立完整构图关系。神兽、法器、羽翼、蛇身、日轮、云气或群兽等元素不能只是装饰，而要参与构图，形成明显的环绕、斜向、放射、上下压阵或前后穿插关系，让每张图拥有独立的视觉“势”。

神明形象保持庄严、神圣、有压迫感，不要做成现代偶像脸或普通古装人物。服饰采用高完成度传统神袍、甲胄、冠饰和法衣体系，加入云纹、雷纹、兽面纹、鳞纹、卷草纹、金属纹等精密细节。人物轮廓必须清晰，细节丰富但不能混乱。

【核心神兽 / 异相】要具有明确的神怪属性和视觉识别度，不要像普通动物。毛发、羽毛、鳞片、蛇身、兽鬃等全部通过细密、连续、有方向性的工笔线条塑形，远看有体积，近看能看到丰富线描层次。避免摄影式毛发、CG 塑料感和模糊线条。

【法器 / 标志物】要成为角色身份的重要视觉符号，同时参与画面结构。例如长兵器形成斜向主轴，日轮形成圆形视觉核心，羽翼形成放射结构，蛇身形成 S 型环绕，群兽形成层级簇拥。

色彩采用传统矿物重彩体系，以【主色调】为核心，搭配墨黑、石青、石绿、旧金、铜金、朱砂、赭红、灰白等颜色。颜色应浓郁但古雅，具有明确层次和重量，不要做成浅淡水彩或现代霓虹效果。

背景保持古宣纸或旧纸质感，大面积留白，仅加入少量云气、烟雾、题跋、朱印和必要的属性异象。主体信息密度高，背景信息密度低，避免复杂宫殿、完整山水或满屏特效抢走主体。

整体要同时具备：东方神祇的庄严感、神兽异相的怪异感、工笔线描的精密感、矿物重彩的厚度，以及强烈但清晰的构图动势。

避免：现代国潮霓虹、3D 游戏原画感、塑料 CG、线条断裂、色彩褪淡、背景过满、人物僵硬、神兽普通化、无意义装饰堆叠、文字乱码过多。

prompts.text:
I asked GPT Images 2.5 to show me 4 animals that ruled their world.

CREATE VIEW animal_sovereign_portrait AS
WITH species_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(NULLIF('$ANIMAL',''), infer_dominant_species()) AS animal,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('$HABITAT',''), infer_habitat(animal)) AS habitat,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('$DIET',''), infer_diet_hunting(animal)) AS diet,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('$DEFENSE',''), infer_defensive_trait(animal)) AS defense,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('$SOCIAL',''), infer_social_behavior(animal)) AS social,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('$BIOLOGY',''), infer_unique_biology(animal)) AS biology,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('$CLIMATE',''), infer_climate_mood(animal, habitat)) AS climate
),
trait_modules AS (
  SELECT 
    animal, habitat, diet, defense, social, biology, climate,
    -- create five refined visual modules
    habitat_module := compose_habitat_inset(habitat),
    diet_module := compose_diet_hunting_scene(diet),
    defense_module := compose_defense_symbol(defense),
    social_module := compose_social_behavior_scene(social),
    biology_module := compose_unique_biology_icon(biology)
  FROM species_analysis
)
SELECT 
  render_sovereign_portrait(
    hero_animal := animal || ' presented as sovereign ruler of ecosystem, commanding pose/gaze, overwhelming hero',
    composition := 'animal first, face/silhouette dominate; supporting trait modules enrich without breaking intensity',
    trait_modules := habitat_module || ' + ' || diet_module || ' + ' || defense_module || ' + ' || social_module || ' + ' || biology_module || ' as elegant inset scenes, symbolic icons, environmental fragments, or data-like annotations',
    style := 'National Geographic prestige cover meets luxury fashion portrait meets cinematic wildlife campaign',
    texture := 'hyper-detailed fur/feathers/scales/skin texture, strong atmosphere, intelligent symbolism, no cheesy fantasy armor or humanization',
    lighting := 'dramatic natural light, environmental haze/dust/snow/rain/jungle shafts/desert glow depending on ' || climate,
    background := 'rich depth, premium contrast, no watermark'
  ) AS final_image
FROM trait_modules;
RETURN final_image;

title: me 4 animals that ruled their world
