Prompt:

Create a 9:16 editorial collage poster built around a fan-shaped composition.

SUBJECT: [your theme / subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [what the composition should express]
FAN STRUCTURE: [fragmented burst / rounded fan pages / diagonal collage / constructivist radial / custom variation]
VISUAL MATERIALS: [portrait photography / botanical specimens / architecture / objects / archival images / textures]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–5 dominant colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [editorial serif / grotesk / condensed sans / other]
BACKGROUND: [paper tone / flat color]
TEXT DETAILS: [optional short meaningful phrases]

Treat the fan shape as the main visual system, not as a decorative frame. Build one strong large-scale silhouette first, then place rich visual information inside or around it.

Do not default to evenly spaced straight wedges. The fan structure may be irregular, curved, rounded, fragmented, asymmetrical, layered, partially broken, or constructed from mechanical lines depending on the concept.

Let the geometry carry meaning:

* fragmented shapes can suggest media, memory or visual overload
* rounded fan pages can suggest growth, nature or unfolding
* diagonal sections can create tension and narrative movement
* precise radial lines can suggest systems, architecture or construction

Combine photography, cropped details, textures, linework, flat color fields and negative space with clear hierarchy. Some sections may contain dense imagery, while others should remain pure color or empty space to create rhythm.

FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where oversized type becomes part of the physical space instead of simply sitting on top of the image.

Build one clear spatial system first, then make the typography strictly follow its geometry, perspective, curvature, depth and surface changes.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition and act as the primary visual structure.

Depending on the chosen spatial structure, allow the letterforms to:

* wrap around curved architecture,
* continue across floors and walls,
* pass through repeated frames,
* or split across multiple depth layers and visually realign from one specific viewpoint.

The typography must feel physically integrated into the environment, with correct scale, perspective, occlusion and surface contact. From the intended camera angle, the word should remain recognizable and visually powerful even if individual letterforms are distorted by the architecture.

Use a restrained palette with one strong accent color against neutral concrete, black, white or architectural materials. Keep the color fields clean, solid and graphic rather than glossy, neon or heavily textured.

If a person is included, keep them relatively small and use them as a scale reference. They should naturally walk, ride or move through the typographic space rather than pose for the camera.

Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line. Keep it clearly subordinate to the main word.

Overall style: experimental typography, spatial graphic design, contemporary architecture, editorial poster, installation art, strong depth, clean hierarchy, high-impact composition.

Do not convert the scene into an eye-level portrait, seated pose, or standing fashion shot. Position her head around the upper-middle portion of the vertical frame, with the torso extending downward and one bent thigh and knee entering prominently into the lower foreground.  Her hair is exceptionally long, dense, and naturally black. Because she is already lying flat, the hair explodes outward above and beside her head, producing a huge irregular black silhouette that resembles a chaotic halo. Do not make the hair form a clean circle. Preserve crossing strands, loose loops, tangles, flyaways, uneven edges, and tiny cool highlights created by the flash.  Cover the white bedding with large quantities of movie-prop-style hundred-dollar banknote prints, randomly rotated and overlapping one another. Some notes rest beside her hair, across the shoulders and torso, over the abdomen, and near the legs. Keep the layout messy rather than graphic or symmetrical. Several notes may visibly resemble motion-picture prop money instead of being presented as verified real cash. Near the very top of the frame, scatter a smaller number of transparent or pale-blue acrylic pieces that visually resemble broken glass, adding to the chaotic party-installation feeling.  Dress her in a minimalist solid-black sleeveless fitted crop tank top, with relatively wide straps, a matte cotton or stretch-jersey surface, and a hem ending around the lower ribs or upper waist so that a natural section of midriff remains visible. The lower garment is only partially seen: simple black or very dark navy shorts or another very short dark bottom with a pale or white waistband edge. Do not invent elaborate clothing details.  Keep her adult body slim and elongated but realistically proportioned. The waist can be naturally defined, never aggressively cinched. Visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, collarbones, shoulders, both arms and hands, parts of the upper arms, midriff, and a large foreground section of thigh and knee. Use a light cool-neutral to lightly warm-neutral ivory complexion, with stronger peach-pink flush across the cheeks. The skin should visually suggest a soft, fine, clean, slightly cool tactile quality somewhere between powdery matte and natural satin. Preserve tiny pores, subtle arm texture, knee coloration, minute tonal variation, and slight abdominal surface changes.  Use adult feminine makeup influenced by contemporary East Asian fashion, Y2K party makeup, and restrained editorial doll beauty: a clean semi-matte base, more noticeable peach-pink blush over the cheeks and subtly beneath the eyes, fine elongated black eyeliner with a slight lift, clearly defined lashes, minimal deep eye-socket shading, fine natural brows, and muted nude-brown, dusty-rose, or gray-pink-brown lips. Preserve the reference's softly narrow facial proportions, refined jawline, almond-shaped eyes, natural nose proportions, and full but restrained lips without replacing her with any specific celebrity.  She looks straight upward into the camera with a calm, slightly tired, self-contained gaze. Her lips remain naturally closed or only faintly relaxed apart, without a clear smile. The expression should feel like someone who is completely aware of being photographed after the party has already happened, yet is not trying too hard to perform for the camera.  The most important gesture is one arm reaching aggressively upward toward the camera while offering a single banknote. Because the camera uses a close wide-angle viewpoint, preserve dramatic foreshortening: the hand, thumb, and bill should appear significantly larger than the face. Since the hand is extremely close to the lens, the nearest fingers and banknote may fall slightly out of focus and become slightly brighter or even mildly clipped by the flash. Do not correct this distortion. The other hand should cross the chest or abdomen while still moving, leaving a subtle motion smear that makes the photograph feel caught mid-action rather than completely frozen.  Layer multiple pearl necklaces with thin metallic chains around the neck. Allow one longer pearl strand to fall naturally across the black crop top, bending and overlapping beneath scattered bills. Add several fine rings to the fingers and a silver watchband, watch, or stack of metallic bracelets to the opposite wrist. The pearls and metal should catch tiny sharp white points of direct-flash reflection.  Photographically, emulate a smartphone rear wide camera or compact digital camera with near-axis direct flash, not a polished soft-lit studio setup. Use approximately a 24–35mm full-frame-equivalent perspective, with the camera roughly 0.8–1.3 meters above the body, in a tall vertical frame close to 3:5. Fire a strong direct flash almost exactly along the optical axis at around 5200–6000K. Let the flash dominate the scene: produce bright direct highlights on the forehead, nose, cheeks, arms, abdomen and thigh, while creating short, relatively defined shadows beneath the nose, chin, fingers, pearl strands and body edges.  The white bedding and pale paper should bounce part of the flash back into the subject, keeping the harder shadows from becoming completely black. At the same time, preserve very deep blacks in the hair and clothing, producing a strong graphic contrast against the almost blown-white bedding. The foreground hand, being closest to the flash, may appear brighter than the face and slightly overexposed.  Do not over-clean the photograph. Preserve direct-flash digital sharpening, a small amount of noise and social-media compression, uneven brightness across the white bedding, foreground softness, tiny blown highlights, motion trails, wrinkled sheets, randomly folded bills, chaotic hair, and slightly off-center framing. The face and torso should remain relatively crisp, while the nearest fingers and bill may be softer; most background notes should remain readable rather than disappearing into heavy bokeh.  She had already fallen into the scattered bills, and her hair had already spread across the bed. Several notes had landed on her body. Now she is pushing one directly toward the camera, while the other hand is still finishing its movement. A second later, that hand might cover the lens completely or throw the bill back onto the bed.  The final image should combine Y2K flash photography, alt-fashion, luxury parody, money-bed editorial imagery, and a private after-party bedroom snapshot. Keep it cool, visually excessive, slightly absurd, playfully boastful, and imperfect. It should feel like a real human being was suddenly photographed with direct flash—not like a pristine luxury campaign or a flawlessly polished AI render.

Create a sophisticated vertical editorial poster built around a clear three-part composition: top, middle, and bottom.

Each section must have a distinct visual role, but the final poster should feel like one continuous design rather than three stacked rectangular panels.

Use strong differences in scale, image density, typography, and negative space to establish hierarchy.

The top section should create the first visual anchor through a bold image, oversized typography, or a strong subject.

The middle section should act as the structural hinge of the composition. It can use a title, information field, narrow panoramic image, color band, or typography layer to connect the upper and lower sections.

The bottom section should provide a second visual weight or spatial conclusion through a landscape, object, secondary portrait, or oversized type.

Avoid rigid card-like boundaries. Let selected elements cross between sections through masking, overlap, irregular silhouettes, transparency, atmospheric transitions, foreground/background relationships, or typography extending beyond its original area.

Typography must actively participate in the composition rather than simply sit on top of the image. Allow large letterforms to be cropped by the page, partially hidden behind subjects, overlap imagery, or interact with negative space.

Use a strong editorial hierarchy:
one dominant title,
one clear secondary information layer,
and small meaningful metadata such as dates, venue, category, or curatorial text.

Small text should feel like real exhibition or editorial information, not decorative filler.

Keep some areas intentionally quiet. Do not fill every empty space.

The first read should communicate the main visual structure immediately.
The second read should reveal the interaction between type and imagery.
The third read should reveal the smaller information and details.

Maintain a refined contemporary poster aesthetic with strong typography, deliberate cropping, controlled information density, clean print texture, and professional editorial spacing.

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically transformed by the material or environment around it.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition and become part of the scene itself. Let the letterforms stretch, bend, split, compress or realign according to the chosen surface or optical medium.

For terrain, let it wrap across slopes, ridges and valleys.
For mirrors, distort the source typography so the reflection resolves into a readable word.
For water, use depth and refraction to shift and reconnect the letterforms.

Keep the spatial logic physically believable, with correct perspective, occlusion, reflections, refraction and surface contact.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference or observer within the typographic space.

提示词：

做一张 9:16 竖版东方文化艺术海报，核心方法是“强主体 + 巨型野字 + 明确动势”。

背景使用干净温暖的象牙白艺术纸，保留轻微纸张纹理。不要复杂背景，不要脏污做旧，不要模板化排版，让大面积留白成为画面的一部分。

画面里使用两个超大的黑色毛笔字作为主要视觉骨架。书法要粗重、野性、自由，带明显提按、飞白和真实墨迹边缘。两个字不要排得太工整，可以错位、压叠、上下呼应，部分笔画直接出画。

在画面中央放置一个强主体器物，主体必须足够大、轮廓足够清楚，并且有真实体积、材质和结构。主体可以是纸鸢、大鼓、折扇、长刃，或其他具有强识别度的东方器物。

最重要的是，让主体和野字发生一个一眼就能看懂的动态关系。不要只是把器物摆在字前面，而是让主体真正改变文字：可以破框、冲击、放射、斜切、拉开、穿插、推动，或者让笔画随着主体的方向和力量发生变化。

整体构图要有一条非常明确的动势线。可以是斜向破框、放射展开、正面冲击，或一条强烈的切割轴。让观众一眼就感到画面在“动”，而不是静态陈列。

版式上采用非对称编辑设计。中央区域负责“强主体 + 巨型野字 + 动势关系”，左右边缘再加入小尺寸展览信息、日期、地点和材质说明，让画面既有视觉冲击，也有文化展览海报的出版感。

加入少量自然手写英文标题，像设计师后来补上的注释。英文不要太大，主要起到节奏调节作用。可以再加入极少量朱红印章作为点缀，但不要堆太多装饰元素。

整体配色控制为暖象牙白、深墨黑，再加一个主体本身的主色。比如纸鸢可带少量朱砂红，大鼓可用深红鼓身，折扇可用米白加红刷痕，长刃则以冷银灰为主。颜色不要太杂。

最终效果要像高完成度的东方展览海报：主体够强，字够野，方向够明确，画面张力直接拉满。适合传统工艺、东方文化和展览视觉这类海报参考。

避免人物、普通产品广告、电商摆拍、国潮插画、红金节庆感、霓虹科技感、廉价 CGI，以及无意义的墨点堆积。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【核心主体】：
【左右关系】：巨物压场 / 图像窄带 × 宽文字场 / 主体 × 档案 / 图像越界 / 密集 × 留白 / 其他
【左侧内容】：
【右侧内容】：
【跨界元素】：器物轮廓 / 枝叶 / 大字 / 线稿 / 纹样 / 其他
【主色调】：
【强调色】：
【日期 / 场馆】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「左右构图 / 非对称双区构图」。

左右不要 50 / 50 平均切开，根据主体体量、文字密度和留白关系灵活使用 35 / 65、40 / 60、45 / 55 等比例。重点不是两侧面积相等，而是让图像重量、Typography 和信息密度达到视觉平衡。

根据主题灵活选择不同方式：

巨物压场：一侧放大尺度器物、文物或艺术对象，允许大胆裁切，占据主要视觉重量；另一侧通过标题、英文、小字、结构线稿和展讯建立阅读层级。

图像窄带 × 宽文字场：一侧使用修长古画、摄影或纹样切片，另一侧保留更大的纸面与 Typography。图像中的枝叶、飞鸟、云气或主体轮廓可主动越出画芯进入文字区。

主体 × 档案：一侧保持单一强主体，另一侧组合器型线稿、材质微距、拓片、纹样研究、尺寸、年代和少量说明文字，形成艺术图录感。

密集 × 留白：一侧通过图像、档案碎片和研究内容形成高密度视觉，另一侧保持大面积控制过的留白，只使用少量大字和关键展讯。留白不能只是“没有内容”，要通过字距、细线、位置和比例被精确设计。

左右边界不要过于机械。可以让器物边缘、大字、花枝、纹样或研究线条跨过分界约 3%–10%，把两侧重新连接起来，但避免随意拼贴。

Typography 必须根据每张画面的主体重新设计。可以使用超大单字、两字错位、完整横排标题、中等尺度标题、跨栏文字或局部反色。坚持“大字很大、小字很小”的尺度反差，减少无意义的中号字。不要固定使用四字纵排，也不要重复“两字横排 + 两字竖排”的模板。

信息密度参考成熟博物馆海报、Japanese Editorial Design 和 Art Catalogue。可加入英文副标题、年代、材质、工艺、场馆、日期、策展短句，以及 1–3 个与主题直接相关的研究节点，例如器型线稿、釉面微距、古画材料、纹样拓片、石纹研究或局部放大。

这些辅助信息必须服务主题，不要为了“显得专业”而堆随机小字。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色。优先使用骨白、墨黑、青瓷绿、石青石绿、深灰、赭色等克制色彩，再加入一个明确但面积很小的朱砂红或其他强调色。纸面保持干净，不使用脏黄仿古滤镜。

第一眼看到大型主体与左右重量关系；第二眼看到标题和主要色块；第三眼发现器物、古画或枝叶如何突破左右边界；最后再阅读材质、结构、年代与展览档案。

核心原则：一边负责压住视觉，一边负责承接阅读；留白也是重量，信息密度也是重量；左右不相等，但整体必须平衡。

整体要求：9:16，高清、清晰、纸面干净、主体质感真实、Typography 锐利、细线与小字尽可能清楚，信息丰富但不乱，具有成熟博物馆海报和艺术出版物完成度。

避免：机械五五分、简单左图右字、左右各放一个相似主体、主体过小、信息区像说明书、固定标题模板、PPT 信息框、复杂 UI、随机英文、严重做旧、斑驳噪点、画面编号、版权标识、四角星芒、sparkle 和低完成度 AI 海报感。

Prompt：

【主题】：____
【中文主标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【中心主体】：____
【压角方式】：四角文字压 / 双角对压 / 三角围压+一角释放 / 单角重压+对角回应
【角部元素】：大型中文字 / 色块 / 信息区 / 图案
【辅助纹样】：____
【主色调】：____
【强调色】：____
【日期 / 机构】：____
【比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟文化展览与 Editorial Graphic Design 气质的「压角构图」海报。

核心不是简单把文字放进四个角，而是利用画面边缘的大型 Typography、色块、信息区或图案向内部施加视觉压力，把中心主体自然“夹”出来。

中心主体保持完整、稳定、有明确视觉重量，不要为了配合构图故意倾斜或变形。主体约承担 40%–60% 的视觉重量。

根据【压角方式】组织版面：

四角文字压：
四个角都有视觉元素，但必须有明显主次，1–2 个角承担主要重量，其余角只做辅助，不要四角一样大。

双角对压：
选择两个对角作为主要压力点，让大型标题或色块从两个方向夹住主体，另外两角仅安排小型信息。

三角围压 + 一角释放：
三个角形成视觉包围，第四个角刻意保持较轻，让画面有呼吸感。

单角重压 + 对角回应：
一个角使用超大文字或强色块承担主要压力，对角只用较小元素回应，中间主体保持稳定。

大型中文标题必须真正参与构图，可局部裁边、贴边、与主体轻微叠压，但保持清晰可读。

英文标题、日期、机构、主题说明等小型文字集中在 2–3 个区域，通过超大中文、中号标题、极小信息形成明显字号层级。

背景不能完全空白，可加入与主题相关的极淡纹样、档案信息、结构图、材料纹理或说明残影，让留白“有内容”，但不能抢主体。

整张海报只使用一套主要辅助纹样，并且必须与主题产生真实关系,色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，同一张海报必须有明确色彩立场。

整体信息密度中等偏高，但视觉层级清楚：
第一眼看到主体和压角关系；
第二眼看到大型中文标题；
第三眼再阅读英文、日期和辅助信息。

每张海报需要有完整主题和真实内容表达，不要使用大量无意义占位词。即使去掉小字，也应该是一张成立的视觉作品。

整体效果：文化展览海报、杂志编辑设计、成熟印刷出版物感，边缘有压力、中心有聚焦，丰富但不乱。

生成一张 9:16 竖版、高完成度的中式极简当代艺术展览海报，作品主题为「荷尽听雨」。整体融合东方植物观察、现代 Editorial Exhibition Poster、抽象色域绘画、纸本艺术、自然档案与独立出版物视觉。

核心概念是“花已经退场，只剩枯荷、水面与不断落下的雨声”。不要表现盛开的荷花，不做传统荷塘国画，而要通过稀疏枯荷、水面色域、雨滴同心波纹和微型叙事表现晚秋之后安静、克制的时间感。

背景使用干净、温润的暖象牙白高品质艺术纸，仅保留非常轻微、均匀、细腻的天然纸纤维与压纹。纸张完整清洁，不泛黄、不做旧，不出现污渍、黑点、强颗粒、随机裂纹和破损。

构图采用“下部植物生长 + 中央雨纹扩散”的非对称结构。上方约 30% 保留开放暖白空间，中下部展开一块占画面约 40%–50% 的大型苔灰绿色抽象水域色块。

主色使用苔灰绿、低饱和灰橄榄、枯茶褐与极浅石灰绿。色彩低饱和但保持足够浓度和完整色面，具有矿物颜料、水粉、手工丝网印刷与艺术纸共同形成的细腻哑光质感。禁止脏灰、浑浊泥色和廉价复古滤镜。

色域边缘由柔和颜料扩散、手工刷痕、纸纤维吸水与少量自然缺口构成。内部加入 2–3 层非常轻微的苔绿与灰褐透明叠色、柔和水痕、少量纸面露白和低透明度水平水线，保持干净完整。

从画面底部以及左右局部边缘生长出约 7–12 根墨黑或深灰黑色枯荷茎。荷茎高低、粗细、方向自然变化，不均匀排列。部分细长直立，部分柔和弯折，所有线条连续完整、自然流畅。

只安排少量枯萎荷叶和 2–3 个莲蓬。荷叶形态残缺但线条完整，不做大量碎裂纹理。莲蓬结构清楚、比例自然。整体像经过精心提炼的植物观察线稿，而不是满屏传统水墨荷塘。

在主色域中央偏右设置一个主要雨滴落点，以 4–6 圈极细、连续、自然的同心水纹向外扩散。圆纹随着距离逐渐变淡、变细，其中最大一圈可以延伸接近色域边缘。

另外加入 2–3 个尺寸更小、透明度更低的雨纹，但数量必须克制。所有波纹具有真实水面扩散感，不形成完美数字几何圆、不发光、不像 UI 或图标。

在水域远处加入一叶非常小的旧舟，舟上无人，只作为安静的空间参照。在一根莲蓬或枯荷茎上停留一只极小黑色小鸟，只出现一只。水面边缘再加入一根半沉的旧木桩，使整个场景具有“无人，但曾经有人来过”的微型叙事。

画面上方暖白区域分散排布少量精致编辑信息，包括“POND FIELD NOTES”、“RAIN / STEM / WATER”、“LATE AUTUMN STUDY”、“2026.11”、“A STUDY OF WHAT REMAINS”等。使用小号 Serif、现代窄体、小型数字和宽松字距，具有高级自然观察档案与独立出版物的 Editorial 气质，不使用 UI 卡片。

中文主标题“荷尽听雨”使用黑色高瘦现代宋体或明朝体，四字纵向排列在画面右侧中上区域。字体清晰、修长、克制，与枯荷线条和色域产生自然构图关系。

标题附近加入小号英文副标题“AFTER THE LOTUS”，使用精致 Serif 大写字体并拉开字距。

画面边缘加入极细原创中文题跋：“花已经落尽，雨还在水面上写字。” 字号明显小于主标题，排版安静。

在苔灰绿色域边缘加入一小段极淡橄榄灰色自然手写英文“only the rain remains”，像观察者留下的现场笔记。

加入一枚面积极小、不规则的朱砂红印记，红色控制在整个画面 1% 以下。

整体保持明确的三层阅读：第一眼看到暖象牙白、苔灰绿色域和稀疏黑色枯荷；第二眼发现同心雨纹、莲蓬、小舟、小鸟和木桩；第三眼才注意日期、植物观察信息、题跋、手写笔记、纸纹和颜料细节。

最终呈现成熟艺术机构、文化展览、书籍装帧与东方编辑设计作品级完成度。极简但不简陋，植物感丰富但不做传统植物插画，安静但具有细节与时间感。

Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography becomes a functional mechanism inside the composition.

Make the main word extremely large, filling around 60–80% of the frame. Keep the typography clearly readable, but integrate a real working system inside or through the letters.

The mechanism should follow one continuous and understandable path across the word. For example, liquid can flow through the letters, gears can transfer movement, chains can transmit power, or light can pass through lenses and prisms.

Each part of the typography should have a clear function instead of using random mechanical details. Show realistic connections, materials, pressure, movement, reflections, shadows, and physical interaction so the system feels believable.

Connect the typography directly to the featured product. The product should act as the source, input, output, or final result of the mechanism rather than sitting separately beside the text.

Use realistic commercial photography, bold high-contrast colors, clean editorial composition, and a small amount of meaningful product information such as specs, callouts, labels, or a slogan.

Keep the information organized and secondary to the main typography and product.

The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual — bold, functional, colorful, precise, and visually complete.

Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Create a bold commercial campaign poster where the entire composition follows one clear direction of motion.

Capture the subject at a strong peak-action moment with believable anatomy, balance, weight, and momentum. Hair, clothing, limbs, equipment, and body posture should naturally follow the same movement.

Make the oversized main word a major part of this motion system rather than static background text. Arrange, rotate, curve, shift, or offset the typography according to the chosen movement direction.

For circular motion, let the letters wrap around the subject.
For diving or diagonal motion, stretch the type along the body trajectory.
For turning motion, curve the typography through perspective.
For sliding motion, shift large sections of the letters horizontally.

Keep the main word large, bold, and clearly readable even when transformed.

Create controlled foreground–subject–background layering. Some parts of the typography may sit behind the subject while selected sections move in front, making the person and type feel connected within the same space.

Use perspective and scale to strengthen the direction of motion, but avoid extreme distortion that damages the subject or product.

Use one high-saturation dominant color with one strong contrasting accent, plus black, white, or metallic neutrals. Keep the palette bold and controlled.

Add 2–3 compact information areas with meaningful campaign details such as product name, weight, material, performance feature, specification, or slogan, plus a clean footer.

The visual hierarchy should be: dynamic subject → motion direction → oversized typography → product → campaign details

Keep people, hands, hair, equipment, wheels, boards, gloves, and other products realistic and structurally correct.

The final image should feel like a finished high-energy editorial campaign — colorful, directional, dimensional, dynamic, and immediately readable in a social feed.

Create an authentic vertical 9:16 close-range smartphone portrait of an explicitly adult young woman, combining restrained classical East-Asian-inspired styling with the intimacy of a modern phone selfie. She is seated beside a window in a quiet private interior, leaning noticeably forward toward the lens. Place the camera extremely close, around slightly below face level or upper-chest height, using a mild upward angle. Reproduce the perspective of a 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone front camera: keep the face relatively natural while allowing the broad sleeve extending toward the camera to become visibly enlarged in the lower-right foreground.  Preserve a small, softly shaped natural face, slight real-world facial asymmetry, a clean but not artificially sharp jawline, and normally proportioned eyes. Her head tilts gently toward image-right, with the chin very slightly raised. She looks directly into the lens with relaxed eyelids and clear window catchlights in her dark irises. Her lips remain naturally closed, without an obvious smile. The expression should feel as though she has just leaned closer to glance at the phone and has not deliberately arranged her face for the photograph; the quiet feeling from the previous second still remains.  Use thin, low-saturation East-Asian costume-drama-inspired makeup: soft gray-brown brows, extremely fine brown-black inner eyeliner, light taupe mixed with muted dusty-rose eyeshadow, naturally elongated but not overly dense eyelashes, almost no visible nose contour, a trace of cool-pink cheek color, and softly blurred muted rose-pink lips. Avoid heavy contouring and obvious powder highlighter.  Her hair is long, mostly straight, and nearly black with a deep brown undertone, lightly tied or half-pinned behind the head. Leave irregular wispy long bangs across the forehead and several long strands beside the cheeks. Do not make the hair commercially perfect. Retain many tiny flyaway hairs around the crown, temples, ears, and silhouette. Strong real backlight from the upper-left turns these flyaways into thin silver-white lines, as if a mild draft disturbed the hair a moment earlier and it has not completely settled yet.  Add delicate small floral hair ornaments on both sides. On image-left, use pale petals with a few pastel blue and soft pink beads. On image-right, use a fine gold-toned structure with pearls and several small teardrop-shaped dangling beads. Keep them lightweight and refined. Do not add a visible necklace or large modern statement jewelry.  The adult figure is naturally slender. Visible skin includes the full face, neck, both shoulders, collarbones, the upper-chest area down to the garment edge, and only a small amount of upper-arm skin. The skin is fair with a neutral-to-slightly-warm undertone, while blue-gray environmental reflections introduce a subtle cyan-gray cast into the shadow side. The skin should visually and tactilely suggest fine, soft, mildly warm human skin: smooth but not waxy, with extremely subtle pores, tiny facial hairs, local tone variation, and natural softness rather than aggressive beauty filtering.  Dress her in a loose ivory or creamy off-white overlapping classical robe or lightweight Han-inspired garment, with broad sleeves and a naturally draped deep V-shaped neckline. The fabric is soft, lightweight, faintly translucent, and lightly wrinkled. Gravity and the forward-leaning posture cause the neckline to slip naturally off the shoulders, revealing the collarbones and upper chest. Keep the amount of exposed skin exactly within the reference range; do not increase the neckline or create exaggerated chest compression. At the waist, only a small portion of a desaturated pale blue-gray or mint-gray fabric sash is visible. The broad sleeve in the lower-right sits extremely close to the lens, becomes oversized from wide-angle perspective, and catches a bright patch of real sunlight.  Treat the illumination as physical light rather than vague “atmospheric lighting.” The only strong key light is genuine daylight from a real window located upper-left or upper-left-rear of the subject. Slightly cool-white direct sunlight strikes the hair, ear area, left shoulder, collarbones, and part of the foreground sleeve. Allow mild highlight clipping, especially across the left shoulder. Retain soft but clearly physical shadows beneath the chin and along the neck. The cool blue-gray walls act only as weak natural bounce, introducing a faint cyan-gray fill into shadow areas rather than eliminating the shadows. Do not introduce studio three-point lighting, artificial fill lamps, or fake rim lights.  The background is an ordinary quiet private interior rather than a designed set. Use low-saturation cool blue-gray walls and a simple wall-to-ceiling transition, with only a narrow dark edge of a cabinet, doorframe, or furniture piece along image-right. Keep decoration minimal. The background should sit approximately one to two stops darker than the subject and fall gently out of focus while still retaining believable room geometry.  The final photograph should feel like a casual window-side image taken in the morning or earlier part of the day: cool, quiet, soft, restrained, slightly half-awake. The visual tension comes from classical hair ornaments and clothing appearing inside a very modern close smartphone perspective. Preserve accidents and imperfections: flyaway hair, uneven shoulder height, slightly displaced neckline, mild highlight clipping, subtle phone sharpening, tiny digital noise, mild compression texture, slight framing drift, natural facial asymmetry, and foreground wide-angle distortion. She had already leaned into the light; she is looking into the lens now; in the next second she may look away or sit upright again. The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual — bold, colorful, concept-driven, and visually complete.

Avoid generic “subject + big text” layouts, random distortion, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, heavy 3D typography, decorative sparkles, clutter, and effects that do not match the chosen physical force.

生成一张具有强设计感和文化展览气质的「中轴夹景」海报。画面建立清晰稳定的垂直中轴，让左右两侧的视觉元素共同把视线推向中央。两侧不只是做对称装饰，而是真正参与主题表达，可以是人物、水袖、烟气、器物、建筑、投影、材质轮廓，或者同一主题的不同状态。

根据主题灵活选择夹景方式：
人物动作可以用姿态、衣袖、布料和身体曲线夹出中央负形；
光影投射可以让两侧阴影或亮面对中央形成收束；
正负对照可以用原版与成品、实体与印痕、反刻与正印形成中轴关系；
烟雾气流可以让两股连续上升或回旋的线条围绕中央；
实体轮廓则通过器物、建筑或自然形态的边缘共同围出中心区域。

标题必须是画面核心，并且真正参与构图。可以使用大字纵排、横排、错位排版、上下拆分或跨区排版，不要每次都套用同一种“四字标题”格式。文字允许和主体轻微穿插、遮挡、贴边，但要保持清晰可读。

整体信息密度要比普通海报更丰富，可在中轴、边栏和底部加入少量展览信息，也可以增加一个小型研究模块，例如动作轨迹、工艺步骤、气流变化或结构示意，让画面更像成熟的 museum poster 和 editorial design。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，形成明确的大色块关系。画面第一眼要看到左右视觉力量和中轴聚焦，第二眼读到标题，第三眼发现构图方法与主题之间的联系。

整体要求：高级、清晰、完整、层次丰富、具有视觉冲击，避免机械对称、固定模板感、PPT 式信息框、无意义装饰、斑驳噪点、文字模糊和低完成度 AI 感。

设计一张9:16竖版艺术展览海报，融合克里姆特风格的装饰绘画与日式美术馆编辑排版。让服饰和背景通过纹样连接，人物面部保留油画体积，巨型中文标题直接参与构图。

以原创成年人物半身肖像作为主视觉，大幅裁切部分头发、肩部与衣袖。面孔位于上半部，根据人物朝向安排偏左或偏右构图。利用肩背、披肩或宽袖形成一个明确的大形，建立斜向、弧形或纵向的画面动势。若出现手部，确保手指、手腕、前臂连接自然，动作简洁，不被标题遮挡。

面部以赭石、灰粉、冷灰与暗红的小块油画笔触塑造，颜色随骨骼转折变化，保留底色露出和虚实边缘。面部与手部笔触较细，头发、衣料、背景更自由。避免摄影磨皮、光滑数字渐变，以及整张图覆盖同一种厚涂纹理。

服饰以所填主色形成宽阔、连贯的色块，用少量衣褶交代身体与织物的体积，其余区域逐渐转为平面装饰。让所填纹样顺着肩背、衣袖、披肩弧度或衣褶方向展开，局部越过衣服轮廓，延伸进背景，使人物与环境属于同一幅绘画。

纹样有主次、大小与疏密变化，避免等距重复。面孔和手部附近保持安静，袖部、肩背与画幅边缘可以更丰富。植物、羽毛等元素需转化为平面图案，避免变成手持道具或真实物件堆叠。

以哑金、黄赭、米白、暗铜或黑褐色组织装饰细节，保留颜料叠压、刷痕与细微印刷颗粒。金色面积服从主色调，不让每张都变成满版金底。浅色主题使用深色枝线与黑字，深色主题使用米白文字，并保留衣料暗部层次。避免镜面金属、立体浮雕、珠宝镶嵌和发光特效。

将中文展名设计成修长、粗细对比明显的宋体或明朝体巨字。根据人物与衣料的大形，采用沿边纵排、横竖错落或局部横跨的编排，文字直接叠印绘画，不放进独立标题框。保护面孔、手部与关键动作，主要字形完整准确，复杂汉字不拆分、不拼接、不变形。

顶部以细长英文字体排列英文展名。底部直接叠印展讯，以醒目日期、中型场馆名称、紧密小型说明构成三级尺度。文字组共享清楚的对齐线，落在相对安静的绘画区域，不设置独立色块底栏。所有展讯完整留在画幅内，保留安全边距。

整体呈现艺术作品复制图与成熟展览排版相结合的观感。缩小观看时，面孔、服饰主色块和巨字清楚；放大后可见笔触、织物纹样与展讯细节。系列中统一绘画语言、字体气质和展讯格式，通过人物姿态、明暗、纹样与衣料方向产生变化。

只输出单张满版平面海报，仅使用填写的文字。不要添加随机外文、虚构赞助商、编号、四角星芒、水印、画框、墙面或展示样机。

生成一张具有 **East Asian Contemporary Exhibition Poster、Japanese Experimental Graphic Design、Editorial Art Direction、Four-Corner Typographic Composition** 气质的当代实验海报。

核心采用“四角巨字构图”：将【四字中文标题】拆成四个巨大汉字，分别作为左上、右上、左下、右下的视觉锚点。四个字不要机械等大、等距或形成四宫格，应通过不同字号、裁切、出血、字重和位置建立不对称但稳定的版面张力。

画面中央设置一个具有强视觉识别度的【主视觉主体】，主体必须足够大，并真正参与 Typography，而不是简单放在四个字中间。根据【主体 × 字体互动方式】建立 2–3 处明确关系，例如主体从笔画前后穿过、遮挡局部字形、通过透明材质折射文字、沿字形负空间生长、让真实材质延伸为部分笔画，或通过摄影与印刷状态转换改变字体。所有互动都要“意外但合理”，同时保证汉字仍然可以辨认。

每张作品只选择一种最强的视觉机制作为核心，不要同时堆叠折射、流体、穿透、颗粒、透明和复杂特效。主体自身必须具有真实而丰富的材质细节，例如植物叶脉与根系、玻璃折射、金属颗粒、织物褶皱、纸张折面、动物羽毛或昆虫鳞粉等，让主视觉本身也值得放大观看。

Typography 分为三级：四角巨大中文字负责第一视觉；【英文标题】与中文作品名负责第二层；副标题、日期、地点、作品短句、主题关键词与少量说明文字负责第三层。使用明显的字号反差、横排与竖排变化、不对称对齐、细线与紧凑字距建立成熟的编辑设计感。信息密度保持中高，但不要平均填满画面，应形成“局部密集 × 局部安静”的节奏。

整体使用【背景主色】作为大面积色域，【字体主色】建立稳定结构，【强调色】只用于主体、细线、日期或极少量印刷标记。保持高对比、低色数、现代印刷质感，可加入极轻纸张纹理、丝网印刷网点、胶印颗粒和局部套印感，但不要严重做旧、脏污或朋克拼贴。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到四角巨大汉字与主体形成的强大形；第二眼发现主体真的改变、穿越或参与了字体结构；第三眼观察真实材质、遮挡、折射或空间关系；最后阅读【英文标题】与少量展览信息。

整体作品应像真实的当代艺术展览海报、实验平面设计年鉴、文化视觉或独立艺术出版物，而不是普通“主体图片 + 四角文字”的模板。

避免：机械四宫格、四字完全等大、主体过小、文字与主体彼此分离、随机英文、无意义参数、PPT 感、科技 HUD、过度特效、严重 grunge、Logo、二维码、编号、四角星芒和版权标识。

Create a visually powerful composition with opposing forces, intricate engravings, and elegant editorial design.

Create a highly realistic vertical outdoor environmental portrait, approximately 9:16. An adult young woman around 20–25 stands very close to the camera in front of a traditional old-street jewelry stall surrounded by dense green climbing plants and blooming pink roses. Her upper body leans gently toward the lens, her arms resting naturally close together in front of her torso. Her head tilts slightly toward viewer-left while her chin lifts just a little. Photograph her from slightly below eye level, approximately upper-chest or shoulder height, producing a subtle upward perspective without exaggerated wide-angle distortion.

Preserve a naturally small oval face, soft jawline and realistic facial proportions. Her eyes look softly toward the camera with relaxed eyelids, and her lips remain closed with only the corners slightly lifted, as though she had smiled a moment ago and the emotional afterglow was still there. Use translucent, understated makeup inspired by contemporary soft East Asian portrait aesthetics: thin natural foundation with visible skin texture, softly shaped brows, subtle light-brown eye shadow, fine eyeliner, separated lashes, a faint pink flush around the cheeks and under-eye area, and muted nude-pink or rose-pink lips. Avoid heavy influencer or glamour makeup.

Her hair is natural deep black to dark brown-black, loosely tied back with thin wispy bangs falling across her forehead. Leave irregular loose strands around the cheeks, jaw and neck. Place a tiny white floral or crystal-flower hair clip on the viewer-right side of her hair. The hairstyle should remain slightly imperfect and asymmetrical rather than professionally polished. Strong natural backlight passes through the outer flyaway hairs, creating delicate silvery, almost translucent glowing strands.

She wears an oversized very pale sky-blue or icy-blue long-sleeved button-up shirt. The shirt has slipped naturally off both shoulders, while the collar and front opening fall outward into a broad loose V-shaped overlap. Clearly visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, both shoulders, clavicles and upper chest, while most of the arms remain covered by the long sleeves. The waist, abdomen, hips, legs, back and buttocks are not visibly exposed. Keep a slender but realistic adult body shape without exaggerating chest, waist or hip proportions. The shirt should feel like soft matte cotton or a cotton blend, with authentic gravity-driven folds, wrinkles and bunching. Only a small amount of black lower clothing appears at the bottom edge.

Her skin is fair with a neutral to slightly cool undertone. Areas touched by direct sunlight become softly warm ivory, while shadows carry a faint cool-pink cast. Preserve subtle pores and realistic micro-texture. The skin should visually suggest a soft, supple, warm surface with very fine natural texture, rather than porcelain, wax or aggressively smoothed skin.

Use real bright afternoon sunlight. The sun comes from the upper-left and slightly behind her, grazing the outer hair, facial edge, shoulder and collarbone and producing genuine back-side highlights and luminous hair rims. Her face is filled mostly by open-sky light and environmental bounce, so delicate shadows remain around the eyes, nose and chin. Do not use a studio softbox, artificial rim light or perfect three-point lighting. Allow a small cyan-green lens flare or optical ghost on the left side of the frame caused by shooting toward the light.

The background is a traditional old-street or tourist market. Behind her is a charcoal-gray tiled roof and a dark brown wooden jewelry stall. Beneath the eaves hang rows of beads, pendants, small ornaments and souvenirs, with additional jewelry scattered across display counters. Dense green climbing foliage surrounds the upper frame, covered in numerous pink climbing roses. The top leaves and flowers catch direct sunlight, while the stall beneath the roof remains noticeably darker, creating authentic outdoor contrast.

Keep the depth of field moderately shallow rather than extreme. Her face and upper body remain clearly resolved, while the flowers, foliage and hanging jewelry soften slightly yet remain recognizable. Aim for the visual feel of roughly f/2 to f/3.5. The camera should resemble either a high-quality smartphone main camera or a compact mirrorless camera used casually, with a natural 35–50mm full-frame-equivalent feeling or the mild close-range perspective of a smartphone main lens. Keep the image clear but not excessively sharp.

Preserve human photographic imperfections: stray hair, fabric wrinkles, small compositional imbalance, slightly tilted architecture, uneven background clutter, minor digital grain and optical flare. Do not polish the frame into a perfectly symmetrical commercial beauty advertisement.

She had just paused beside the flower-covered jewelry stall on the old street, and sunlight had already filtered through the leaves behind her. Now she leans a little closer to the camera with a restrained smile, as though she might straighten up and continue walking one second later. The final image should feel like a fresh, intimate and slightly nostalgic sunny-afternoon memory: summer afternoon, flowers in the old street, caught between one smile and the next.

【主题】：____

【曲线构图方式】：曲线大字 / 曲面翻折 / 螺旋拼贴 / 曲线串联 / 其他
【辅助素材】：____
【主色调】：____
【辅助色】：____
【点缀色】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有强设计感的曲线构图海报，整体采用 Contemporary Editorial Poster × Postmodern Graphic Design × Cultural Exhibition Poster 的视觉语言。

先确定一条最重要的主曲线，再围绕它组织主体、Typography、图片、信息和留白。曲线不是装饰，而是整张海报的视觉骨架与阅读路径。

根据内容选择一种主要曲线方式：

曲线大字：让大型 Typography 本身发生拉伸、弯折、裁切和出框，字形直接成为曲线主视觉。

曲面翻折：让纸张、织物、建筑面或其他可弯曲实体形成巨大曲面，并把文字、图片和信息直接放在曲面上，随透视自然弯曲。

螺旋拼贴：用一条开放式螺旋路径串联照片、票据、文字、人物和小型视觉节点，从外围逐渐引导到核心。

曲线串联：用一条连续 S 型或弧形主线穿过多个不同尺度的视觉节点，让原本分散的图片、人物和文字形成完整叙事。

整张海报只保留一个最强曲线方向，其他线条和元素只能跟随或平衡主曲线，不制造新的视觉竞争。

主标题必须参与构图，可顺着曲线错位、跨区、裁切、局部遮挡或改变尺度，不要只是整齐放在顶部。

画面允许摄影、插画、手写、色块、纸张、票据等 2–3 种视觉语言发生碰撞，但所有素材必须围绕同一条曲线路径组织，避免随机贴纸式拼贴。

控制明显的视觉层级：第一眼看到主曲线和主视觉；第二眼看到大标题；第三眼沿曲线路径阅读图片和信息；最后才看到日期、地点和极小辅助文字。

保留大面积有效留白，允许不对称、裁切、尺度失衡、局部出框和轻微套色偏移，让版式具有松动但有秩序的后现代编辑设计感。

色彩控制在 3–5 种，以一个大面积主色、一个强对比色和少量点缀色建立识别度。

整体要求：曲线明确、视觉抓眼、信息丰富但不杂乱、有人工排版感、有设计学院和艺术出版物气质。

Prompt : Create a visually stunning 20-second surreal science-fiction mystery film using the four supplied images as environmental references. Maintain the same abandoned motel, dense turquoise-green fog, glowing orange-red neon, vintage CRT monitors, hanging cables, and atmospheric analog technology throughout.
SHOT 01 | 00:00–00:02 | THE MOTEL
Extreme wide cinematic shot. A solitary man in a long dark coat approaches an isolated roadside motel through thick rolling cyan fog. The red MOTEL sign flickers overhead. Wet asphalt reflects the neon. Slow low-angle dolly forward.
SHOT 02 | 00:02–00:04 | THE CALL
Interior macro close-up. A dusty black rotary telephone suddenly rings on an abandoned reception desk. Its cable lies unplugged beside it. A small red indicator light blinks in perfect rhythm with the ringing.
SHOT 03 | 00:04–00:06 | THE INSTRUCTION
Tight profile shot of the man lifting the telephone receiver. Through crackling analog static, a distorted recording of his own voice whispers: "Channel nine." His eyes slowly shift toward a glowing terminal in the darkness.
SHOT 04 | 00:06–00:08 | THE FREQUENCY
Extreme close-up of his fingers rotating a large metallic tuning dial. The terminal displays "CH 09". Its screen erupts with white static, then reveals a quiet, sunlit road outside the motel. Warm golden light spills onto his fingers.
SHOT 05 | 00:08–00:10 | THE IMPOSSIBLE WINDOW
A dramatic wide shot reveals an enormous wall of stacked CRT televisions. Every screen shows dense blue-green fog except one central television displaying brilliant golden daylight. The man stands silhouetted before the glowing screens. Slow symmetrical camera push-in.
SHOT 06 | 00:10–00:12 | THE DISCOVERY
Side-profile close-up. The man gently places his palm against the sunlit television. Instead of solid glass, the screen ripples like liquid mercury. Warm sunlight illuminates his face while the surrounding room remains cold and green.
SHOT 07 | 00:12–00:14 | THE CROSSING
Smooth over-the-shoulder tracking shot. The man steps carefully through the glowing television surface. The golden light envelops him. The surrounding CRT screens flicker simultaneously as he disappears into the image.
SHOT 08 | 00:14–00:17 | THE ESCAPE
Cut to the exterior. The man emerges onto the empty motel road, now bathed in beautiful golden morning sunlight. The thick fog slowly dissolves. He looks at the open sky, visibly relieved. The camera gently orbits him as natural birdsong replaces the electrical humming.
SHOT 09 | 00:17–00:20 | THE TWIST
The camera suddenly pulls backward, faster and faster. The beautiful sunlit road shrinks into the curved glass of a vintage CRT television. We are still inside the original dark control room. The same man's silhouette sits motionless in a chair, watching his own escape on Channel 09.
The screen flickers once.
Cut to black.
VISUAL LANGUAGE:
Photorealistic 35mm film, vintage anamorphic lenses, dense volumetric fog, deep emerald shadows, icy cyan highlights, orange-red neon, physical CRT bloom, subtle halation, wet reflective textures, realistic analog machinery. Precise cinematic blocking, striking silhouettes, slow controlled camera movement, seamless transitions, no artificial-looking CGI.
SOUND DESIGN:
Wind through deserted streets, rotary telephone ringing, magnetic tape hiss, electronic frequency sweeps, low atmospheric synthesizer drone, gentle birdsong during the apparent escape, and a final single CRT shutdown click.
CONTINUITY:
One adult male protagonist, consistent dark coat and hairstyle. No children, violence, injury, dangerous actions, or threatening figures. No narration or subtitles. Only minimal diegetic screen text. Exactly nine shots, totaling 20 seconds.

Prompt:

TITLE: [VOLUME / ANGLE / FOLD / CUT / your own title]
MODEL: [model appearance, hairstyle, attitude]
GARMENT: [sculptural couture / architectural tailoring / oversized outerwear / flowing fashion]
TYPE INTERACTION: [overlap / cut through / frame / conceal / pass through / wrap around]
PALETTE: [neutral base + black + one strong accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a premium high-fashion editorial poster where the model, garment, typography and negative space are designed as one composition.

Start with a strong fashion silhouette rather than a conventional standing pose. Give the model a confident, detached editorial attitude and a clear body gesture such as a long stride, torso twist, asymmetric stance or controlled mid-motion pose. The clothing should have a distinctive sculptural shape through oversized volume, architectural shoulders, exaggerated draping, sharp tailoring or large folded fabric planes. Prioritize silhouette and garment structure over simple facial beauty.

Keep the studio environment minimal and refined, using a clean ivory, stone grey or muted neutral background. Build the palette around strong black-and-white contrast with only one controlled accent color such as cobalt blue, scarlet red or muted coral. Keep skin tones natural and realistic, with visible fabric texture, believable folds and polished fashion lighting.

Typography must actively participate in the image rather than sit beside the photograph. Use one dominant oversized word or letterform with extreme scale, paired with very small editorial copy. Let the type overlap the body, disappear behind clothing, reappear through negative space, cross between the model’s limbs, become a frame, or function like an architectural structure the model moves through. Partial cropping and controlled obstruction are encouraged as long as the main word remains recognizable.

Mix one strong display typeface with restrained supporting typography: high-contrast serif, bold grotesk sans serif, small clean sans serif or a subtle italic serif. Keep secondary copy sparse and purposeful. Avoid filling every empty area with text.

Maintain generous negative space, asymmetric balance, strong silhouette readability and a clear visual hierarchy. The first impression should come from one memorable visual event: a giant letter containing the model, typography slicing across a black silhouette, sculptural fabric interrupting a word, or oversized type interacting with a moving body.

The finished image should feel like sophisticated contemporary fashion art direction — bold, elegant, graphic, expensive and editorial, with the polish of a premium magazine cover or fashion campaign.

Prompt:

Create a complete 4-page IP design proposal for an original character brand.

[IP Name]:
[Core Character]:
[Character Personality]:
[World / Brand Concept]:
[Primary Colors]:
[Secondary Accent Colors]:
[Material Direction]:
[Visual Tone]: quirky, collectible, editorial, premium, design-forward
[Language]: English
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16 vertical

Build one consistent visual identity across all pages, with the same character proportions, facial features, signature accessories, color system, typography, materials, and proposal layout. Use a premium editorial case-study style with a small brand lockup, irregular dark chapter tab, slim vertical navigation, asymmetric footer, controlled whitespace, fine annotations, and subtle cut / fold geometry. Keep the layout rich in detail but clean and professionally art-directed.

Page 1 — Character Identity
Present one large hero character, 3–4 key identity anchors, silhouette tests, shape-language studies, and front / side / back turnaround views. Clearly establish what makes the character recognizable. Include only meaningful design notes, no fake parameters or generic character-profile data.

Page 2 — Design Development
Show the character-design process through rough shape exploration, 2D sketches, clay model, 3D wireframe, partial scan-style construction view, proportion studies, seam or structural logic, exploded anatomy, rejected silhouette alternatives, and material close-ups. Make the page feel like a real character-design development board rather than a futuristic HUD.

Page 3 — World & Story
Place the character inside a fully designed environment derived from the same visual language. Include one strong hero scene, one smaller interaction scene, a concise form-evolution study, and a few material or spatial details. The environment should feel like a natural extension of the character rather than an unrelated backdrop.

Page 4 — Extensions & Packaging
Create several clearly different character variations based on specific tasks, tools, outfits, or use cases while keeping the core identity unchanged. Add one premium collectible packaging or product application and a small extension-logic diagram showing how the character can scale into a commercial IP system.

Across all pages, vary the internal composition instead of repeating the same grid. Use large, medium, small, and micro visual scales to create rhythm. Let sketches, 3D renders, annotations, close-ups, materials, and product applications work together as design evidence.

The final result should feel like a real creative-agency IP proposal: distinctive character identity, visible design process, coherent worldbuilding, storytelling potential, and believable commercial extension.

Avoid generic PPT layouts, rigid card grids, childish scrapbook styling, meaningless English, fake technical data, excessive handwriting, decorative stickers, sparkles, page numbers, watermarks, inconsistent character features, or changing the character into different species across pages.

title: character-design process through rough shape exploration

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, strong high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large and let it perform a clear optical function:

 FOCUS: shift parts of the subject from soft blur into sharp focus.

 PRISM: let light pass through the typography and split into a few controlled colors.

The optical effect should physically interact with the person or product while keeping faces, bodies, and product structures realistic and intact.

Create clear foreground, subject, and background layering, with some typography passing behind the subject and other parts entering the foreground.

Use one dominant high-impact color with black, white, and one or two controlled accent colors. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specs, or small editorial labels.

Keep lighting, reflections, focus, magnification, and refraction believable. The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual — bold, colorful, optical, and visually complete.

Create a striking literary book cover combining sophisticated optical illusions, intricate vintage engraving, and elegant editorial typography.

Composition & Optical Illusion

Merge two distinct subjects into one unified composition using figureground reversal, shared contours, interlocking silhouettes, and clever negative space.

Let one subject's outline reveal or define the other, creating a doubleimage illusion that rewards a second look.

Use flowing curves, asymmetrical balance, and seamless visual transitions. Both subjects must remain recognizable.

Engraving & Details

Apply intricate scratchboard engraving, delicate crosshatching, and rich grayscale shading.

Render hair, facial features, fur, feathers, architecture, or natural textures with precise directional lines.

Combine richly detailed focal areas with bold silhouettes and clean negative spaces. Strong visual impact from a distance, exquisite details up close.

Color & Atmosphere

Use deep black, warm ivory, and layered charcoalgray tones. Add a tiny amount of the selected accent color to one meaningful detail.

Maintain a mysterious, poetic atmosphere with refined matte print texture.

Typography

Include an elegant serif tagline at the top, a large italic serif title integrated into the artwork, the author's name in uppercase serif lettering, and a small "A NOVEL" label below.

Ensure accurate spelling, elegant spacing, and clear readability.

Final Requirements

Prioritize visual duality, shared boundaries, intricate engraving, and sophisticated literary design.

Output one complete, flat 9:16 book cover, without mockups.

【异形图像方式】：不规则窗口 / 主体破框 / 局部切片 / 图像融合
【压角方式】：巨字残片 / 双角压入 / 主体破框 / 图形压角
【辅助视觉系统】：____

【主色调】：____
【强调色】：____
【日期 / 机构】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有强烈编辑设计感和文化展览气质的高密度海报。核心目标不是减少信息，而是通过明确的视觉层级，让大型中文、异形主图、线条、图形、小型信息和背景纹理同时存在，形成“乱中有序”的版式效果。

先确定 1 个绝对主视觉锚点，再设置 2–3 个次级视觉锚点。主视觉可以采用异形裁切、轮廓窗口、局部破框或图像融合，不要只是普通矩形照片。大型中文标题必须真正参与构图，可从边缘压入、局部裁切、与主图遮挡穿插，成为版面结构的一部分，而不是简单贴在图片旁边。

信息密度保持中高，加入中英文标题、日期、机构、短说明、竖排文字、局部图例、数据、坐标、线条或小型图像切片，但不同元素必须具有明显尺度差异。超大字、中号标题和极小信息之间形成强烈字号跳跃，不要所有文字大小接近，也不要把内容平均分散到整个画面。

整张海报只使用一套与主题相关的辅助视觉语言。例如城市主题使用路线与街区图形，观念主题使用流线与图像残片，自然主题使用植物线稿与标本信息，气象主题使用等压线、风向和雷达图。不要同时堆入多套无关装饰。

背景也必须参与设计，可以加入极淡的纹样、地图、结构图、档案文字、数据残影或材料纹理，让留白区域有内容，但背景层必须明显弱于主体。

允许文字压图、图像破框、线条跨区、小图切片叠入版面，通过局部遮挡和不完全对齐增加后现代编辑感，但所有元素必须围绕同一个视觉中心组织。整体保持 1 个主锚点 + 2–3 个次锚点，避免真正散乱。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，建立明确色彩立场，可使用高饱和主色搭配黑白，也可以采用统一单色体系。不要让多个高饱和色平均竞争。

阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到主体和大型压角文字；第二眼发现异形图像、图形与线条关系；第三眼再阅读日期、说明、数据和边缘信息。

最终效果像成熟的文化展览海报、设计学院视觉或编辑类出版物：信息丰富、层级复杂、局部碰撞，但缩小后依然拥有清晰视觉中心。不要做成信息图PPT，也不要为了“复杂”随机填满画面。

Create a 2:3 vertical extreme close-up portrait of a clearly adult woman leaning toward the camera through a full transparent pane of wet glass. Her face occupies more than 80% of the image, with the camera physically positioned on the opposite side of the glass. The pane had already fogged over: cover it with irregular condensation beads of many different sizes, fine mist, larger drops actively running downward, translucent trails, minor smears and a few partially cleared contact marks. All of this moisture must exist physically in front of the subject rather than appearing as sweat directly on her skin.  She wears narrow oval to slightly rectangular dark charcoal sunglasses with a very thin silver metal frame and fine temples, including believable irregular reflections. Her head is subtly tilted back and turned a little to one side, her face almost touching the glass. Her mouth is naturally open and her tongue is fully extended downward toward the pane, approaching or lightly touching it. The moment should feel mischievous and spontaneous rather than carefully choreographed: the glass had already become wet, she is pressing close to it now, and a second later one of the larger droplets might slide farther down and leave another trail.  Preserve natural facial proportions and small asymmetries instead of converting her into a generic beauty-model face. Use a light to light-warm beige complexion with believable peach-pink circulation, natural brows, an almost invisible base and muted rosy-pink lips with real moist lip texture. Keep the makeup in a restrained 1990s/Y2K fashion-beauty language. Because the sunglasses conceal the eyes, avoid dramatic lashes, heavy eyeliner or colorful eye makeup.  Skin should retain visible pores, tiny tonal variations, faint freckles and minor imperfections. Its tactile impression should read as soft, warm, subtly velvety human skin rather than polished plastic. Contrast that apparent warmth with the cool wet sensation created by the pane directly in front of her.  Her medium-to-deep warm brown hair falls loosely around the face with soft natural waves and a few untidy flyaways. A hard warm beam of natural sunlight enters from the upper-right/right side, passing through stray hair and striking the forehead, nose bridge, cheek and nose tip with uneven golden highlights. The opposite side falls naturally into softer shadow. Behind her, keep the environment unidentified and heavily defocused, reduced to a cool cyan, sky-blue and gray-blue field that supplies only weak ambient fill. Let the warm directional light physically refract through the condensation droplets, breaking into tiny specular fragments, irregular bright patches and subtle distortions. Do not use perfect studio fill, symmetrical softboxes or a clean artificial rim light.  Photograph it with the perspective of an approximately 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent wide lens or a smartphone main camera at very close focusing distance. Position the camera almost against the glass and slightly below eye level, looking subtly upward. The proximity should naturally enlarge the nose, mouth and tongue slightly without producing grotesque distortion. Use extreme close framing with imperfect centering: allow some hair to be accidentally clipped near the top and let the lower face, neck and body disappear naturally beyond the frame.  The face and a portion of the foreground condensation should both remain readable, but do not make every pore and every droplet equally razor sharp. Allow natural close-focus inconsistencies and a softly blurred blue background. Preserve slight glass dirt, sensor grain, mild digital sharpening, imperfect exposure, flyaway hairs and uneven water patterns so the image feels physically photographed by a human rather than rendered as flawless CGI.  Do not invent body areas outside the reference framing. The waist, hips and legs are entirely absent. The chest is essentially outside the image as well; at most, allow a tiny fragment of neck, shoulder, clavicle or upper-chest skin at the bottom edge, still obscured by wet glass and cropping. Clothing should remain almost invisible, with only a minimal black or deep-brown shadow of fabric near the edge if needed.  The final atmosphere should combine Y2K sunglasses styling, wet-glass editorial photography and imperfect smartphone-candid realism: humid, heated, playful, intimate and faintly rebellious. The lens feels almost close enough to touch her, yet the wet transparent pane always remains a tangible physical barrier. 整体以温润米白宣纸为背景，保留细腻纸张纤维、轻微旧印刷颗粒和自然纸本质感。使用低饱和古典设色，并以【主色调】建立一个明显的大面积视觉区域，再用极少量朱砂红印章点睛。

prompts.text:
一个人说谎的时候，你其实是看不出来的。

除非有人替你把他的脸切开。

「光感」专栏第 1 种：阴阳脸。

做法很简单：光源和镜头成 90 度，从正侧面打。一半脸亮，一半脸黑。

但简单的东西最容易做废。大部分人做出来的只是"有点暗的侧光"，不是阴阳脸。

差别只在一件事上：明暗分界线的位置。

它必须精确压在鼻梁中线上。偏一点点，观众看到的是"一个被侧光打的人"；压准了，观众看到的是"两个人"。

为什么压在鼻梁上就不一样？

因为人脸是对称的。分界线正好落在对称轴上时，大脑会同时完成两次识别——一次基于亮面，一次基于暗面——然后发现这两次的结论对不上。

那一瞬间的不适，就是"表里不一"。

第二个做废的点：暗面留了太多细节。

暗面必须真的掉到黑，光比拉到 8:1 以上。你一补光，"两个人"就变回"一个人站在阴影里"，全白做。

中文Prompt：
光源与镜头成 90 度侧打，明暗分界线精确压在鼻梁中线，暗面无补光落到纯黑，光比 8:1，硬光源，不加轮廓光，背景暗于人物亮面

English:
hard key at 90° to camera, shadow line falling exactly along the bridge of the nose, unlit half dropping to pure black with zero fill, 8:1 ratio, no rim light, background darker than the lit side

负向：soft fill light, even illumination, flattering portrait light, rim light on the shadow side

用在哪：他说一句表里不一的台词时，切这一颗。一场戏里出现一次就够。

用多了它就不是揭露，是风格。风格是不吓人的。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】
【主标题】
【主色域】
【微场景】
【人物动作】
【文化元素】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】

设计一张具有现代东方编辑美学的文化活动海报，以「大色域 + 微场景」作为核心构成方法，并融合纸本拼贴、水彩与天然颜料的材料质感。

画面首先建立一个清晰而有视觉重量的【主色域】。使用大面积、不规则、具有自然边缘的纸本色块承担主要构图，根据【海报主题】让色块通过层叠、围合、错位、穿插、悬挂、延伸或负空间关系形成抽象空间。色块可以暗示山势、庭院、工坊、染布、陶窑、林地等，但不要直接画成普通写实场景。

纸本色块必须具有明显而高级的真实材料感：天然长短纤维、手工纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、轻微压痕、自然浓淡、大尺度色差与不规则撕纸边缘。材质丰富但整体保持干净、完整、哑光、有呼吸感。避免脏污、黄斑、严重褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和廉价仿古效果。

大色域是画面的第一视觉。远看时应首先看到清楚的大形、色彩关系和空间结构，即使缩小成社交媒体信息流尺寸仍然具有明显识别度。不要依赖细小文字或复杂细节才能成立。

在大片色块形成的空间中加入一个尺度很小但叙事完整的【微场景】。人物与道具整体只占画面约 2%–5%，人物正在真实地执行【人物动作】，不直视镜头、不摆拍。微场景需要让观众靠近以后才发现，并通过动作关系讲清一个小故事。

根据主题自然加入少量【文化元素】，例如陶器、手工纸、染布、竹篮、茶具、植物、古琴、纸鸢、木桌、工具等。器物应真正参与场景，不要为了装饰而堆砌，也不要做成整齐的商品陈列。

画面可以设置一个面积极小的视觉点睛色，例如朱砂红、暖橙、枯金或灯火色，通常控制在整体面积的 1%–3%。点睛色应与主题发生关系，例如窑火、印记、器物、染材或自然光点，而不是随意添加装饰。

主标题【主标题】使用精致、克制的中文宋体、明朝体或具有现代出版气质的字体。标题字号保持中小尺度，不使用巨大 Typography，不让文字压过大色域。辅助英文、日期、地点和活动类型使用更小字号，形成清楚的信息层级，并保留充分留白。

排版避免规则居中和 PPT 式网格。优先使用不对称构图、大小反差、疏密变化、大面积留白、色块错位和前后遮挡，让文字像文化机构的编辑信息一样自然进入画面，而不是覆盖在视觉主体表面。

整体阅读顺序应为：

大片纸本色域与材质关系 → 微型人物场景与文化行为 → 主标题 → 小型活动信息。

最终呈现一种“远看简洁有大形，近看精致有材质、有故事”的现代东方文化海报。整体应兼具纸本拼贴、水彩肌理、编辑设计、微型叙事和文化活动视觉的特征，精致但不过度繁复。

避免：书籍封面既视感、巨大标题、传统水墨画、普通国风插画、写实摄影背景、PPT式排版、商业广告感、元素堆砌、无意义英文占位词、脏旧纸张、强噪点、塑料质感、3D CGI、玻璃材质、霓虹色、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【文化主题】：填写，如唐三彩、青花瓷、钧窑、建盏
【核心器物】：填写名称、器型及材质特征
【中文主标题】：填写
【英文主标题】：填写
【文化短句】：填写
【系列名称】：器色有形 / COLORS OF HERITAGE
【主色与辅助色】：填写
【视觉模式】：深色矿物 / 高饱和撞色 / 渐变光栅
【画幅比例】：9:16

创作一张高完成度的东方文博实验字体艺术海报，融合中国传统美学、博物馆展览视觉、复古编辑设计与现代实验 Typography。

一、器物与构图

以一件具有真实文化特征的器物作为核心主视觉，大比例展示，具备准确的器型、精致的材质纹理、自然釉面或表面质感，以及博物馆藏品摄影般的光影层次。

允许器物局部放大、边缘出框，与文字产生前后遮挡。加入一件局部裁切或半透明的辅助器物，利用大小、虚实、方向与形态差异建立空间层次。

二、字体与排版

中文主标题使用巨大而富有力量的毛笔书法，具有自然的笔锋、飞白与粗细变化，成为画面的重要视觉图形。

英文主标题采用高品质大写复古衬线字体，通过放大、分行、错位与叠压，与中文书法及器物产生互动。可加入少量优雅的英文连笔字作为辅助。

画面必须具有完整的编辑式信息层级，包括系列名称、器物名称、文化分类、工艺说明、中英文短句及少量精致标注线。信息密度中高，但保持明确的主次关系。

三、色彩与背景

根据选择的视觉模式设计：

- 深色矿物： 墨黑、深蓝、铜金等色彩，融合矿物纹理、局部金属色细节、半透明书法底纹，呈现深邃厚重的文化气质。
- 高饱和撞色： 使用两种鲜明的主色进行大面积分区，搭配有机曲线、器物错位出框、巨大字体与低对比文化纹样，形成复古编辑设计感。
- 渐变光栅： 使用具有空间深度的青蓝、靛紫等渐变色场，叠加连续细密的纵向光栅。线条在器物边缘产生轻微弯曲、疏密变化和前后遮挡，形成器物若隐若现的现代光学艺术效果。

背景融入与主题相关的传统书法、装饰纹样、釉色流动或历史文化肌理，透明度较低，丰富画面但不干扰主要信息。

四、视觉层级与完成度

以巨大中文书法、核心器物和英文大标题构建三个主要视觉锚点。

通过器物局部出框、文字叠压、色彩对比、背景虚影和精细线条，形成丰富的空间层次与阅读节奏。

远看具有强烈的视觉冲击和清晰的大形，近看能发现精致的材质、书法肌理、文化信息与图形细节。

整张海报应具有专业文博展览、艺术出版和文化品牌设计的完成度，成为一件具有独立主题表达的完整作品，而不是普通的器物展示模板。

确保器物造型准确、文字清晰、排版精密、色彩成熟。避免乱码、虚构展讯、无意义英文、廉价3D、过度科技特效、随机编号、四角星芒及水印。

最终输出一张9:16竖版高清艺术海报。

生成一张具有强视觉冲击和高级文化展览气质的「中轴夹景」海报。

先建立一条明确、稳定的垂直中轴，再让【左侧主体】与【右侧主体】从画面两侧共同形成视觉重量，把主标题、人物、植物或留白区域推向中央。

左右主体必须足够大，靠近画面边缘并允许自然裁切，共同承担主要视觉重量。两侧可以在轮廓、大小、颜色、材质和细节上不同，但整体视觉重量必须平衡，避免简单复制和机械镜像。

根据主题选择不同的夹景方式：

圆形、弧形主体可利用轮廓共同夹出中央负形；
建筑、屏风等空间主体可通过透视形成纵深中轴；
织物、植物等柔性材料可通过自然弯曲形成柔性夹景；
器物、人物或文物可通过左右配重强化中央标题。

中轴必须成为画面最重要的阅读区域。中文主标题使用大胆的大字号，可采用纵排、横竖混排、尺度变化、局部遮挡或与主体轻微穿插，让 Typography 真正参与构图，而不是普通放在顶部。

允许中轴加入一个低权重视觉节点，例如极小人物、花枝、纹样拓片、结构线稿或研究图，让中央既有焦点又有层次，但不要形成第三个同等级主体。

信息密度可以丰富，但集中在 2–3 个区域：中轴核心信息、左右边栏、底部展讯。通过超大标题与极小文字形成明显字号反差，不要把小字平均撒满整个画面。

使用一个明确的大面积主色建立识别度，例如朱红、钴蓝、柠檬黄、草绿、青蓝、深棕或柿子橙。整体控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，通过主体材质、Typography 和极少量点缀色形成对比。

核心原则：不是简单“左右对称”，而是利用两侧视觉重量共同塑造中心。左右负责施压，中轴负责聚焦；结构稳定，但细节允许不同。

整体要求：强中轴、强主体、强色域，设计感明确，信息丰富但不乱，边缘清晰，文字清楚，材质真实，具有成熟文化展览海报与 Editorial Design 的完成度。

提示词：

【主题 / 作品名】：____
【核心主体】：____
【聚核方式】：人物视线 / 光线空间 / 元素回流 / Typography 密度 / 其他
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【视觉风格】：____
【主色调】：____
【辅助色】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 与艺术展览视觉质感的海报。

先确定一个绝对视觉核心，再让画面里的其他力量主动把视线送回这个核心。重点不是简单把主体放在中间，而是建立清晰的“向心关系”。

根据内容选择合适的聚核方式：

人物类：通过人物视线、头部朝向、身体姿态、手势和道具方向共同指向核心人物，让看不见的视线成为引导线。

空间类：通过建筑透视、墙体切面、明暗关系和光线方向，把多个空间力量汇聚到同一个焦点；主体即使很小，也能成为第一视觉。

纸本 / 拼贴类：让纸页、图像、文字条和版面碎片形成连续回流路径，外围元素有大小、疏密和方向变化，但最终都回到中央版心或核心对象。

Typography 类：通过字号、字重、字距、密度和方向变化制造向心关系；越靠近核心，文字越强、越密，外围则更轻、更疏。文字本身成为图像，而不是普通信息排版。

整张画面只保留一个主要视觉核。辅助元素只能围绕、指向、托住或平衡它，不能形成第二个同等重量的视觉中心。

Typography 必须与作品主题本身有关，不出现“视觉聚核”“构图案例”“设计研究”等模板化占位文字。让每张海报首先是一件独立成立的作品，再把构图方法藏在设计里面。

控制信息层级：主标题承担主要文字视觉；副标题和作品短句建立内容气质；日期、机构等信息集中在少量区域。避免把小字平均撒满整个版面。

保留足够负空间。可以使用裁切、叠压、透视、回流、密度变化和非对称平衡增强张力，但不要依靠箭头、明显辅助线或无意义装饰去解释构图。

整体要求：聚焦明确、主次清楚、丰富但不乱、有作品感、有成熟视觉设计品质，适合海报、展览视觉、Editorial Design 和封面设计。

加入少量极细的纵向线、弧线或测量线，作为连接与节奏元素。下方或中下部放置 1 个小尺寸具象主体，作为视觉落点，例如器物、花枝、小型装置、标本、人物剪影等，主体不能过大，不能抢走几何构成的主导地位。

右侧安排大号纵向中文标题【标题】，字体修长、疏朗、留白充足；左侧或中下区域安排极细小字信息，包括【副标题】、【活动信息】、【日期时间】、【地点】与少量英文信息，形成“大字极疏、小字极密”的编辑反差。整体留白充分，信息密度克制，版式要像独立出版物或展览海报，而不是模板图。

特别要求：顶部主圆必须完整显示，不能被左侧或顶部裁切；背景必须完整铺满整个画布，右侧不能出现额外白边或独立白栏；画面要像完整作品，不像占位模板。

Prompt:

TITLE: [TENSION / DRIFT / FOCUS / REFRACT / your own word]
PROJECT: [brand / exhibition / campaign name]
ENVIRONMENT: [fabric canopy / terrain / mirror installation / water / other]
TYPE MECHANISM: [surface distortion / terrain warp / reflection / refraction]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
MAIN COLOR: [accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically transformed by the material or environment around it.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition and become part of the scene itself. Let the letterforms stretch, bend, split, compress or realign according to the chosen surface or optical medium.

For fabric, let the type follow tension, curvature and suspended folds.
For terrain, let it wrap across slopes, ridges and valleys.
For mirrors, distort the source typography so the reflection resolves into a readable word.
For water, use depth and refraction to shift and reconnect the letterforms.

Keep the spatial logic physically believable, with correct perspective, occlusion, reflections, refraction and surface contact.

Use one strong accent color against a restrained architectural or natural palette. Keep the typography bold, clean and highly legible from the intended viewpoint.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference or observer within the typographic space.

Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, date, location and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, spatial graphic design, contemporary installation art, editorial poster, strong depth, clean hierarchy and high visual impact.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a bold commercial campaign poster where oversized typography controls gravity and directly affects how the subject moves.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Gravity Effect: [TILT / DROP / FLOAT / PULL / OTHER]
Movement: [DESCRIBE THE ACTION]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, strong perspective, vivid high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the typography extremely large and let it create a clear gravity effect:

 TILT: rotate the direction of gravity while the normal poster layout stays upright.
 DROP: pull the subject and typography downward, with stronger vertical displacement toward the bottom.
 FLOAT: remove the ground and let the subject, clothing, hair, and typography naturally suspend at different depths.
 PULL: create an opposing force that pulls clothing, hair, straps, or products toward the typography while the subject moves against it.

The body pose, hair, clothing, accessories, shadows, and products must all follow the same gravity logic so the effect feels physically believable.

Create clear foreground, subject, and background layers, with parts of the typography moving in front of and behind the subject.

Keep the main letters crisp, readable, and clean. Use smooth matte surfaces, even color, sharp edges, and controlled depth. Avoid distressed, chipped, dirty, concrete-like, or noisy textures.

All motion paths, gravity lines, curves, and callout lines should be continuous, smooth, and clearly rendered.

Keep people highly realistic with natural anatomy, believable proportions, real skin texture, controlled highlights, and detailed hair. Avoid waxy skin, oily reflections, CGI appearance, distorted limbs, and exaggerated wide-angle proportions.

Use one dominant high-impact color with black, white, and one strong accent color. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand, product name, slogan, and 2–3 concise feature callouts.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual where typography, gravity, and human movement behave as one physical system.

Create a striking literary book cover combining intricate vintage engraving, scratchboard illustration, and sophisticated negativespace design.

Composition & Duality

Build the composition around two contrasting yet interconnected subjects. Use bold blackandivory silhouettes, shared contours, interlocking shapes, and figureground reversal.

Create dynamic tension through opposing movements, sweeping curves, and asymmetrical balance. Both subjects should feel like parts of one unified visual structure.

Engraving & Details

Use exceptionally detailed fineline engraving, rich crosshatching, and layered grayscale shading.

Render feathers, scales, fur, branches, or other relevant textures with precise, directional strokes following each subject's anatomy.

Concentrate intricate details around focal points while preserving clean negative spaces. Strong silhouettes from a distance, exquisite details up close.

Color & Atmosphere

Use deep black, warm ivory, and layered charcoalgray tones. Add a tiny amount of the selected accent color to one meaningful detail.

Maintain a dramatic, mysterious atmosphere with refined matte print texture.

Typography

Design a complete literary book cover featuring:

 An elegant serif tagline at the top.
 A large, expressive italic serif title integrated into the artwork.
 The author's name in uppercase serif lettering.
 A small "A NOVEL" label at the bottom.

Ensure accurate spelling, beautiful typography, and clear visual hierarchy.

Create a visually powerful composition with opposing forces, intricate engravings, and elegant editorial design.

Output one complete, flat 9:16 book cover, without mockups.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Nano banana V2.1 on Flow. 

System prompt : 
HUMAN PORTRAIT DIRECTOR
ROLE

Translate user briefs into production ready image generation prompts for photographic portraits. Prioritize authentic skin anatomy, subtle facial expression, directional lighting, and clear focal hierarchy.
Support individual portraits, paired portraits, environmental portraits, and multi image character series. Strictly follow all user specifications for subject identity, age, wardrobe, environment, lighting, aspect ratio, and target model format.

REFERENCE HANDLING

 * Attribute Isolation: Distinguish style references from identity, pose, wardrobe, lighting, and composition. Apply only the parameters assigned to each specific reference. Style references govern photographic treatment only; they do not dictate subject identity, garments, or layout.

 * Artifact Exclusion: Disregard UI overlays, watermarks, crop borders, and annotations present in reference images unless explicitly requested.
 * Missing Assets: If a referenced file is unavailable and essential to generation, request clarification rather than guessing.

FACIAL GEOMETRY AND EXPRESSION

 * Underlying Structure: Establish cranial anatomy, cheek volume, jaw contour, orbital depth, nose bridge, lips, and hairline before adding micro-detail. Maintain organic asymmetry and believable proportions.

 * Mature Anatomy: Distribute aging characteristics naturally across facial planes (brow laxity, periorbital lines, nasolabial folds, jawline softening). Avoid exaggerating every aging artifact on a single face.

 * Observable Expression: Define visible muscular movement rather than subjective mood adjectives. Specify gaze vector, eyelid aperture, brow tension, lip closure, and head angle.
SKIN AND SURFACE OPTICS
 * Scale Hierarchy: Describe skin across macro volume, anatomical folds, and micro-surface variation according to camera distance and framing.
 * Texture Distribution: Keep skin texture non-uniform. Forehead creases follow the frontal muscle, crow's feet radiate outward, and nasolabial folds follow facial contours. Pore visibility varies naturally across the T-zone and cheeks.
 * Material Physics: Distinguish surface relief from pigmentation. Treat freckles, lentigines, and minor vascular flush as pigmentation variations rather than physical indentations. Specify realistic specular response: diffuse matte planes along the perimeter with soft specular sheen across the bridge and cheeks.

 * Optical Attenuation: Micro-detail resolves only where the primary light and focal plane intersect. Shadows and optical defocus must naturally soften surface detail.

 * Anti Artifact Guardrails: Avoid waxy smoothing, synthetic pore overlays, over carved wrinkles, high frequency digital sharpening, and uniform oily shine across the face.

EYES, HAIR, AND CONTACT POINTS

 * Ocular Optics: Make the eyes the primary focal anchor when visible. Specify natural limbal rings, iris depth, moist lower lid margins, and precise catchlights consistent with the key light source.

 * Hair Dynamics: Define hair as volumetric masses and layered groupings accented by broken strands and organic flyaways. Avoid wire-like rendering, edge halos, or uniform strand density.

 * Physical Contact: When hands touch the face or neck, specify the hand, finger posture, contact point, and tissue compression. Match hand scale, vascularity, skin tone, and age characteristics to the face.

OPTICS AND COMPOSITION

 * Framing and Stance: Define camera framing (close-up, medium portrait, environmental portrait) and cranial angle (frontal, three quarter, profile). Decouple ocular gaze direction from head orientation.

 * Focal Length: Use short telephoto perspectives (typically 85mm full-frame equivalent) to ensure natural facial compression and prevent wide-angle optical distortion.

 * Depth of Field: Specify depth of field directly. Anchor critical focus on the nearest eye, allowing ears, rear hairline, wardrobe, and background to roll off into progressive optical blur. Maintain focal coherence across multiple subjects.

LIGHTING SETUP

 * Key Architecture: Anchor the scene with a dominant primary source (such as diffused north-facing window light or a large studio softbox). Specify source angle, elevation, and falloff relative to the camera axis.
 * Shadow Modulation: Use directional modeling to define facial planes while preserving gradated penumbras. Maintain ambient fill control: avoid muddy shadow crush, unmotivated rim lights, blown specular highlights, or conflicting catchlights.
 * Occlusion: Ensure hair, wardrobe, and hands cast accurate contact shadows across adjacent surfaces.

COLOR, WARDROBE, AND ENVIRONMENT

 * Color Grading: Preserve authentic skin undertones. Maintain controlled tonal contrast against subdued, neutral, or low-key backgrounds. Avoid global orange/teal grading or uniform color casts.
 * Wardrobe Realism: Specify realistic fabric properties (textile weave, weight, drape, seam structure, and subtle wear).

 * Background Depth: Keep backgrounds clean, contextual, and unobtrusive. Separate the subject using tonal contrast, selective lighting, and optical bokeh rather than decorative clutter.

 * Dynamic Range: Preserve midtone detail, highlight retention, and clean shadow separation. Do not use exaggerated clarity filters, HDR halos, or crushed blacks.

SERIES CONTINUITY

 * Independence: Generate complete, standalone prompts per frame. Do not format outputs as contact sheets or multi-panel grids unless explicitly directed.
 * Character Consistency: For consistent identity across a series, lock core facial geometry, eye shape, and defining traits. Vary only pose, framing, wardrobe, or light.
 * Cohort Diversity: For distinct subjects within a shared series, vary underlying bone structure and features while maintaining consistent optical and lighting parameters.

PROMPT ARCHITECTURE

 * Clause Sequence: Structure prompts logically: Subject and Demographics -> Framing and Camera Angle -> Pose and Muscular Expression -> Wardrobe and Props -> Key and Ambient Lighting -> Surface Optics and Focus Roll-Off -> Background and Atmosphere -> Technical Parameters.

 * Anti-Slop Directive: Exclude buzzwords such as "photorealistic", "hyperrealistic", "masterpiece", "award-winning", "8K resolution", "unreal engine", or publication names. Replace subjective praise with concrete photographic descriptors: lens focal length, aperture setting, lighting geometry, and surface physics.
 * Token Economy: Keep standard prompts compact and information-dense (approximately 150 to 220 words). Every sentence must specify a visible physical property or mitigate a generative failure mode.

PLATFORM AND SYNTAX HANDLING

 * Parameter Compliance: When targeting Midjourney, append only valid, verified flags (such as --ar, --stylize, --v) at the end of the prompt. Do not fabricate seed numbers, personalization hashes, or style reference codes.
 * Schema Adherence: When JSON or YAML output is requested, output strict, valid schemas without inline comments, markdown wrappers inside keys, or trailing commas.
 * Multilingual Terminology: When non-English output is requested, use verified photographic and optical terminology in the target language.

OUTPUT PROTOCOL

 * Return strictly the finished prompt text (or numbered list for multiple prompts) without conversational preamble, sign-offs, or meta-commentary unless requested.
 * Use direct language with zero em dashes, zero decorative markdown wrappers, and zero vague filler.

设计一张高密度 Editorial / Museum Poster。把文字、图案、图像、档案资料和版式真正融合成一个整体，强调 controlled chaos / 凌乱美，不要简单平铺素材。

SYSTEM PROMPT: WORLDKNOT CHRONICLE

Rewrite the user's text, image, or both as one prompt for GPT Image Gen V2 or Nano Banana Pro. Write in the user's language, preserve text, and keep requested or source ratio.

Use three systems. Directive Vector carries one clear action, gaze, path, beam, tool, or gesture from origin to target. Worldbody Weave turns the larger receiving force into an environment-scale body built from anatomy, terrain, smoke, water, roots, fabric, cables, or masonry. Margin Chronicle contains the image and repeats one subject-derived motif through border bands, corner records, or a cartouche.

Do not create generic Celtic fantasy, a warrior facing a one-eyed giant, or ornament without function. Determine subject, scale relation, vector route, target, worldbody materials, motif, open interval, border logic, and quiet region.

Preserve subject, count, identity, action, setting, clothing, objects, colors, text, and references. For edits, preserve unrequested content. Use references only for scale asymmetry, contour, metallic structure, patterned mass, interval, and frame. Do not copy characters, weapons, symbols, titles, or exact ornament.

Directive Vector needs one owner, route, and consequence. Keep it clear through gesture, light, tool alignment, gaze, road, or another caused line. Do not add competing vectors.

Worldbody Weave needs coherent anatomy or construction. Its pattern comes from the subject's material, not default spirals or knots. Dense detail belongs inside the large body; the smaller source stays clearer.

Margin Chronicle relays the motif with changes in scale, direction, and density. Use a title strip only when text is requested. Otherwise use a blank cartouche or ornament. Keep an open interval between source and worldbody.

Use parchment, ink, opaque wash, and restrained metallic gold. Gold marks light, attachment, route, or structure. Remove praise, mood labels, fake detail, repetition, and alternatives. Use concrete nouns and active verbs. No em dash or en dash.

GPT: return 500 to 800 words in five paragraphs covering scene, subjects, systems, composition, surface, references, text, and failures.

NANO: return JSON only, 1000 to 1800 tokens, using "aspect_ratio", "references", "scene", "subjects", "directive_vector", "worldbody_weave", "margin_chronicle", "composition", "surface_and_palette", "text", "avoid". Omit unused fields. No metadata, IDs, weights, comments, or repetition.

Use references only for scale asymmetry, contour, metallic structure, patterned mass, interval, and frame. Do not copy characters, weapons, symbols, titles, or exact ornament.

Directive Vector needs one owner, route, and consequence. Keep it clear through gesture, light, tool alignment, gaze, road, or another caused line. Do not add competing vectors.

Worldbody Weave needs coherent anatomy or construction. Its pattern comes from the subject's material, not default spirals or knots. Dense detail belongs inside the large body; the smaller source stays clearer.

Margin Chronicle relays the motif with changes in scale, direction, and density. Use a title strip only when text is requested. Otherwise use a blank cartouche or ornament. Keep an open interval between source and worldbody.

Use parchment, ink, opaque wash, and restrained metallic gold. Gold marks light, attachment, route, or structure. Remove praise, mood labels, fake detail, repetition, and alternatives. Use concrete nouns and active verbs. No em dash or en dash.

GPT: return 500 to 800 words in five paragraphs covering scene, subjects, systems, composition, surface, references, text, and failures.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：{青瓷 / 传统服饰 / 宣纸 / 砚石 / 其他东方文化材质}
【中文标题】：{4–6 字主题名称}
【英文标题】：{对应英文展览标题}
【核心主体】：{器物 / 织物 / 纸张 / 材质对象}
【辅助档案】：{线稿 / 古画 / 山水 / 结构图 / 材质研究 / 文献等}
【主色调】：{月白灰青 / 浅玉色 / 暖米灰 / 墨黑等}
【核心构图】：{景深留白 / 对角悬浮 / 纸层拼贴 / 大块材质裁切等}
【画幅比例】：9:16

设计一张高级东方文博编辑海报，将传统东方器物、织物、纸张或自然材质重新组织进当代博物馆展览、艺术出版物与文化研究视觉系统中。

整体视觉强调“克制、留白、材质与信息层级”，不是传统中国风装饰海报，也不是普通产品展示。

背景使用温润干净的暖象牙白、月白或极浅灰白艺术纸 / 展览空间，只保留极轻微真实纸张、织物或自然材质纹理，不做旧、不脏、不泛黄。

采用成熟的非对称编辑网格，让【核心主体】通过放大、裁切、悬浮、透光、虚焦、叠层、斜向进入或局部超出画面的方式参与构图。不要规整居中完整展示，而要让主体本身成为版式结构的一部分。

根据【核心构图】建立明确空间关系：

可使用前景虚化、中景主体、远景轮廓形成景深；
可使用半透明纸层、织物、玻璃或自然投影形成叠层；
可使用大块材质切面、留白和阴影形成抽象几何关系；
可让主体的轮廓、褶皱、边缘、孔洞、纹理或结构线自然参与文字排版。

Typography 使用现代宋体 / 明朝体与高对比 Serif 英文字体混排。

中文标题作为主要或次要视觉锚点，根据画面选择横排、竖排、错位或大尺度局部排列；英文标题承担另一层编辑层级。不要所有文字等大，要形成明显的“大标题 × 中型说明 × 极小档案信息”尺度差异。

在留白区域加入少量真正有意义的展览信息、材料研究、制作方式、文化说明和机构信息，使画面接近真实博物馆图录、艺术出版物或研究型展览视觉，而不是使用随机英文或 Lorem Ipsum。

加入与主题相关的【辅助档案】，例如：

器物轮廓线稿、山水档案、传统服饰结构图、材质截面、纸张纹理、拓片、手稿、器形分类、工艺研究图等。

所有辅助内容必须降低对比度、局部裁切、半透明化，只作为第二层或第三层信息，不与主体竞争。

色彩使用低饱和东方材质色，根据主题控制在 3–5 个主要色阶以内。例如：

暖象牙白 + 月白 + 灰青；暖米白 + 浅玉色 + 墨灰；暖白 + 淡茶褐 + 石灰；暖白 + 墨黑 + 浅石色。

不要为了“东方感”堆叠大量红、金、青绿等传统色。

画面必须建立清楚的三级观看关系：

远看：
主体大形、标题和留白首先成立，缩略图状态下仍然有明确视觉重心。

中距离：
能够发现材质、光影、景深、投影、裁切和主体与 Typography 之间的空间关系。

近距离：
才能阅读档案信息、研究标签、线稿、材质说明和细小文字。

保持约 45%–60% 的有效留白，但留白必须受到主体方向、光线、材质边界和文字网格的控制，不能只是单纯空着。

最终效果像亚洲顶级美术馆、设计博物馆、传统工艺研究机构或高级独立艺术出版物制作的东方文博展览主视觉：

传统对象经过当代编辑设计重新组织，安静、克制、真实、有空气感、有知识性，同时具有完整的作品感和成熟的信息层级。

避免：传统中国风模板、主体完整居中、商业产品广告、电商展示、红金配色堆叠、祥云边框、满屏书法、过度做旧、脏污纸张、CGI 塑料材质、强烈奢侈品高光、随机英文、信息过少、模板化极简、编号、No.、Vol.、四角星芒。

整体采用写实 Editorial Photography × 情绪艺术海报视觉语言，不是普通人物写真或商业广告。

人物保持真实自然的五官、皮肤纹理和身体比例。核心使用“局部清晰 + 动态残影”的摄影方式：人物身体、肩颈、手部和部分花束保持相对清晰；头发、脸部边缘、衣摆或动作方向产生自然的慢速快门 motion blur、轻微双重曝光和时间错位效果。

不要整个人平均模糊。脸部主体仍然需要可辨认，只让局部五官、发丝或轮廓产生方向明确的残影，让画面像同时记录了两个非常接近的时间节点。

花束作为情绪视觉锚点，中心花朵相对清晰，外围花瓣、枝叶可以出现少量动态拖影。花束颜色与场景形成明确的冷暖或明暗对比。

背景根据场景产生不同的流动效果，例如交通灯光横向拉丝、植物前景掠过、麦田和裙摆随风流动、走廊灯光形成时间残影。背景需要有运动和空气感，但不要抢过人物。

构图保持不完全对称和自然留白，人物放在画面一侧，另一侧留给标题与环境。加入克制的中文竖排标题和小号英文副标题，使用现代宋体 / 细衬线字体，让部分发丝、光影或环境残影轻微穿过文字区域，使 Typography 与摄影自然融合。

整体低饱和、电影感、真实、诗意、有情绪张力。画面既要有人物美感，也要有时间正在流逝的感觉。

设计一张具有现代东方编辑美学的文化活动海报，以「大色域 + 微场景」作为核心构成方法，并融合纸本拼贴、水彩与天然颜料的材料质感。

画面首先建立一个清晰而有视觉重量的【主色域】。使用大面积、不规则、具有自然边缘的纸本色块承担主要构图，根据【海报主题】让色块通过层叠、围合、错位、穿插、悬挂、延伸或负空间关系形成抽象空间。色块可以暗示山势、庭院、工坊、染布、陶窑、林地等，但不要直接画成普通写实场景。

纸本色块必须具有明显而高级的真实材料感：天然长短纤维、手工纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、轻微压痕、自然浓淡、大尺度色差与不规则撕纸边缘。材质丰富但整体保持干净、完整、哑光、有呼吸感。避免脏污、黄斑、严重褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和廉价仿古效果。

大色域是画面的第一视觉。远看时应首先看到清楚的大形、色彩关系和空间结构，即使缩小成社交媒体信息流尺寸仍然具有明显识别度。不要依赖细小文字或复杂细节才能成立。

在大片色块形成的空间中加入一个尺度很小但叙事完整的【微场景】。人物与道具整体只占画面约 2%–5%，人物正在真实地执行【人物动作】，不直视镜头、不摆拍。微场景需要让观众靠近以后才发现，并通过动作关系讲清一个小故事。

根据主题自然加入少量【文化元素】，例如陶器、手工纸、染布、竹篮、茶具、植物、古琴、纸鸢、木桌、工具等。器物应真正参与场景，不要为了装饰而堆砌，也不要做成整齐的商品陈列。

画面可以设置一个面积极小的视觉点睛色，例如朱砂红、暖橙、枯金或灯火色，通常控制在整体面积的 1%–3%。点睛色应与主题发生关系，例如窑火、印记、器物、染材或自然光点，而不是随意添加装饰。

主标题【主标题】使用精致、克制的中文宋体、明朝体或具有现代出版气质的字体。标题字号保持中小尺度，不使用巨大 Typography，不让文字压过大色域。辅助英文、日期、地点和活动类型使用更小字号，形成清楚的信息层级，并保留充分留白。

排版避免规则居中和 PPT 式网格。优先使用不对称构图、大小反差、疏密变化、大面积留白、色块错位和前后遮挡，让文字像文化机构的编辑信息一样自然进入画面，而不是覆盖在视觉主体表面。

整体阅读顺序应为：

大片纸本色域与材质关系 → 微型人物场景与文化行为 → 主标题 → 小型活动信息。

最终呈现一种“远看简洁有大形，近看精致有材质、有故事”的现代东方文化海报。整体应兼具纸本拼贴、水彩肌理、编辑设计、微型叙事和文化活动视觉的特征，精致但不过度繁复。

避免：书籍封面既视感、巨大标题、传统水墨画、普通国风插画、写实摄影背景、PPT式排版、商业广告感、元素堆砌、无意义英文占位词、脏旧纸张、强噪点、塑料质感、3D CGI、玻璃材质、霓虹色、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。
